jobs.title: Staff Data Scientist - Supply Chain Optimisation

titleByLocale.en: Staff Data Scientist - Supply Chain Optimisation
titleByLocale.it: Staff Data Scientist - Supply Chain Optimisation
titleByLocale.fr: Staff Data Scientist - Chaîne d'approvisionnement Optimisation

jobs.description:
In short
 As a Staff Data Scientist in Supply Chain, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of On’s supply chain. You are a technical leader within our data science team, responsible for designing, developing, and deploying cutting-edge optimization solutions and advanced forecasting models. Your work will have a topline impact on our ability to optimize inventory, improve planning accuracy, and make data-driven decisions at a global scale.

You will tackle our most complex and ambiguous challenges in our supply chain. You will not only build and implement models but also provide strategic guidance, mentor fellow data scientists, and drive the technical roadmap for forecasting at On.

Your mission
 - Position data science to drive topline impact on the supply chain, reducing stockouts and ensuring orders are met in full, through evaluating the space and providing clarity on what needs to happen from both a technology, algorithm, and process perspective to achieve results.
- Design, develop, and implement state-of-the-art optimization models to drive a more efficient, resilient, and reliable supply chain.
- Lead complex, end-to-end optimization projects from conception to deployment, ensuring they meet business needs and are scalable and robust.
- Provide guidance on forecasting approaches and how they impact supply chain optimization and performance.
- Collaborate with senior stakeholders across the organization, including Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Product, and Controlling, to guide supply chain strategy so that it can best take advantage of data & AI.
- Act as a thought leader in the field of supply chain optimization and forecasting, staying abreast of the latest research and technologies and identifying opportunities to apply them at On.
- Mentor and coach other data scientists, providing technical guidance and helping them grow in their careers.
- Contribute to the development of our data science platform and infrastructure, ensuring we have the tools and processes to build and deploy models efficiently.

Your story
 - A deep understanding of statistical modeling, machine learning, and time-series forecasting. You have 8+ years of experience in data science, with a focus on optimization in the context of supply chains. Experience building forecasting models is also desired.
- A Master's or Ph.D. in a quantitative field such as Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related discipline.
- A hands-on-keyboard data scientist who is also a strategic thinker. You can lead projects, mentor others, and drive technical decisions.
- Expertise in Python and SQL, and experience with data science libraries such as Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, and TensorFlow/PyTorch. Experience deploying and maintaining machine learning and optimization models in a production environment.
- Experience with optimization software such as (but not limited to) Gurobi, as well as fluency in large-scale data processing and distributed computing frameworks (e.g. Spark).
- A strong communicator who can build relationships with stakeholders at all levels of the organization. You can translate complex technical concepts into business terms and drive alignment around your proposed solutions.
- Are passionate about using data to drive business impact and are excited about the opportunity to shape the future of On’s supply chain.

Meet the team
 You will be part of a growing and diverse team of ML engineers, data scientists, data engineers, and product managers passionate about revolutionizing how we leverage AI/ML to solve complex challenges across On.

We focus on building and operating the creative and impactful models that personalize experiences, optimize decision-making, and predict future trends. The team operates in a fast-paced environment and is used to rapid turnaround times and ambitious targets. The shared goal is efficient growth at high speed, ensuring our ML systems scale with On's needs.

What we offer
 On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

jobs.description:
Commercial Project & Strategic Initiatives Lead (12-Months Maternity Cover)

At a Glance

We are looking for a strategic, action-oriented, and highly capable Commercial Project & Strategic Initiatives Lead to step into a critical 12-month maternity cover role.

In this position, you won't just manage timelines, you will own the execution of high-impact strategic initiatives across our global commercial landscape. You will take point on complex, cross-functional projects, orchestrate alignment between diverse stakeholder groups, and importantly, ensure that new programs are successfully adopted by regional markets to drive tangible business growth.

Your Team

You will be joining the Global Commercial Programs & Market Expansion team - the command centre behind some of our most critical and high-impact strategic initiatives. This is where strategy turns into action and where we push ideas all the way to the finish line.

Operating at the intersection of Commercial Strategy, Sales, Product, GTM, Tech, and regional markets, the team drives the programs that shape how we operate, scale our business, and unlock new growth opportunities. We take complex challenges, bring clarity and structure, and turn them into tangible results.

While anchored within the broader Commercial Operations setup, the team operates with a strong strategy and business development mindset, focusing on translating strategic priorities into execution that drives premium growth and commercial impact.

Think of us as the team that bridges strategy and execution, aligning the right people, making sharp decisions, and turning ambition into measurable business results.

If you’re energized by shaping direction, solving complex challenges, and driving real impact, you found your team!

Your Mission

• Drive Complex Strategic Initiatives: Take end-to-end ownership of large-scale, high-priority commercial projects from ideation through to final delivery, ensuring milestones are met on time and within scope.

• Cross-Functional Orchestration: Act as the ultimate bridge between Commercial Strategy, Sales, Product, GTM, and Tech. Align diverse teams around unified project goals, navigating a complex matrix organization with ease.

• Strategic Stakeholder Management: Proactively engage and build deep trust with internal stakeholders and senior leadership. Manage expectations, navigate conflicting priorities, and facilitate sharp, data-driven decision-making.

• Drive Adoption & Change Management: Ensure that projects don’t just launch, but land. Own the post-launch adoption strategy, ensuring regional markets and teams fully integrate new tools, programs, and commercial frameworks into their daily operations.

• Impact Communication: Deliver clear, compelling project updates, risk assessments, and milestone reports to the Cross-Functional Program Management Team and executive leadership.

Your Story

• Experience: A minimum of 6 years of proven experience leading complex project management, program management, or strategic initiatives (experience in management consulting or a fast-paced global commercial environment is highly valued).

• Project Mastery: Exceptional project management capabilities with a track record of successfully delivering large-scale, multi-layered initiatives in matrixed organizations. Project management certification (PMP, PRINCE2, Agile) is preferred.

• Stakeholder & Influence Skills: Outstanding interpersonal and communication skills. You are an expert at managing senior stakeholders, resolving conflict, and influencing cross-functional teams without direct authority.

• Adoption Focused: Demonstrated experience in change management, training rollout, or user adoption strategies, ensuring organizational changes stick.

• Problem Solver: A natural ability to bring structure to ambiguity, break down complex challenges into actionable steps, and maintain a solution-oriented mindset.

• Tools & Languages: Proficiency with enterprise project management tools (e.g., Jira). Fluent in English; additional languages are a clear plus.

What We Offer

A fair and balanced internal recruiting process with an opportunity to learn about other teams, roles, and challenges. On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Sr. Lead - Progetto commerciale e iniziative strategiche (12 mesi di copertura per la maternità)

In una prospettiva: Stiamo cercando un individuo dotato e strategico per svolgere temporaneamente il ruolo di Lead del Processo e del Progetto Commerciale. Come responsabile del Processo e del Progetto Commerciale, guiderai le nostre iniziative di miglioramento del processo e supervisionerai la riuscita realizzazione di progetti chiave all'interno della nostra organizzazione. Lavorerai a stretto contatto con team interfunzionali per guidare l'efficienza operativa, migliorare le capacità di gestione del progetto e garantire la riuscita dell'esecuzione di iniziative strategiche.

Il tuo team Entrerai nel team Global Commercial Programs & Market Expansion, il centro di comando dietro alcune delle nostre iniziative strategiche più critiche e ad alto impatto. Qui la strategia si trasforma in azione e dove spiniamo le idee fino al traguardo.

Operando all'incrocio tra i mercati Commercial Strategy, Sales, Product, GTM, Tech e Regional, il team guida i programmi che modellano il nostro funzionamento, scalano il nostro business e sbloccano nuove opportunità di crescita.Assuniamo sfide complesse, portiamo chiarezza e struttura, e li trasformiamo in risultati tangibili.

Pur essendo ancorato all'interno del più ampio sistema di operazioni commerciali, il team opera con una forte strategia e una mentalità di sviluppo aziendale, concentrandosi sulla traduzione delle priorità strategiche in esecuzione che guida la crescita premium e l'impatto commerciale.

Pensateci come il team che mette in contatto strategia ed esecuzione, allineando le persone giuste, prendendo decisioni decise e trasformando l'ambizione in risultati commerciali misurabili.

Se si.re stimolato da modellare direzione, risolvere sfide complesse, e guidando impatto reale, hai trovato il tuo team!

La tua missione - Team Leadership: fornire leadership e guida al team di gestione dei processi e dei progetti. Definire obiettivi chiari, aspettative e priorità. Mentore e sviluppare membri del team per migliorare le proprie competenze e capacità. - Stakeholder Engagement: promuovere relazioni positive con gli stakeholder interni per raccogliere feedback, affrontare le preoccupazioni e garantire la soddisfazione degli stakeholder. Gestire le aspettative e risolvere i conflitti se necessario. - Conducte Management: coordinare e gestire il gasdotto dei progetti commerciali e preparare i progetti per la presentazione durante la pianificazione trimestrale diensens.

- Gestione delle capacità: gestire la capacità all'interno del team di Progetto Commerciale per ottimizzare l'efficienza e massimizzare la produttività. - Gestione dei progetti: controllare la pianificazione, l'esecuzione e la consegna dei progetti organizzativi principali. - Gestione dei processi: controllare lo sviluppo e l'implementazione di iniziative di miglioramento dei processi in tutta l'organizzazione. - Comunicazione: mantenere una comunicazione regolare con gli stakeholder per fornire aggiornamenti dei progetti, affrontare le preoccupazioni e gestire le aspettative.

Preparare e presentare report sullo stato del progetto, pietre miliari e risultati per tutti i progetti commerciali al Team di Gestione del Programma Cross-Functional.

La tua storia - Laurea in Amministrazione aziendale, Gestione dei progetti o un campo correlato. - Almeno 6 anni di esperienza in progetti, processi o gestione dei programmi. - Una forte comprensione dei principi di gestione dei progetti, metodologie e best practice. - La certificazione di gestione dei progetti (PMP, PRINCE2, ecc.) preferita. - Una forte comprensione della gestione dei processi e delle metodologie e degli strumenti di miglioramento continuo. - Leadership di progetto e competenze di gestione del team, con la capacità di ispirare e di 107 team interfunzionali.

- Eccellente comunicazione e capacità interpersonali, con la capacità di impegnarsi efficacemente con gli stakeholder a tutti i livelli dell'organizzazione. - Proficienza con strumenti di project management e software come Asana. - Fluente in inglese; ulteriori lingue sono un plus.

Ciò che offriamo Un processo di reclutamento interno equo ed equilibrato con l'opportunità di conoscere altri team, ruoli e sfide. On è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. Ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente di lavoro equo e inclusivo, dove tutte le decisioni relative al reclutamento, avanzamento, e mantenimento sono esenti da discriminazione.

Als kaufmännischer Prozess- und Projektleitung führen Sie unsere Prozessverbesserungsinitiativen und überwachen die erfolgreiche Durchführung wichtiger Projekte innerhalb unserer Organisation. Sie arbeiten eng mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammen, um die operative Effizienz zu steigern, die Projektmanagementfähigkeiten zu verbessern und die erfolgreiche Durchführung strategischer Initiativen zu gewährleisten.

Ihr Team Sie werden Mitglied im Team Global Commercial Programs & Market Expansion - dem Kommandozentrum hinter einigen unserer kritischsten und wirkungsreichsten strategischen Initiativen. Hier wird Strategie in Aktion und wir treiben Ideen bis zum Ziel.

Das Team, das an der Schnittstelle von Kommerzieller Strategie, Vertrieb, Produkt, GTM, Technologie und regionalen Märkten arbeitet, treibt die Programme voran, die unsere Arbeitsweise gestalten, unser Geschäft skalieren und neue Wachstumschancen erschließen. Wir nehmen komplexe Herausforderungen an, bringen Klarheit und Struktur und machen daraus greifbare Ergebnisse.

Das Team, das im Rahmen des breiteren kommerziellen Betriebsaufbaus verankert ist, arbeitet mit einer starken Strategie und einer starken Unternehmensentwicklungsorientierung, wobei es sich auf die Umsetzung strategischer Prioritäten in die Umsetzung konzentriert, die Premium-Wachstum und kommerzielle Auswirkungen fördert.

Denken Sie an uns als das Team, das Strategie und Ausführung überbrückt, die richtigen Menschen ausgerichtet, scharfe Entscheidungen getroffen und Ehrgeiz in messbare Geschäftsergebnisse verwandelt.

Wenn Sie, durch die Gestaltung der Richtung, die Lösung komplexer Herausforderungen und die treibende echte Wirkung, Sie Ihr Team gefunden werden!

Ihre Mission - Team Leadership: Geben Sie dem Prozess- und Projektmanagement-Team Führung und Beratung. Setzen Sie klare Ziele, Erwartungen und Prioritäten. Mentor und entwickeln Sie Teammitglieder, um ihre Fähigkeiten und Fähigkeiten zu verbessern. - Stakeholder-Engagement: Fördern Sie positive Beziehungen mit internen Stakeholdern, um Feedback zu sammeln, Bedenken zu adressieren und die Zufriedenheit der Stakeholder zu gewährleisten.

- Capacity Management: Management der Kapazitäten im Commercial Project Team zur Optimierung der Effizienz und zur Maximierung der Produktivität. - Project Management: Überwachen Sie die Planung, Durchführung und Durchführung von wichtigen organisatorischen Projekten. - Process Management: Überwachen Sie die Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Prozessverbesserungsinitiativen im gesamten Unternehmen. - Kommunikation: Pflegen Sie regelmäßige Kommunikation mit Stakeholdern, um Projekt-Updates zu liefern, Anliegen zu adressieren und Erwartungen zu managen.

Bereiten Sie dem Cross-Functional Program Management Team Projektstatusberichte, Meilensteine und Lieferwerte für alle kommerziellen Projekte vor und präsentieren Sie diese.

Ihre Geschichte - Bachelor-Abschluss in Betriebswirtschaft, Projektmanagement, oder ein verwandtes Gebiet. - Mindestens 6 Jahre Erfahrung in Projekt-, Prozess- oder Programmmanagement. - Ein starkes Verständnis der Projektmanagement-Prinzipien, Methoden und Best Practices. - Projektmanagement-Zertifizierung (PMP, PRINCE2, etc.) bevorzugt. - Ein starkes Verständnis der Prozessmanagement- und kontinuierliche Verbesserungsmethoden und -Tools. - Bewährte Führungs- und Teammanagement-Fähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, funktionsübergreifende Teams zu inspirieren und zu motivieren.

- Ausgezeichnete Kommunikation und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten, mit der Fähigkeit, effektiv mit Stakeholdern auf allen Ebenen der Organisation zu engagieren. - Kompetenz mit Projektmanagement-Tools und Software wie Asana. - Fließend in Englisch; zusätzliche Sprachen sind ein Plus.

Was wir bieten Ein fairer und ausgewogener interner Rekrutierungsprozess mit der Möglichkeit, über andere Teams, Rollen und Herausforderungen zu lernen. On ist ein Chancengleichheits-Arbeitgeber. Wir sind verpflichtet, ein faires und integratives Arbeitsumfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Entscheidungen im Zusammenhang mit Rekrutierung, Fortschritt und Beibehaltung frei von Diskriminierung sind.

Votre équipe Vous vous joindrez à l'équipe des Programmes commerciaux mondiaux et de l'expansion du marché - le centre de commandement derrière certaines de nos initiatives stratégiques les plus critiques et les plus à impact élevé.

En travaillant à l'intersection des marchés commerciaux, des ventes, des produits, de la GTM, de la technologie et des marchés régionaux, l'équipe pilote les programmes qui façonnent notre fonctionnement, élargissent nos activités et ouvrent de nouvelles perspectives de croissance.

Bien qu'elle soit ancrée dans la structure générale des Opérations commerciales, l'équipe fonctionne avec une stratégie solide et une attitude de développement des affaires, en se concentrant sur la traduction des priorités stratégiques en exécution qui stimule la croissance et l'impact commercial.

Considérez-nous comme l'équipe qui relie la stratégie et l'exécution, qui aligne les bonnes personnes, qui prend des décisions fermes et qui transforme l'ambition en résultats opérationnels mesurables.

Mentor et former des membres d'équipe pour améliorer leurs compétences et leurs capacités. - Engagement des intervenants : Favoriser des relations positives avec les intervenants internes afin de recueillir des commentaires, de répondre aux préoccupations et d'assurer la satisfaction des intervenants.

- Gestion de la capacité : Gérer la capacité au sein de l'équipe de projet commercial d'optimiser l'efficacité et de maximiser la productivité. - Gestion de projet : Surveiller la planification, l'exécution et la réalisation des principaux projets organisationnels. - Gestion des processus : Surveiller l'élaboration et la mise en oeuvre d'initiatives d'amélioration des processus dans l'ensemble de l'organisation. - Communication : Maintenir des communications régulières avec les intervenants pour fournir des mises à jour de projet, répondre aux préoccupations et gérer les attentes.

Préparer et présenter des rapports d'étape, des jalons et des livrables pour tous les projets commerciaux à l'équipe de gestion du programme transfonctionnel.

Votre histoire - Baccalauréat en administration des affaires, gestion de projet ou domaine connexe. - Au moins 6 ans d'expérience en gestion de projet, de processus ou de programme. - Une bonne compréhension des principes, des méthodologies et des pratiques exemplaires en gestion de projet. - Une certification de gestion de projet (PMP, PRINCE2, etc.) préférée. - Une bonne compréhension de la gestion de processus et des méthodes et outils d'amélioration continue. - Une compétence en leadership et en gestion d'équipe, avec la capacité d'inspirer et de motiver les équipes interfonctionnelles.

- Excellente communication et aptitudes interpersonnelles, avec la capacité de s'engager efficacement avec les parties prenantes à tous les niveaux de l'organisation. - Compétence avec les outils de gestion de projet et les logiciels comme Asana. - Fluent en anglais; les langues supplémentaires sont un plus.

Ce que nous offrons Un processus de recrutement interne équitable et équilibré qui permet d'en apprendre davantage sur les autres équipes, les rôles et les défis. Nous sommes un employeur à égalité des chances. Nous sommes déterminés à créer un milieu de travail équitable et inclusif, où toutes les décisions liées au recrutement, à l'avancement et au maintien en poste sont exemptes de discrimination.

jobs.title: Specialist - Material Quality
jobs.description:
In short
 As the Material Quality Specialist for Apparel and Accessories, you will be responsible for upholding global quality standards, implementing processes, and tracking metrics that ensure premium material quality and pinnacle performance across the entire A&A product range. Your technical knowledge and analytical skills will support your cross-functional communication in relevant quality, testing, and compliance discussions. You will report to the A&A Material Quality, Testing, and Color Lead, and work closely with Material Development, Product Quality, Material Sourcing, Product Compliance, and material vendors/product factories around the world.

Your mission
 - Partner with product creation teams, sourcing offices, and suppliers to identify and mitigate material quality risks before manufacturing, and support remediation material quality issues in bulk production

- Drive the collection, interpretation, and communication of material testing data (3rd party, T2, and Internal)

- Identify opportunity for quality improvements as it relates to material/trim development and specialized testing

- Maximize information availability and optimize the translation of product range + material specifications to a seasonal testing plan

- Build and maintain partnerships with third party testing agencies to ensure on-time results and to facilitate proper understanding of testing, compliance, and regulatory expectations

- Serve as point of contact to creation teams for product integrity inquiries, and support the education of the wider team as an advocate of quality

Your story
 - Experience: You have 4+ years’ experience in materials quality, materials development, or textile production.

- Technical Expertise: You have extensive knowledge of textile fibers, production processes (including spinning, weaving, knitting, dyeing, and finishing), as well as a very strong understanding of standard test methods for quality testing. Trims and hard goods experience is a plus.

- Analytical Mindset: You are able to extract meaning and draw parallels from large datasets. You can extrapolate patterns to determine the best course of action in pursuit of premium quality.

- Communication: You have excellent verbal and written communication skills to collaborate with internal and external partners globally. You can present complex information effectively to audiences with minimal technical background.

- Organizational Skills: You are detail-oriented with the ability to manage and execute multiple short-term and long-term projects simultaneously.

- Global Exposure: Experience with global material sourcing and development, including travel to key manufacturing hubs, trade fairs, and global sourcing offices is a plus.

- Fluent in English (written and spoken).

Meet the team
 We’re responsible for creating innovative products for On. We have a vital responsibility to meet the needs and demands of our runners and new customers. So we research, design, develop and test lots of ideas scientifically and aesthetically. Only products that pass our rigorous testing standards ever go to market.

What we offer
 On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

jobs.title: Senior Specialist - Tooling Engineer
jobs.description:
This role will act as the leader and main point of contact when it comes to the bottom unit in the footwear development process. As a Footwear Tooling engineer, you will work in close collaboration with designers, developers and out sourcing hub in Asia to provide a smooth and effective transition from the concept creation, to prototyping and through to production. You will also be working closely with our Innovation and Sport engineering teams to help validate and bring high performance products and technologies to market.

• Provide Footwear technical designs constraints and solutions, material choices and product construction input by using your demonstrated knowledge of material, mold construction and manufacturing methods.

• Act as the bottom unit leader for product across multiples verticals and projects, not only Inline but Innovation as well.

• Analyse and improve product designs for manufacturability and durability by offering solutions and still achieving quality and performance targets. Your skills in 2D-3D modelling will support these goals.

• Use your understanding of cost implementations of individual molding methods as well as actual tooling designs to give recommendations.

• Assist the development product management and design teams with any tooling related questions or issues, in addition of collaborating with our Asian counterparts and supporting moldshops teams.

• Hold a higher education degree in Engineering or Design fields.

• Have 5+ of experience within a engineering role working closely with development and production, preferably in FTW.

• Have experience working with 2D and 3D CAD FIles (Rhinoceros ideally). Experience in Simulation (FEA) as a bonus.

• Have excellent time management skills an the ability to work with multiples deadlines.

• Have technical knowledge in material, manufacturing, and plastic molding. Footwear is a world you know well.

• Have demonstrated expertise in project management, costing, quality, and abilities to provide solutions within complex constraints.

• Fluent in English

You'll be joining our growing team of five Tooling experts, a specialized group at the heart of our global Footwear Engineering team. Here, you will be fueled by a culture of relentless discovery, directly shaping the future of our products.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Designazione delle merci

Questo ruolo fungerà da leader e principale punto di contatto quando si tratta di unità inferiore nel processo di sviluppo calzaturiero. Come ingegnere Footwear Tooling, lavorerai in stretta collaborazione con designer, sviluppatori e fuori hub di approvvigionamento in Asia per fornire una transizione agevole ed efficace dalla creazione del concetto, alla prototipazione e fino alla produzione. Lavorerai anche a stretto contatto con i nostri team di ingegneria Innovazione e Sport per aiutare a convalidare e portare prodotti e tecnologie ad alte prestazioni sul mercato.

Responsabilità

- Fornire alle calzature vincoli e soluzioni tecniche, scelte materiali e input di costruzione dei prodotti utilizzando la vostra conoscenza dimostrata di materiali, costruzione di stampi e metodi di produzione. - Agire come il leader di base per i prodotti attraverso multipli verticali e progetti, non solo Inline ma Innovazione pure. - Analizzare e migliorare i progetti di prodotto per la capacità di costruire e durare in vita offrendo soluzioni e ancora raggiungere obiettivi di qualità e prestazioni. Le vostre competenze nella modellazione 2D-3D sosterrà questi obiettivi.

- Utilizzare la comprensione dei costi implementazioni di singoli metodi di stampaggio e progetti di strumenti reali per dare raccomandazioni. - Assistere lo sviluppo di prodotti di gestione e di progettazione team con qualsiasi domanda o problemi correlati strumento, oltre a collaborare con le nostre controparti asiatiche e supportare squadre di stampshop.

Requisiti

- Avere 5+ di esperienza in ambito ingegneristico lavorando a stretto contatto con lo sviluppo e la produzione, preferibilmente in FTW. - Avere esperienza lavorando con i file 2D e 3D CAD (Rhinoceros idealmente). L'esperienza in Simulazione (FEA) come bonus. - Avere eccellenti capacità di gestione del tempo e la capacità di lavorare con scadenze multiple. - Avere conoscenze tecniche in materia di materiali, fabbricazione e stampaggio plastico. Le calzature è un mondo che conosci bene.

- Hanno dimostrato esperienza nella gestione dei progetti, costi, qualità e capacità di fornire soluzioni entro vincoli complessi. - Fluente in inglese

Cosa offriamo

Vi unirete al nostro team di cinque esperti Tooling, un gruppo specializzato al centro del nostro team globale di Footwear Engineering. Qui sarete alimentati da una cultura di scoperta inesorabile, che plasma direttamente il futuro dei nostri prodotti.

Als Footwear Tooling-Ingenieur arbeiten Sie in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Designern, Entwicklern und Outsourcing-Hub in Asien zusammen, um einen reibungslosen und effektiven Übergang von der Konzepterstellung, zum Prototyping und bis zur Produktion zu ermöglichen. Sie werden auch eng mit unseren Innovations- und Sport-Engineering-Teams zusammenarbeiten, um Produkte und Technologien mit hoher Leistung zu validieren und auf den Markt zu bringen.

Zuständigkeiten

- Bereitstellung von Schuhen technische Entwürfe Einschränkungen und Lösungen, Materialwahl und Produktbau Input durch die Verwendung Ihrer nachgewiesenen Kenntnisse über Material, Formenbau und Herstellungsmethoden. - Handeln Sie als die untere Einheit führend für Produkt über mehrere vertikale und Projekte, nicht nur Inline, sondern Innovation sowie. - Analyse und verbessern Sie Produktdesigns für die Herstellungsfähigkeit und Haltbarkeit durch das Angebot von Lösungen und immer noch die Erreichung von Qualität und Leistungszielen. Ihre Fähigkeiten in 2D-3D-Modellierung wird diese Ziele unterstützen.

- Nutzen Sie Ihr Verständnis der Kostenimplementierung einzelner Formgebungsmethoden sowie der tatsächlichen Werkzeugkonstruktionen, um Empfehlungen zu geben. - Helfen Sie dem Entwicklungsproduktmanagement und Designteams bei allen Fragen oder Problemen im Zusammenhang mit Werkzeugen, zusätzlich zur Zusammenarbeit mit unseren asiatischen Kollegen und unterstützen Sie die Formshops-Teams.

Anforderungen

- Haben Sie 5+ Erfahrung in einer Engineering-Rolle, die eng mit Entwicklung und Produktion, vorzugsweise in FTW. - Haben Sie Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit 2D und 3D CAD FIles (Rhinoceros ideal). Erfahrung in Simulation (FEA) als Bonus. - Haben Sie ausgezeichnete Zeitmanagement-Fähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, mit Multiples Fristen zu arbeiten. - Haben Sie technische Kenntnisse in Material, Fertigung und Kunststoffformung. Schuhe ist eine Welt, die Sie gut kennen.

- Haben Sie Know-how in Projektmanagement, Kosten, Qualität und Fähigkeiten, Lösungen innerhalb komplexer Einschränkungen bieten demonstriert. - Fluent in Englisch

Was wir anbieten

Sie werden sich unserem wachsenden Team aus fünf Tooling-Experten anschließen, einer spezialisierten Gruppe im Herzen unseres globalen Footwear Engineering-Teams. Hier werden Sie von einer Kultur der unerbittlichen Entdeckung angetrieben, die die Zukunft unserer Produkte direkt prägt.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Désignation des marchandises

En tant qu'ingénieur en outillage de chaussures, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les concepteurs, les développeurs et le centre d'externalisation en Asie pour assurer une transition harmonieuse et efficace de la création de concept, au prototypage et à la production. Vous travaillerez également en étroite collaboration avec nos équipes d'ingénierie Innovation et Sport afin de valider et de commercialiser des produits et technologies de haute performance.

Responsabilités

- Offrez des contraintes et des solutions techniques pour les modèles de chaussures, des choix de matériaux et des intrants de construction de produits en utilisant vos connaissances démontrées des matériaux, de la construction de moules et des méthodes de fabrication. - Agissez comme leader de l'unité inférieure pour les produits sur plusieurs verticales et projets, non seulement en ligne mais aussi en innovation. - Analysez et améliorez les conceptions de produits pour la fabrication et la durabilité en offrant des solutions et en atteignant des objectifs de qualité et de performance.

- Utilisez votre compréhension des coûts de mise en œuvre des méthodes de moulage individuelles ainsi que des conceptions d'outillage réelles pour donner des recommandations. - Aider les équipes de gestion de produits de développement et de conception avec toutes les questions ou problèmes liés à l'outillage, en plus de collaborer avec nos homologues asiatiques et d'appuyer les équipes de moulage.

Besoins

- Avoir une expérience de 5+ d'expérience dans un rôle d'ingénierie en étroite collaboration avec le développement et la production, de préférence en FTW. - Avoir une expérience de travail avec les FILES CAD 2D et 3D (Rhinoceros idéalement). Expérience en simulation (FEA) en bonus. - Avoir d'excellentes compétences en gestion du temps et la capacité de travailler avec les délais de plusieurs. - Avoir des connaissances techniques en matière de matériaux, de fabrication et de moulage plastique.

- Avoir fait preuve d'une expertise en gestion de projet, en établissement des coûts, en qualité et en capacité de fournir des solutions dans des limites complexes.

Ce que nous offrons

Vous vous joindrez à notre équipe grandissante de cinq experts en outillage, un groupe spécialisé au cœur de notre équipe mondiale de la technologie de la chaussure. Ici, vous serez alimenté par une culture de découverte incessante, façonnant directement l'avenir de nos produits.

jobs.description:
At a Glance

We are looking for a Senior Specialist to join our Product Talent Acquisition team. You will be a hands-on contributor focused on delivering key Product Creation hires, collaborating closely with hiring managers and the broader TA team to build efficient, high-quality hiring processes. You bring strong sourcing and stakeholder management skills, and a deep commitment to candidate experience and excellent outcomes.

Your Mission

• Manage full-cycle recruitment processes for Apparel and Accessories Product Creation roles

• Partner with Apparel and Accessories Product Creation leaders to understand hiring needs, align on role profiles, and develop search strategies

• Drive sourcing, screening, stakeholder communication, and offer management with a focus on quality and clarity

• Collaborate with recruiting coordination and TA operations to ensure smooth and professional candidate experiences

• Use data and insights to support hiring decisions and improve search effectiveness

• Support broader TA initiatives such as tooling, processes, and employer branding as needed

Your Story

• You bring extensive experience in Talent Acquisition with a focus on Product roles within fast-paced and international environments.

• Background in consumer goods companies or creative industries is highly preferred

• You have a proven track record of hiring across a range of disciplines within Product Creation

• A keen awareness of global and cultural trends that shape the world of brands

• You are confident partnering with hiring managers, providing market insights and clear recommendations

• You are proactive and hands-on with sourcing, skilled in tools like LinkedIn Recruiter and ATS platforms (Greenhouse, Workday, etc.)

• You are passionate about delivering an excellent candidate experience and representing the brand professionally

• You thrive in collaborative, fast-moving environments and handle multiple priorities effectively

• Background in consumer goods companies, Luxury or creative industries is highly preferred

Your Team:

Being part of the talent team at On means consistently questioning the status quo. We don’t do things just because they are what “HR does”. We build, grow, enable, and empower the team to drive the future of On. Because this is what matters to us. Because we are On.

descriptionByLocale.it:
A una lancia

Cerchiamo un Senior Specialist per entrare nel nostro team di acquisizione di prodotti. Sarete un collaboratore pratico focalizzato sulla fornitura di noli di creazione di prodotti chiave, collaborando strettamente con i responsabili del noleggio e il team più ampio TA per costruire processi di assunzione efficienti e di alta qualità. Porterete forti capacità di approvvigionamento e gestione degli stakeholder, e un profondo impegno per l'esperienza dei candidati e risultati eccellenti.

La tua missione

- Gestire processi di reclutamento a ciclo pieno per ruoli di creazione di prodotti per il settore Electric e il settore del settore del trasporto aereo

- Partner con i leader della creazione di prodotti di Rarel e di Accessori per comprendere le esigenze di assunzione, allineare i profili dei ruoli e sviluppare strategie di ricerca

- Guidare l'approvvigionamento, lo screening, la comunicazione degli stakeholder e offrire la gestione con un focus sulla qualità e la chiarezza

- Dilagando con il reclutamento di coordinamento e operazioni di TA per garantire esperienze fluide e professionali candidati

- Utilizzare dati e approfondimenti per supportare le decisioni di assunzione e migliorare l'efficacia della ricerca

- Sostenere iniziative più ampie di AT come strumenti, processi e marchi di imprese, se necessario

La tua storia

- Portate una vasta esperienza in Acquisizione di un prodotto con un focus sui ruoli del prodotto in ambienti veloci e internazionali.

- Le imprese di beni di consumo o le industrie creative sono altamente preferite

- Hai un curriculum di assunzione in una serie di discipline all'interno della creazione del prodotto

- Una profonda consapevolezza delle tendenze globali e culturali che plasmano il mondo dei marchi

- Siete fiduciosi partner con i manager di assunzione, fornendo informazioni di mercato e chiare raccomandazioni

- Sei proattivo e pratico con approvvigionamento, esperto in strumenti come LinkedIn Recruiter e piattaforme ATS (Greenhouse, Workday, ecc.)

- Sei appassionato di offrire un'eccellente esperienza candidato e rappresentare il marchio professionalmente

- Si prospera in ambienti collaborativi e in rapida evoluzione e gestire in modo efficace più priorità

jobs.title: Senior Specialist - Sports Science
jobs.description:
In short
 Sports Science is the engine of innovation at On. You will design and carry out high impact research, in the field and in the lab, to define the next frontier of performance footwear. Bridging the gap between science and performance, you’ll collaborate with interdisciplinary teams of developers, designers, PMs, and engineers to translate biomechanical insights into groundbreaking product advancements. Your mission is to elevate athlete performance and craft unique consumer experiences by pushing the boundaries of sports science.
As a Sr Specialist, you will report to the Senior Lead of Sports Science on the Sports Science team.

Your mission
 - Pioneer the Scientific Frontier: Architect and spearhead high-impact, proprietary research to engineer the next breakthroughs in footwear technology. You are responsible for deconstructing complex physiological and biomechanical phenomena into advanced experimental frameworks that redefine the absolute limits of human performance.

- Command Evidence-Based Innovation: Serve as the authoritative scientific bridge, distilling high-level biomechanical data into disruptive product features. You will direct design and development teams with elite-level technical insights, providing the scientific mandate required to execute bold, industry-leading performance innovations.

- Validate Global Product Standards: Orchestrate a rigorous scientific audit of the innovation lifecycle, benchmarking interdisciplinary outputs against elite performance metrics. You will hold the final authority at key development milestones, delivering the data-backed "green light" that ensures every product creates a revolutionary, evidence-verified athlete experience.

Your story
 - PhD in Sports Science, Kinesiology or Mechanical Engineering focused on Biomechanics
- 3+ years of progressive working experience in sports science and/or engineering environment, preferably related to footwear
- Experience developing and executing rigorous testing methodologies within agile environments
- Expertise in biomechanical research tools including motion capture, force plates, IMU’s, and metabolic analyzers with a strong understanding of applications to athlete performance
- Proficiency in Python, MATLAB and Visual3D and other relevant software
- Entrepreneurial mindset and ability to work independently as well as part of a team
- Excellent time management, prioritization skills and ability to balance short-term tasks with long-term goals
- Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills
- Action orientated through execution with a continued growth mindset
- Fluent in English (written and spoken).

Meet the team
 The Sports Science Lab (SSL) is an innovative team working to convert cutting-edge theories into exceptional performance products. Our team consists of a great mix of different backgrounds and experiences which blend into a lively, high-energy environment. We’re quick to support each other on research projects as we strive to execute high-impact research. By bridging the gap between controlled laboratory data and real-world athletic performance, we ensure that every insight we uncover leads to a measurable advantage on the field.

What we offer
 On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
In short
 Sports Science is the engine of innovation at On. You will design and carry out high impact research, in the field and in the lab, to define the next frontier of performance footwear. Bridging the gap between science and performance, you’ll collaborate with interdisciplinary teams of developers, designers, PMs, and engineers to translate biomechanical insights into groundbreaking product advancements. Your mission is to elevate athlete performance and craft unique consumer experiences by pushing the boundaries of sports science.
As a Sr Specialist, you will report to the Senior Lead of Sports Science on the Sports Science team.

Your mission
 - Pioneer the Scientific Frontier: Architect and spearhead high-impact, proprietary research to engineer the next breakthroughs in footwear technology. You are responsible for deconstructing complex physiological and biomechanical phenomena into advanced experimental frameworks that redefine the absolute limits of human performance.

- Command Evidence-Based Innovation: Serve as the authoritative scientific bridge, distilling high-level biomechanical data into disruptive product features. You will direct design and development teams with elite-level technical insights, providing the scientific mandate required to execute bold, industry-leading performance innovations.

- Validate Global Product Standards: Orchestrate a rigorous scientific audit of the innovation lifecycle, benchmarking interdisciplinary outputs against elite performance metrics. You will hold the final authority at key development milestones, delivering the data-backed "green light" that ensures every product creates a revolutionary, evidence-verified athlete experience.

Your story
 - PhD in Sports Science, Kinesiology or Mechanical Engineering focused on Biomechanics
- 3+ years of progressive working experience in sports science and/or engineering environment, preferably related to footwear
- Experience developing and executing rigorous testing methodologies within agile environments
- Expertise in biomechanical research tools including motion capture, force plates, IMU’s, and metabolic analyzers with a strong understanding of applications to athlete performance
- Proficiency in Python, MATLAB and Visual3D and other relevant software
- Entrepreneurial mindset and ability to work independently as well as part of a team
- Excellent time management, prioritization skills and ability to balance short-term tasks with long-term goals
- Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills
- Action orientated through execution with a continued growth mindset
- Fluent in English (written and spoken).

Meet the team
 The Sports Science Lab (SSL) is an innovative team working to convert cutting-edge theories into exceptional performance products. Our team consists of a great mix of different backgrounds and experiences which blend into a lively, high-energy environment. We’re quick to support each other on research projects as we strive to execute high-impact research. By bridging the gap between controlled laboratory data and real-world athletic performance, we ensure that every insight we uncover leads to a measurable advantage on the field.

jobs.title: Senior Specialist - SMU Designer FTW
jobs.description:
In short
 This role will be rooted within our CMD SMU (Special Make-Up) design team, with a strong interdisciplinary collaboration alongside Product Design, Innovation, Color, Materials, and the respective Product Management team. You will be responsible for driving ON’s seasonal CMD SMU projects from a creative and strategic perspective, ensuring our collections are getting developed according to our future business needs while simultaneously weaving in the desires of our retail partners, distributors, and target markets.
The spectrum of partnerships and coinciding product is vast and versatile in this role; requiring a sharp eye for modern trends, a significant global / cultural understanding, an open-mind aesthetically and a design practice that brings a unique perspective to the development of our collections. You navigate with ease in either macro or micro trend environments and have the ability to understand markets, regions and communities you will closely work with. Additionally, you are a strong technical team player who can evolve in an ever-changing, fast-paced environment that requires the balancing of hyper-creative tasks with administrative-design duties.

Your mission
 - Focus on Collaboration: Focusing on both our account-focused and inline collections, you easily collaborate with multiple counterparts in different teams (Product Managers, Merchandisers, Developers, Strategizers, etc.)
- Analyze Consumer Behavior: Analyze consumer behavior, market trends, and lifestyle shifts to identify opportunities for innovative color and material directions.
- Translate Consumer Insights: Translate consumer insights into seasonal color / material stories, and design narratives that resonate with target audiences.
- Monitor Global Trends: Monitor global fashion, sport, culture, and retail trends to anticipate emerging consumer preferences and influence future product strategies.
- Balance Creativity and Commercial Viability: Use qualitative and quantitative insights to balance consumer desirability, brand identity, innovation, and commercial viability.
- Present Design Recommendations: Present consumer-driven design recommendations supported by research, storytelling, and visual communication.
- Champion a Consumer-First Mindset: Champion a consumer-first mindset throughout the product creation process, ensuring color and material decisions enhance both performance and emotional connection.
- Design into Briefs: Designing into briefs, interpreting feedback, and creating whatever appropriate amount of ideations might suit the task, whilst showcasing how ideas can live within all ends of the spectrum; ranging from relevant-and-commercial to energetic-and-forward-thinking.
- Communicate Design Decisions: Being able to verbally talk-through your ideas with a strong emphasis on WHY you followed certain paths and made specific design decisions.
- Collaborate Across CMD: Collaborating closely with the greater CMD team on defining signature executions that will bond our head-to-toe collections together.
- Drive Material Innovation: Proactively scouring the landscape for the latest print, material, finish and colouring technologies that will challenge our product, brand and industry.
- Partner with R&D: In collaboration with our R&D material specialists, making sure that only materials which both fulfill all functionality and sustainability criteria are selected for projects you lead — all the while, pushing to establish what pinnacle expression through materilization could be for us in the future.
- Own Projects: Owning projects from conversations and concepts all the way through to techpacks and final delivery, by collaborating hand-in-hand with both our Zurich based development team and overseas partners.
- Strengthen Industry Knowledge: Increase our industry knowledge by attending key retailer sell-in meetings, tradeshows, brick-and-mortar stores, regional markets and partnering with our internal teams on consumer insights.
- Support Development: Overseeing developmental duties including but not limited to color cad techpacks, material map creation, shell pattern alterations and graphic / artwork adjustments.

Your story
 - Education & Experience: You have completed a Bachelor or Masters degree in Textile Design, Industrial / Product Design, Graphic Design or any other related field.
- CMD Experience: You bring 5+ years of working experience in the CMD segment within the apparel, accessories, or footwear segment.
- Portfolio: You bring a strong portfolio with proven experience working on everything ranging from engineered materials, trims, dyeing techniques to prints.
- Industry Knowledge: You bring a great knowledge of key retailers within the lifestyle footwear landscape.
- Operational Excellence: You have strong organizational skills, the ability to manage complex projects whilst sticking to critical timelines and deadlines - at the same time working on overlapping seasons and projects without losing or diluting the overview and vision.
- Entrepreneurial Mindset: You have an entrepreneurial attitude, ambition and willingness to take on challenges.
- Communication & Leadership: You are a strong communicator with proven experience presenting projects to a wider team of decision makers and adapting given the needs of different audiences.
- Technical Proficiency: Excellent 2D software skills in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, etc. Experience in rendering programs are a plus. - Fluent in English, written and spoken, any other language would be a plus.

Meet the team
 You will be working with ON’s highly creative CMD team, driven by innovation, performance, sustainability and collaboration. You will be rooted in our design team which includes fellow CMD, Footwear, Apparel, and Accessory Designers who all closely collaborate alongside our Developers, Product Managers, Innovation and GTM teams.

What we offer
 On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

titleByLocale.en: Senior Specialist - Operational Excellence Strategy & Transformation

titleByLocale.de: Senior Spezialist - Operational Excellence Strategy & Transformation

jobs.description:
In short
 You will play an important role in helping On evolve how products are developed and brought to market. In this role, you will contribute to strategic initiatives and cross-functional projects that support On's long-term business priorities. Working closely with teams across the product organization, you will help improve processes, capabilities and ways of working that enable greater speed, effectiveness and quality across Footwear, Apparel and Accessories.

The Senior Specialist role will report to the Head of Strategy & Transformation - Operational Excellence.

Your mission
 - Apply a strategic and analytical lens to problem-solving: Support the structuring of complex and often ambiguous business challenges. Break down problems into key questions, conduct analyses, synthesize findings and help identify practical recommendations that support On's strategic objectives.
- Drive strategic initiatives and project work streams: Own and drive specific workstreams within cross-functional projects that support the evolution of the product organization’s processes, capabilities, technologies and ways of working. Help ensure projects are delivered with a high level of quality, rigor and stakeholder alignment.
- Support cross-functional collaboration: Partner closely with stakeholders across innovation, product strategy, design, product development, sourcing, planning, commercial, and other functions. Help facilitate discussions, align perspectives and contribute to solutions that improve organizational effectiveness.
- Contribute to key LRP priorities: Support the delivery of strategic initiatives that are critical to On's Long Range Plan (LRP), working across Footwear, Apparel and Accessories to help drive scalable and sustainable business impact.
- Develop insights and recommendations: Translate data, analyses and stakeholder inputs into clear insights and recommendations. Create materials and narratives that support decision-making and help move initiatives forward.
- Drive project governance and execution: Help establish transparency across projects through structured planning, milestone tracking, risk management and stakeholder communication, ensuring initiatives remain on track and aligned with business objectives.

Your story
 - 5+ years of experience in product strategy, operational excellence, business transformation, consulting or related fields.
- Master's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Innovation Management, or a related field.
- Footwear and/or apparel industry experience and/or experience in a strategy or consulting environment is a must.
- Experience contributing to cross-functional projects involving multiple stakeholders and business functions.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure complex topics and derive actionable insights.
- Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build productive working relationships across teams.
- Comfortable working across a variety of topics, including process improvement, operating models, product creation and organizational effectiveness.
- Strong project management and organizational skills, with attention to detail and follow-through.
- Passion for understanding and supporting On's vision and long-term business objectives.
- Fluent in English, both spoken and written.

Meet the team
 The Operational Excellence team is part of the product organization: an entrepreneurial, dynamic and talented group focused on evolving the product organization (innovation, product strategy, design, development, sourcing) to new levels of effectiveness and performance.

Working closely with teams across the product organization, you will help improve processes, capabilities and ways of working that enable greater speed, effectiveness and quality across Footwear, Apparel and Accessories.

The Senior Specialist role will report to the Head of Strategy & Transformation - Operational Excellence.

Your mission
 - Apply a strategic and analytical lens to problem-solving: Support the structuring of complex and often ambiguous business challenges. Break down problems into key questions, conduct analyses, synthesize findings and help identify practical recommendations that support On's strategic objectives.
- Drive strategic initiatives and project work streams: Own and drive specific workstreams within cross-functional projects that support the evolution of the product organization’s processes, capabilities, technologies and ways of working. Help ensure projects are delivered with a high level of quality, rigor and stakeholder alignment.
- Support cross-functional collaboration: Partner closely with stakeholders across innovation, product strategy, design, product development, sourcing, planning, commercial, and other functions. Help facilitate discussions, align perspectives and contribute to solutions that improve organizational effectiveness.
- Contribute to key LRP priorities: Support the delivery of strategic initiatives that are critical to On's Long Range Plan (LRP), working across Footwear, Apparel and Accessories to help drive scalable and sustainable business impact.
- Develop insights and recommendations: Translate data, analyses and stakeholder inputs into clear insights and recommendations. Create materials and narratives that support decision-making and help move initiatives forward.
- Drive project governance and execution: Help establish transparency across projects through structured planning, milestone tracking, risk management and stakeholder communication, ensuring initiatives remain on track and aligned with business objectives.

Your story
 - 5+ years of experience in product strategy, operational excellence, business transformation, consulting or related fields.
- Master's degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Innovation Management, or a related field.
- Footwear and/or apparel industry experience and/or experience in a strategy or consulting environment is a must.
- Experience contributing to cross-functional projects involving multiple stakeholders and business functions.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure complex topics and derive actionable insights.
- Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build productive working relationships across teams.

jobs.title: Senior Specialist - New Store Openings Project Manager, DMS

titleByLocale.en: Senior Specialist - New Store Openings Project Manager, DMS
titleByLocale.it: Senior Specialista - New Store Openings Project Manager, DMS
titleByLocale.de: Senior Spezialist - New Store Openings Project Manager, DMS
titleByLocale.fr: Senior Spécialiste - New Store Openings Project Manager, DMS

jobs.description:
In short
 We are looking for a Retail Project Manager to drive the new store opening process for our partners-led Retail stores globally. In this role, you will elevate the new store opening process by leading new store openings project management and driving seamless execution. You will play a key role in ensuring smooth store launches while fostering strong collaboration with cross-functional teams.

Your mission
 - Drive project management for new retail store openings worldwide, ensuring seamless collaboration across internal cross-functional teams (e.g., Visual Merchandising, Marketing, Construction and Regions) and external distributor partners to deliver successful store launches.
- Ensure all elements of store readiness are executed to deliver a premium customer experience from day one on (e.g. training, merchandising, operational setup...).
- Act as the single point of contact for the global retail team and senior leadership throughout the new store opening process for partner-led stores
- Develop and maintain project documentation, including timelines, risk assessments, and contingency plans to ensure transparency and accountability across all stakeholders.
- Gather, organize and share project learnings with project stakeholders.
- Participate in site analysis and support the development of comprehensive project briefs.

Your story
 - You have 5+ years of relevant work experience in a similar role working with distributor partners, previous experience in premium retail and/ or the sports industry is a plus.
You have strong experience in project management from start to finish coordinating cross-functional teams.
- You have an entrepreneurial growth mindset, eager to challenge the status quo with an appetite for relentless improvement.
- You have a deep understanding of Retail and Operational Excellence and can effectively advocate for it across diverse stakeholder groups.
- You are curious to work globally across different cultures.
- You have excellent communication and collaboration skills and are thriving in a dynamic and complex environment with the ability to work autonomously.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.

Meet the team
 Join one of the world’s fastest-growing sportswear brands and help shape the future of On’s retail presence. We’re not just opening stores — we’re redefining the retail experience. If you’re passionate about Retail Strategy, motivated by impact, and thrive on turning insights into strategic action, this is your opportunity to drive meaningful growth in a global environment.

Home base: Zurich, travelling to new store locations during preparation/ opening phase may be required

jobs.title: Senior Specialist - Innovation Footwear Developer
jobs.description:
In short
 The Innovation Footwear Developer will collaborate with product teams to shape the future of On's product line, by translating footwear innovation work into advanced footwear products and by creating future technologies that will define the brand. This role is responsible for leading the development of future-oriented concepts within the R&D organization.

Your mission
 - Manage and execute the creation of innovative product concepts from conception to completion, overseeing technology development, sample creation and assembly, as well as the development of uppers, toolings, technologies, and molds.
- Management of multiple high-impact innovation projects with complete autonomy and ownership. Strategic planning and aligning with company goals.
- Engage in complex problem-solving, tackling challenges related to product intricacies, process optimization, efficiency enhancement, model making and the enablement of scalable manufacturing practices.
- Ensure seamless communication and collaboration by acting as a bridge between designers, conceptual footwear innovators, model makers, pattern engineers, technology partners and other stakeholders. Ensure that scalability is carefully considered for every project.
- Work closely with the Sport Science, Innovation Design, Footwear Engineering, and Innovation Material Science teams to create an environment of interdisciplinary collaboration and drive the development of innovative prototypes.
- Create and update the transfer Manual, by meticulously documenting processes, including key data, design images, and detailed product/process descriptions to ensure it remains a comprehensive and user-friendly resource for successful technical knowledge transfer.
- Forge strong connections with our development teams in Asia, actively participating in the assurance of successful information transfer strategies, and fostering a collaborative cross-border working relationship.
- Demonstrate expertise in fabricating and assembling materials and components, utilizing a diverse array of machinery and hand tools. This includes, but is not limited to, proficiency in cutting, injecting, sanding, buffing, sewing, welding, pressing, and lasting processes.

Your story
 - 5+ years of footwear-specific experience.
- Experience with footwear innovation projects.
- Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or another relevant field preferred.
- 3+ years of experience in traditional footwear manufacturing processes - injecting, cutting, sewing, welding, machining, laser cutting, construction, and prototyping among others.
- Ability to identify design issues and offer solutions to improve functionality and manufacturability of products.
- Demonstrated knowledge of material testing and methodology, comfortable working with chemistry/chemical processes for materials creation - not limited to: textiles, foam polymers, solvents, chemicals, polyurethane, superfoams, EVA, among others.
- Proven ability to lead the scaling, costing, and testing of manufacturing processes and concepts while introducing new technologies to the market.
- Excellent communication skills and comfort adapting communication style between engineers, designers, product experts and cross-functional non-product creation partners.
- Ability to work independently under a deadline on several projects simultaneously requiring both innovative ideas and engineering problem-solving.
- Exemplify a high tolerance for ambiguity and solution-focused attitude.
- Comfortable working with industrial machinery.
- Availability to travel up to 15% of the time.

Meet the team
 On’s Innovation team is responsible for On’s future innovation, out-of-the-box thinking and the outstanding athlete-informed technology that differentiates On footwear from all other footwear products in the market. If you are interested in being a part of an agile and interdisciplinary team of experts in the area of engineering and sports sciences, come join us!

What we offer
 On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

jobs.title: Senior Specialist - Innovation Concept Design
jobs.description:
In short
 The Innovation Concept Designer drives the creation of future-defining concepts, technologies, and products for elite athletes while accelerating On’s sustainability goals. Fueled by curiosity and a desire to challenge convention, you will envision and shape the industry through game-changing innovation. As part of a multidisciplinary team, you will push the boundaries of performance, leading the end-to-end concept creation process to craft the future of On’s footwear and product ecosystem.

Your mission
 - Be a key player of the Innovation Design Studio and push the boundaries of On’s pinnacle design- and technology platforms
- Own your projects from bold visions through to successful implementation and tangible prototypes
- Collaborate closely with On’s sport-science teams to elevate data driven footwear design and innovation
- Leverage your progressive 2D and 3D design approach to co-create and co-define On’s design vision
- Co-develop advanced prototyping workflows and leverage digital creation and AI tools to bring groundbreaking concepts to life
- Collaborate with our Zurich- and Vietnam based development teams on crafting best in class performance-driven products.
- You will collaborate with and travel to Vietnam and Europe based development centres

Your story
 - You hold a bachelor or master’s degree in product/industrial design and/or design engineering
- 5+ years of experience working on global innovation teams delivering groundbreaking solutions designed for performance. Automation and robotics knowledge is a plus.
- Curious and entrepreneurial mind with the passion for pushing the boundaries of design and innovation
- Analytic approach – ability to break down complex problems, excellent communication and presentation skills
- Strong data driven design approach that translates into highly functional solutions
- Deep knowledge in advanced materials and digital manufacturing processes, eager to experiment and pioneer new technologies
- Excellent 3D and prototyping skills, computational design knowledge is a plus
- Strong visualisation skills and AI fluency, always exploring the latest tools and effectively embedding them into your creative process.
- You thrive in cross-functional teams of world class experts, collaboratively engaging in creative problem solving.
- Fluent in English both written and spoken

Meet the team
 You will work alongside the broader Innovation team consisting of passionate experts, developers and engineers across different disciplines, designing and developing the most advanced products and technologies at On. We deliver breakthrough Innovation and Design by leveraging state of the art manufacturing technologies and computational design tools. This team is specifically tasked with designing and developing the most exciting long-term innovation solutions into high level product concepts that are driven by Athlete Performance and Sustainability goals. To be truly disruptive in this space, this team rethinks the ways our products are made from the ground up and seamlessly integrates design and technology to unlock new opportunities.

What we offer
 On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

jobs.title: Senior Specialist - Group CAPEX
jobs.description:
In Short:

Are you the hands-on finance enthusiast we are seeking? We are looking for a process-oriented and numbers-driven team player to take ownership of our group-wide CAPEX. You will act as the financial architect of our global expansion, working at the intersection of Controlling, Retail, and Office Expansion teams. With your proven experience in accounting and a high affinity for modern cloud-based tools, you will take our CAPEX accounting to the next level.

Your Mission:

• Financial Integrity PPE: Act as the subject matter expert for the lifecycle of all fixed assets. This includes determining initial recognition, identifying subsequent expenditures that should be capitalized vs. expensed, and managing complex depreciation models and impairment testing.

• Financial Integrity IFRS 16: Lead the accounting for the global lease portfolio. This involves ensuring the accurate calculation of Right-of-Use assets and lease liabilities, managing lease modifications (extensions, terminations, or rent concessions), and ensuring all disclosures meet the latest IFRS standards.

• Operational Excellence: Oversee daily operations, including additions, disposals, depreciation, and re-measurements.

• Global Connectivity: Act as the primary contact for all CAPEX-related requests, bridging the gap between global standards and local needs.

• External Partner Management & Mentorship: Act as the primary point of oversight and quality control for our outsourced accounting provider. You will be responsible for reviewing their deliverables, and mentoring their team members to ensure alignment with our global standards and quality requirements.

• Reporting & Compliance: Ensure accurate disclosure in our consolidated IFRS Financial Statements and oversee internal SOX controls.

• Process Innovation: Actively challenge and automate global processes using our digital toolkit.

• Strategic Documentation: Create and maintain robust process documentation and user guidance to support a scaling organization.

Your Story:

• Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Accounting and Finance.

• Experience: 4+ years of practical experience within a large-scale or international corporate environment with a focus on IFRS and preferably CAPEX.

• Knowledge: Solid understanding of IFRS, with specific, hands-on experience in IAS 16 and IFRS 16. You should be comfortable navigating complex lease contracts and determining the correct accounting treatment for diverse global asset classes in autonomy.

• Effective Communication: Ability to navigate a matrix organization, effectively communicating complex financial concepts to stakeholders at all levels

• Tech Savvy: You are a power user of MS Excel and Google Workspace. Experience with Dynamics 365 is a plus.

• Modern Toolkit: Familiarity with tools that drive automation and leverage AI to optimize financial workflows.

• Mindset: A hands-on mentality with the ability to adapt to a constantly changing environment.

• Soft Skills: Exceptional analytical skills and business proficiency in English.

Meet The Team:

Join an international finance team that acts as both the backbone and the advanced navigator of our speedboat. We constantly challenge the status quo to handle rapid growth. We shape tomorrow’s best practices by thinking differently, acting cross-functionally, and leveraging a cutting-edge tech stack.

What We Offer:

A dynamic environment ranked as a "fastest-growing sports company" where your work directly impacts our global footprint. A culture that fosters excellence and potential. This role offers deep exposure to strategic planning and technical knowledge growth. The chance to build something incredible with a collaborative, high-energy global community where you can truly thrive.

If you are driven to bring On to the next level, curious about the opportunity and want to be part of our growing team send us your application, and join the ONiverse!

descriptionByLocale.it:
Designazione delle merci

In breve: Sei l'appassionato di finanza pratica che stiamo cercando? Stiamo cercando un giocatore di squadra orientato ai processi e guidato dai numeri per prendere la proprietà del nostro CAPEX gruppo-wide. Tu agirai come architetto finanziario della nostra espansione globale, lavorando all'incrocio di squadre di controllo, retail, e espansione di ufficio. Con la tua esperienza comprovata in contabilità e un'alta affinità per i moderni strumenti basati sul cloud, porterai la nostra contabilità CAPEX al livello successivo.

La tua missione: - PPE Integrità Finanziaria: Act as the subject matter expert for the lifecy of all fixed assets. Ciò include determinare il riconoscimento iniziale, identificare le spese successive che dovrebbero essere capitalizzate contro spese e gestire modelli di ammortamento complessi e test di riduzione di valore. - Integrità Finanziaria IFRS 16: Guidare la contabilizzazione per il portafoglio di leasing globale.

Ciò comporta il calcolo accurato delle attività e delle passività in leasing per il diritto d'uso, la gestione delle modifiche del leasing (estensione, terminazioni o concessioni di locazione), e la garanzia che tutte le informazioni siano conformi agli ultimi standard IFRS. - Eccellenza operativa: superare le operazioni quotidiane, comprese aggiunte, cessioni, ammortamenti e rimisurazioni. - Connettività globale: agire come contatto primario per tutte le richieste relative a CAPEX, colmare il divario tra gli standard globali e le esigenze locali.

- Gestione e Mentora dei partner esterni: agire come punto primario di controllo e controllo della qualità per il nostro fornitore di contabilità esternalizzato. Sarà responsabile della revisione dei risultati e dell'AEVOLUZIONE dei membri del team per garantire l'allineamento ai nostri standard e requisiti di qualità globali. - Reporting & Compliance: garantire una corretta divulgazione nel nostro bilancio consolidato IFRS e supervisionare i controlli interni SOX. - Innovazione di processo: sfidare attivamente e automatizzare i processi globali utilizzando il nostro toolkit digitale.

- Documentazione strategica: creare e mantenere robusta documentazione di processo e guida dell'utente per supportare un'organizzazione di scala.

La tua storia: - Formazione: Bachelor.s o Master.s laurea in Contabilità e Finanza. - Esperienza: 4+ anni di esperienza pratica in un contesto aziendale su larga scala o internazionale con un focus sugli IFRS e preferibilmente CAPEX. - Conoscenza: Solida comprensione degli IFRS, con specifica esperienza pratica negli IAS 16 e 16. Dovresti essere a tuo agio navigando in contratti di leasing complessi e determinando il corretto trattamento contabile per diverse classi di attività globali in autonomia.

- Comunicazione efficace: Capacità di navigare in un'organizzazione matrice, comunicando efficacemente concetti finanziari complessi agli stakeholder a tutti i livelli. - Tech Savvy: Sei un utente potente di MS Excel e Google Workspace. L'esperienza con Dynamics 365 è un plus. - Toolkit moderno: Fa 1ster con strumenti che guidano l'automazione e sfruttano l'AI per ottimizzare i flussi di lavoro finanziari. - Mindset: Una mentalità pratica con la capacità di adattarsi ad un ambiente in continua evoluzione. - Soft Skills: Eccezionali capacità analitiche e competenza aziendale in inglese.

Incontriamo il Team: unisciti a un team di finanza internazionale che funge sia dalla spina dorsale che dal navigatore avanzato del nostro motoscafo. Sfidiamo costantemente lo status quo per gestire una crescita rapida. Formiamo le migliori pratiche domani pensando in modo diverso, agendo in modo cross-funzionale e sfruttando uno stack tecnologico all'avanguardia.

Cosa offriamo: - Un ambiente dinamico classificato come "azienda sportiva in crescita più veloce" dove il vostro lavoro influisce direttamente sulla nostra impronta globale. - Una cultura che promuove l'eccellenza e il potenziale. - Questo ruolo offre una profonda esposizione alla pianificazione strategica e alla crescita delle conoscenze tecniche. - L'opportunità di costruire qualcosa di incredibile con una comunità globale collaborativa e ad alta energia dove si può veramente prosperare.
