Sie sind Senior Director von Apparel Marketing und berichten direkt über die CMO. Ihre Aufgabe ist es, der direkte Markenpartner des Creative Director of Bekleidung zu sein, Teams in ganz On zu begeistern, unsere Kultur zu fördern und als Hüter des Markenportfolios und strategische Ausrichtung von Apparel anerkannt zu werden, um sicherzustellen, dass alle Marketing-Bemühungen in Apparel mit den wichtigsten Prioritäten von Apparel abgestimmt sind, die von der externen globalen Landschaft beeinflusst werden.

- Work Focus: Sie definieren und leiten die funktionsweite Markenstrategie für Apparel und überwachen mehrere komplexe und strategische Initiativen mit einem Schwerpunkt auf Apparel. Diese Rolle erfordert strategisches Know-how auf Unternehmensebene und hat eine kritische, systemische Wirkung während der gesamten Zeit. - Entscheidungsfindung: Sie sind erfahren, wenn Sie Entscheidungen auf hohem Niveau vorantreiben, als Entscheidungsträger für die Apparel Brand Management Funktion agieren und eine Schlüsselrolle in der Geschäftsleitung spielen. - Umfang: Projekte und Initiativen unter Ihrer Leitung haben strategische Auswirkungen auf On,s gesamtes Portfolio und langfristige Ausrichtung.

Sie arbeiten mit der C-Suite, Senior Leadership und sind ein wichtiger Akteur des Management Teams. - Psycholog: Sie besitzen die Apparel Brand Management Disziplin global, definieren Betriebsmodelle und Prioritäten. Sie sind verantwortlich für die Vereinfachung komplexer Organisationssituationen und die Priorisierung kritischer Arbeit im Unternehmen. Sie spielen eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Sicherstellung von Synergien über alle Produktkategorien, Marketingkanäle und Regionen hinweg.

Ihre Mission

Ihre Kernaufgabe ist es, die globale Marke On zu erhöhen, indem Sie die Struktur entwerfen, die Strategie definieren und die Talente führen, die für die Umsetzung unseres Markenversprechens in allen Kategorien erforderlich sind.

Unternehmen Marke setzen Vision & Governance

- Definieren Sie die langfristige, mehrjährige Architektur für die Funktion Markenmanagement Apparel und bestimmen Sie, wie alle Kategorien-Markenführer (einschließlich des Head of Brand, Apparel) ihr Geschäft angehen, um eine einheitliche globale Markenidentität zu gewährleisten. - Ausrichten und sichern Sie Buy-In von der C-Suite und allen regionalen Geschäftsführern auf die übergeordnete Markenstrategie und Ressourcenallokation über große Produktvertikalien hinweg. - Vereinfachen und priorisieren Sie das komplexe Portfolio von Markeninitiativen, um Ressourcen auf die höchsten Wertschöpfungschancen für nachhaltiges Wachstum von On,s zu konzentrieren.

Antriebs-Organisation und Talent Excellence

- Als leitender Organisationsleiter, der das Team von Apparel Brand betreut und leitet, um die Qualität des strategischen Denkens und der Ausführung zu verbessern. Sie werden auch Einfluss und Antrieb nehmen - Erstellen Sie das globale Betriebsmodell für das Management von Apparel Brand, um klare Rollen, Verantwortlichkeiten und Entscheidungsrechte zwischen Produkt-, Marketing- und kommerziellen Teams weltweit zu gewährleisten. - Handeln Sie als primäre Schnittstelle zwischen der Funktion von Apparel Brand und Executive Leadership, indem Sie die Markenstrategie, Leistung und Talentbedürfnisse kommunizieren.

Maßnahme für die systemische Evolution

- Festlegung und Mandat der wichtigsten Leistungsindikatoren (KPIs) und Metriken (z.B. Markengesundheit, kulturelle Relevanz, Portfoliowert), die in allen Bekleidungskategorien und -regionen zur Messung des Markenerfolgs verwendet werden. - Förderung einer Messkultur, die strategische Veränderungen in Produktinvestitionen, Markteintritt und kommerziellen Prioritäten auf der Führungsebene informiert.

Ihre Geschichte

Sie sind ein anerkannter Führungspersönlichkeitsführer mit einer Erfolgsbilanz des Wachstums und der Veränderung im globalen Maßstab. Sie besitzen die intellektuelle Neugier und die nötige Gravitation, um den Status Quo auf den höchsten Ebenen der Organisation herauszufordern und gleichzeitig eine Kultur der hohen Leistung und psychologischen Sicherheit innerhalb Ihres Teams zu fördern.

Sie verstehen sich als Strategen auf Unternehmensebene, die in der Lage sind, Mehrdeutigkeit und Komplexität zu navigieren, um einfache, hochwirksame organisatorische Lösungen zu liefern. Sie sind ein Kultur- und Talentkatalysator, der Führungskräfte inspiriert und die nächste Generation von Führungspositionen entwickelt.

Anforderungen

- 15+ Jahre progressive Führungserfahrung in der globalen Markenführung, Markenstrategie oder gleichwertigen Rollen in der Premium-Sportbekleidung, Mode oder Konsumindustrie. - Mindestens 8+ Jahre in einer leitenden Führungsrolle, Leitung eines Teams von Leitern auf Director-Ebene oder gleichwertigen Führungspositionen und Überwachung eines komplexen, mehrstufigen Markenportfolios. - Demonstration der Fähigkeit, langfristige strategische Pläne (5-Jahreshorizont) zu entwerfen und erfolgreich C-Suite, regionale Präsidenten und funktionsübergreifende SVP/VIII Führungsteams auszurichten.

- Präsenz auf Executive-Ebene und außergewöhnliche Präsentationskompetenzen; komfortable Präsentation von Strategie, Leistung und organisatorischen Empfehlungen vor großen internen und externen Zielgruppen. - Ein hohes Maß an intellektueller Neugier und ein strategischer Geist, ausgeglichen mit der Fähigkeit, einfache, ausführbare Rahmen für globale Teams zu definieren.

Was wir anbieten

- Eine herausfordernde Rolle, die Sie an der Spitze der globalen Expansion und Markenarchitektur von On stellt und einen unvergleichlichen Einfluss auf den langfristigen Erfolg des Unternehmens bietet. - Ein fairer und ausgewogener interner Recruiting-Prozess mit der Möglichkeit, sich über andere Teams, Rollen und Herausforderungen zu informieren.

Wir verpflichten uns, ein faires und integratives Arbeitsumfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Entscheidungen im Zusammenhang mit der Einstellung, dem Aufstieg und der Beibehaltung von Arbeitsplätzen frei von Diskriminierung sind.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez GENCE

Vous êtes le directeur principal de Apparel Marketing, qui fait directement partie de l'OCM. Votre mission est d'être le partenaire direct de la marque du Directeur créatif de l'habillement, d'inspirer les équipes à travers On, de défendre notre culture et d'être reconnu comme un gardien du portefeuille de la marque Apparel et de l'orientation stratégique, assurant tous les efforts de marketing à Apparel s'aligner sur les priorités principales de l'On, influencés par le paysage mondial externe.

- Objectif de travail : Vous définirez et dirigerez la stratégie de marque à l'échelle de la fonction pour Apparel, en supervisant de multiples initiatives complexes et stratégiques axées sur Apparel. Ce rôle exige une expertise stratégique au niveau de l'entreprise et a un impact critique et systémique tout au long de l'initiative. - Prise de décision : Vous avez de l'expérience dans la conduite de décisions de haut niveau, en agissant comme décideur pour la fonction Apparel Brand Management et en jouant un rôle clé dans la prise de décisions de la direction. - Portée : Les projets et les initiatives sous votre direction ont un impact stratégique sur l'ensemble du portefeuille et la direction à long terme.

Vous collaborez avec la C-suite, la direction et êtes un intervenant clé de l'équipe de gestion. - Autonomie : Vous possédez la discipline Apparel Brand Management au niveau mondial, définissant les modèles et les priorités d'exploitation. Vous êtes responsable de simplifier les situations organisationnelles complexes et de prioriser le travail critique dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise.

Votre mission

Votre mission principale est d'élever la marque Global On en architectant la structure, en définissant la stratégie et en dirigeant le talent nécessaire pour exécuter notre promesse de marque dans toutes les catégories.

Définir la vision de marque d'entreprise et la gouvernance

- Définir l'architecture à long terme et pluriannuelle de la fonction Apparel Brand Management, en dictant comment toutes les catégories de marques de premier plan (y compris le chef de marque Apparel) abordent leur entreprise pour assurer une identité de marque mondiale unifiée. - Aligner et sécuriser l'adhésion de la C-suite et de tous les directeurs régionaux sur la stratégie globale de la marque et l'allocation des ressources à travers les grandes verticales de produits. - Simplifier et prioriser le portefeuille complexe des initiatives de marque pour concentrer les ressources sur les opportunités les plus importantes pour la croissance durable On, et en particulier pour les PME.

Favoriser l'excellence organisationnelle et en matière de talents

- Vous serez le chef de file organisationnel principal qui coache, mentore et dirige l'équipe Apparel Brand pour élever la barre sur la pensée stratégique et la qualité d'exécution. Vous influencerez et piloterez également - Architecte le modèle opérationnel mondial pour la gestion Apparel Brand, en assurant des rôles, responsabilités et droits de décision clairs entre les équipes de produits, de marketing et commerciales dans le monde entier. - Agir comme interface principale entre la fonction Apparel Brand et Leadership Executive, en communiquant la stratégie de marque, les performances et les besoins en talents.

Mesure pour l'évolution systémique

- Établir et mandater les indicateurs de rendement clés (ICR) et les mesures (p. ex. santé de la marque, pertinence culturelle, valeur du portefeuille) utilisés dans toutes les catégories de vêtements et dans toutes les régions pour mesurer le succès de la marque. - Favoriser une culture de mesure qui oriente les changements stratégiques dans l'investissement en produits, l'entrée sur le marché et les priorités commerciales au niveau des cadres supérieurs.

Votre histoire

Vous êtes un leader exécutif reconnu avec un bilan de changement et de croissance à l'échelle mondiale. Vous possédez la curiosité intellectuelle et les gravitas nécessaires pour défier le statu quo aux plus hauts niveaux de l'organisation tout en favorisant une culture de haute performance et de sécurité psychologique au sein de votre équipe.

Vous vous voyez comme un stratège d'entreprise capable de naviguer dans l'ambiguïté et la complexité pour fournir des solutions organisationnelles simples et à impact élevé. Vous êtes une Catalyste Culture et Talent qui inspire les dirigeants et développe la prochaine génération de leadership.

Besoins

- 15 ans et plus d'expérience de leadership progressif dans la gestion de marques, la stratégie de marques ou des rôles équivalents dans les secteurs de la mode, de la mode ou de la consommation. - Au moins 8 ans et plus dans un rôle de direction, la gestion d'une équipe de dirigeants de niveau directeur ou d'un groupe équivalent et la supervision d'un portefeuille complexe et multicatégories de marques. - Capacité démontrée d'élaborer des plans stratégiques à long terme (5 ans) et d'aligner avec succès les C-suite, les présidents régionaux et les équipes de leadership interfonctionnelles SVP/EVP.

- Présence au niveau de la direction et compétences exceptionnelles en matière de présentation; présentation confortable de recommandations stratégiques, de performances et organisationnelles devant un public interne et externe important. - Une grande curiosité intellectuelle et un esprit stratégique équilibrés avec la capacité de définir des cadres simples et exécutables pour les équipes mondiales.

Ce que nous offrons

- Un rôle stimulant qui vous place à l'avant-garde de l'expansion mondiale et de l'architecture de la marque d'On, offrant une influence inégalée sur la réussite à long terme de l'entreprise. - Un processus de recrutement interne équitable et équilibré avec une occasion de découvrir d'autres équipes, rôles et défis.

Nous sommes déterminés à créer un milieu de travail équitable et inclusif, où toutes les décisions liées au recrutement, à l'avancement et au maintien en poste sont exemptes de discrimination.

jobs.description:
In short
 In Technology at On, everything we build fuels our mission to ignite the human spirit through movement. We craft technology that improves with every interaction, enhancing the experience for everyone who moves. Delivering Wow through our platforms, apps and services is a core value.
We believe in building solutions that not only function effortlessly but also contribute positively to the world. Our work connects communities and makes movement more enjoyable and accessible for all.
Joining the Tech Leadership team at On, you'll find yourself at the heart of a fast-paced, diverse environment. Our ecosystem thrives on collaboration: a confluence of curious minds challenging and learning from one another, always seeking the uncharted. Here, we venture into new territories of technology, continuously refining our approach and embracing challenges head-on.
Your role will be pivotal in shaping the next generation of intelligence, learning systems, cloud infrastructure, and AI platforms at On, helping create the foundations that power every part of our technology ecosystem.

Your mission
 Strategic & Visionary Leadership :

- Architect and spearhead the engineering vision for On’s core intelligence, learning systems, agent platforms, and cloud infrastructure.
- Drive the technical strategy for building a connected, event-driven ecosystem that acts as the central nervous system of the company, enabling real-time intelligence, autonomous decision support, and agentic workflows across the enterprise.
- Lead high-level architectural decisions that resonate across the organisation, ensuring our technology choices create a compounding competitive advantage and align with On’s long-term strategic vision.
- Articulate a compelling vision for the future of intelligence systems at On, spanning data platforms, knowledge systems, agent ecosystems, cloud architecture, and AI-native ways of operating.
- Help define the foundational capabilities required for enterprise AI at scale, including identity, discovery, governance, orchestration, observability, interoperability, and trust.

Execution & Cross-Functional Influence :

- Serve as the lead engineer and technical authority for cross-company initiatives, guiding multiple teams to deliver on a unified architectural vision.
- Leverage your combined expertise in Machine Learning, Cloud Infrastructure, Distributed Systems, and Software Engineering to bridge the gap between our Brand, Operations, Product, and Technology domains.
- Establish and champion a "build the core" philosophy, creating durable platform capabilities that enable hundreds of future AI and software use cases rather than solving them one by one.
- Shape the architectural foundations that allow data, models, workflows, applications, and people to operate as a connected intelligence ecosystem.
- Advise executives and business leaders on technology strategy, implementation choices, platform investments, and the technical feasibility of our most ambitious AI-driven goals.

Innovation & Continuous Improvement :

- Foster a culture of world-class engineering and continuous technical advancement, championing direct feedback, rigorous design, and innovative solutions.
- Stay ahead of advancements in AI, agent systems, machine learning infrastructure, distributed systems, cloud platforms, and event-driven architecture, guiding R&D efforts to solve On’s most complex challenges.
- Evaluate emerging technologies and industry standards that will shape the future of enterprise intelligence, agent interoperability, and cloud-native systems.
- Elevate the technical bar across the engineering organisation, mentoring senior engineers and ensuring our systems are built for scale, resilience, adaptability, and long-term evolution.

Your story
 - You are a master builder of high-performance, scalable, resilient systems and platforms, with 10+ years of experience architecting and leading the development of complex software, cloud, data, and infrastructure ecosystems.
- Challenges fuel your innovation, and your sharp analytical skills lead to creative yet pragmatic solutions that stand the test of time.
- You have a proven track record of leading large-scale, cross-functional engineering initiatives from concept to delivery, demonstrating your ability to drive technical alignment and deliver measurable business impact.
- Your background uniquely positions you to bridge Machine Learning, Cloud Infrastructure, Distributed Systems, and Software Engineering, with deep expertise in designing systems that enable intelligence to emerge and operate at scale.
- You possess a profound understanding of distributed systems, event-driven architecture, cloud platforms, modern data systems, and infrastructure design, and have applied them to solve real-world business problems.
- You have hands-on experience building or operating modern AI infrastructure, including model platforms, inference systems, vector databases, retrieval architectures, agent frameworks, orchestration layers, or adjacent technologies.
- You understand that the future competitive advantage of enterprises will increasingly come from the systems that connect models, data, workflows, and people together.
- You are fluent in multiple programming languages and frameworks, but more importantly, you possess exceptional judgement in complex system design and long-term technology strategy.
- You thrive on defining and advancing world-class engineering practices and possess a deep understanding of evolutionary architecture, platform thinking, and systems design at scale.
- Fluent in English, your ability to articulate complex technical ideas clearly and persuasively allows you to influence teams, executives, and partners across the organisation.

At On, you will help build the foundational intelligence platform that enables the company to evolve from using AI to becoming an AI-native organisation.

Meet the team
 As a leading running brand, On’s technology division operates in a dynamic, fast-paced environment and plays a critical role in driving our business success. You will play an active role in shaping and accelerating the maturity of our security posture; by being a pragmatic, trusted, and a collaborative partner to Engineering. Your scope is broad, covering cloud, platform, application, and data.

What we offer
 On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

jobs.title: Sample Maker
jobs.description:
Sample Maker Job Summary:
 We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Sample Maker with a passion for athletic and ready to wear apparel. In this role, you will be responsible for creating high-quality prototypes, muslins and mockups in partnership with pattern engineers, product development and designers to bring product concepts to life. The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in fabric handling (both cutting and sewing), garment construction and sewing techniques. This person should be self driven and eager to continuously grow their skills in apparel development. This is a 6 month contract with potential for permanent.

Key Responsibilities:

• Construct prototypes based on technical specifications, patterns, and alternative construction methods in collaboration with cross functional teams.

• Determine optimal fabrics, trims, and sewing techniques for high-performance apparel.

• Proactively identify and resolve construction challenges.

• Support prototype-to-production transitions at a premium level.

• Ensure samples meet strict quality standards for stitching, durability, and finish.

• Maintain an organized workspace and efficient workflow.

• Stay current on both athletic and ready to wear industry trends and advanced sewing techniques, specific to appearance and function.

Qualifications & Skills:

Experience:

• 8+ years of experience as a Sample Maker, Sample Sewer, or in a similar role within apparel manufacturing, including employment experience in a factory, sample room, or tailoring shop.

• Demonstrated technical proficiency in handling and sewing complex fabrications, spanning both stretch and non-stretch textiles.

• Advanced experience with sewing athletics and ready to wear garments.

• Understanding of garment construction and pattern interpretation.

Technical Skills:

• Proficiency in using industrial sewing machines (single-needle, overlock, coverstitch, etc.).

• Ability to read and follow patterns, spec sheets, and technical sketches.

• Experience working with all fabrications

• Strong attention to detail and a commitment to quality craftsmanship.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience with digital pattern-making software (e.g., Gerber, Lectra) is a plus.

• Basic knowledge of garment dyeing, washing, or textile printing techniques (DTF, DTG).

About the team:

We are focused, solutions-oriented, and able to take action upon imminent challenges. We establish and follow processes, but are also continuously confronting the status quo and the industry standard. We are engineers that steer pinnacle sportswear design ideas into functional reality. We are able to convert innovative concepts and prototypes into commercialised products with stringent quality and engineering standards, bringing them into the hands of our discerning, global customer base. Product creation is a mindset and every team member is empowered to make decisions with the understanding that failure is part of the learning and growth process. As an integrated function in the design and development organisation; we are detail-minded problem solvers; guiding and executing apparel technical development within tight timelines and the highest possible product quality, both on the shelf and in use.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione Siamo alla ricerca di un campione Maker motivato e orientato ai dettagli con la passione per l'abbigliamento sportivo e pronto all'uso. In questo ruolo, sarete responsabili della creazione di prototipi di alta qualità, mussola e mockup in collaborazione con ingegneri pattern, sviluppo di prodotti e designer per dare vita a concetti di prodotto. Il candidato ideale ha una forte base nella gestione del tessuto (sia taglio e cucito), costruzione di capi e tecniche di cucito. Questa persona dovrebbe essere autoguidata e desiderosa di crescere continuamente le loro competenze nello sviluppo dell'abbigliamento.

Questo è un contratto di 6 mesi con potenziale per permanente.

Responsabilità - Costruisci prototipi basati su specifiche tecniche, modelli e metodi di costruzione alternativi in collaborazione con team cross functional. - Determinare tessuti, finiture e tecniche di cucito ottimali per abbigliamento ad alte prestazioni. - Identificare e risolvere in modo proattivo le sfide costruttive. - Sostenere le transizioni prototipo-produzione a un livello premium. - Garantire che i campioni soddisfino severi standard di qualità per cuciture, durabilità e finitura. - Mantenere uno spazio di lavoro organizzato e un flusso di lavoro efficiente.

- Rimani aggiornato sia sulle tendenze atletiche che pronte all'uso del settore e sulle tecniche di cucito avanzate, specifiche per l'aspetto e la funzione.

Qualificazioni e competenze

Esperienza - 8+ anni di esperienza come Maker campione, Seminatore campione, o in un ruolo simile nella produzione di abbigliamento, tra cui esperienza di lavoro in una fabbrica, sala campioni, o negozio di sartoria. - Competenza tecnica dimostrativa nella manipolazione e cucito manufatti complessi, spaziando sia tessuti elastici e non elastici. - Esperienza avanzata con l'atletica del cucito e pronto per indossare indumenti. - Comprensione della costruzione di capi e interpretazione del modello.

Capacità tecniche - Professionalità nell'uso di macchine da cucire industriali (ago singolo, overlock, covertitch, ecc.). - Capacità di leggere e seguire modelli, fogli specifici e schizzi tecnici. - Esperienza lavorando con tutte le lavorazioni - Forte attenzione ai dettagli e un impegno per l'artigianato di qualità.

Qualificazioni preferite - L'esperienza con il software digitale di creazione di pattern (ad esempio, Gerber, Lectra) è un plus. - Conoscenza di base di tintura di capi di abbigliamento, lavaggio, o tecniche di stampa tessile (DTF, DGG).

Siamo focalizzati, orientati alle soluzioni e in grado di affrontare sfide imminenti. Stabiliamo e seguiamo i processi, ma stiamo anche affrontando continuamente lo status quo e lo standard del settore. Siamo ingegneri che guidano le idee di design dello sportswear in realtà funzionale. Siamo in grado di convertire concetti e prototipi innovativi in prodotti commercializzati con standard qualitativi e ingegneristici rigorosi, portandoli nelle mani della nostra clientela globale e discreta.

La creazione di prodotti è una mentalità e ogni membro del team è abilitato a prendere decisioni con la consapevolezza che il fallimento è parte del processo di apprendimento e crescita. Come funzione integrata nell'organizzazione di progettazione e sviluppo; siamo risolutori di problemi con una mentalità dettagliata; guida e attuazione dello sviluppo tecnico dell'abbigliamento entro scadenze ravvicinate e la massima qualità possibile del prodotto, sia sullo scaffale che in uso.

Beschreibung Wir suchen einen motivierten und detailorientierten Sample Maker mit Leidenschaft für sportliche und wearfähige Bekleidung. In dieser Rolle sind Sie verantwortlich für die Erstellung hochwertiger Prototypen, Muslins und Mockups in Partnerschaft mit Musteringenieuren, Produktentwicklung und Designern, um Produktkonzepte zum Leben zu erwecken. Der ideale Kandidat hat eine starke Grundlage in der Stoffhandhabung (Schneiden und Nähen), Bekleidungsbau und Nähtechniken. Diese Person sollte selbstgetrieben und eifrig sein, ihre Fähigkeiten in der Bekleidungsentwicklung kontinuierlich zu erweitern.

Dies ist ein 6-monatiger Vertrag mit einem Potenzial für Dauerhaft.

Verantwortungen - Konstruieren Sie Prototypen auf der Grundlage technischer Spezifikationen, Muster und alternativer Konstruktionsmethoden in Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams. - Determinieren Sie optimale Stoffe, Trimmungen und Nähtechniken für Hochleistungsbekleidung. - Proaktiv identifizieren und lösen Sie Konstruktion Herausforderungen. - Unterstützung Prototyp-to-Produktion Übergänge auf Premium-Ebene. - Stellen Sie sicher, Proben erfüllen strenge Qualitätsstandards für Nähten, Haltbarkeit und Finish. - Pflege eines organisierten Arbeitsplatz und effizienten Workflow.

- Bleiben Sie auf athletischen und bereit, Industrietrends und fortschrittliche Nähtechniken, die speziell auf Aussehen und Funktion.

Qualifikationen und Fähigkeiten

Erfahrung - 8+ Jahre Erfahrung als Sample Maker, Sample Sewer, oder in einer ähnlichen Rolle in der Bekleidungsherstellung, einschließlich Arbeitserfahrung in einer Fabrik, Proberaum oder Schneiderei. - demonstrierte technische Kompetenz in der Handhabung und Nähen komplexer Fabrikationen, spannen sowohl Stretch-und nicht-Stretch-Textilien. - Erweiterte Erfahrung mit nähenden Leichtathletik und bereit, Kleidung zu tragen. - Verständnis der Bekleidungskonstruktion und Muster-Interpretation.

Technische Fähigkeiten - Kenntnisse in der Verwendung von industriellen Nähmaschinen (Einzelnadel, Overlock, Covertitch, etc.). - Fähigkeit, Mustern, Spec Sheets und technischen Skizzen zu lesen und zu folgen. - Erfahrung mit allen Fabrikationen arbeiten - Starke Liebe zum Detail und ein Engagement für Qualität Handwerk.

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen - Erfahrung mit digitaler Musterbausoftware (z.B. Gerber, Lectra) ist ein Plus. - Grundkenntnisse in der Bekleidungsfärbetechnik, beim Waschen oder Textildruck (DTF, DTG).

Über das Team Wir sind fokussiert, lösungsorientiert und können auf die bevorstehenden Herausforderungen reagieren. Wir etablieren und verfolgen Prozesse, stehen aber auch kontinuierlich mit dem Status Quo und dem Industriestandard in Verbindung. Wir sind Ingenieure, die die Ideen von spitzensportbekleidungsdesign in die funktionale Realität lenken. Wir sind in der Lage, innovative Konzepte und Prototypen in marktfähige Produkte mit strengen Qualitäts- und Engineeringstandards umzuwandeln und sie in die Hände unserer anspruchsvollen, globalen Kundenbasis zu bringen.

Die Produktgestaltung ist eine Denkkraft und jedes Teammitglied ist befugt, Entscheidungen zu treffen, mit dem Verständnis, dass Scheitern Teil des Lern- und Wachstumsprozesses ist. Als integrierte Funktion in der Design- und Entwicklungsorganisation sind wir detailorientierte Problemlösungen; führen und realisieren Sie die technische Entwicklung der Bekleidung innerhalb knapper Zeit und der höchstmöglichen Produktqualität, sowohl im Regal als auch im Gebrauch.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Description Nous recherchons un fabricant d'échantillons motivé et axé sur les détails, passionné de vêtements sportifs et prêts à porter. Dans ce rôle, vous serez responsable de la création de prototypes, de muscins et de maquettes de haute qualité en partenariat avec les ingénieurs de motifs, le développement de produits et les concepteurs pour donner vie aux concepts de produits. Le candidat idéal a une base solide dans la manipulation des tissus (à la fois la coupe et la couture), la construction de vêtements et les techniques de couture.

Il s'agit d'un contrat de 6 mois avec possibilité de permanent.

Responsabilités - Construisez des prototypes en fonction des spécifications techniques, des modèles et des méthodes de construction alternatives en collaboration avec des équipes interfonctionnelles. - Déterminez les tissus, les garnitures et les techniques de couture optimales pour les vêtements de haute performance. - Identifier et résoudre les défis de construction. - Soutenir les transitions prototype-production à un niveau de qualité supérieure. - Veiller à ce que les échantillons répondent aux normes de qualité strictes pour la couture, la durabilité et la finition. - Maintenir un espace de travail organisé et un workflow efficace.

- Restez à jour sur les tendances de l'industrie sportive et prêt à porter et les techniques de couture avancées, spécifiques à l'apparence et à la fonction.

Qualifications et compétences

Expérience - 8 ans et plus d'expérience en tant que fabricant d'échantillons, égout d'échantillons ou dans un rôle similaire dans la fabrication de vêtements, y compris l'expérience d'emploi dans une usine, salle d'échantillonnage ou atelier de couture. - Compétence technique démontrée dans la manipulation et la couture de fabrications complexes, couvrant à la fois les textiles extensibles et non extensibles. - Expérience avancée en couture d'athlétisme et prêt à porter des vêtements. - Compréhension de la construction de vêtements et de l'interprétation de motifs.

Compétences techniques - Compétences en matière d'utilisation de machines à coudre industrielles (simple besoin, verrouillage, covertitch, etc.). - Capacité de lire et de suivre des modèles, des fiches techniques et des croquis techniques. - Expérience de travail avec toutes les fabrications - Une grande attention aux détails et un engagement pour l'artisanat de qualité.

Qualifications privilégiées - Expérience des logiciels numériques de fabrication de motifs (p. ex. Gerber, Lectra) est un atout. - Connaissance de base des techniques de teinture, de lavage ou d'impression textile (DTF, DTG).

Nous sommes des ingénieurs qui orientent les idées de conception de vêtements de sport pinnacle en réalité fonctionnelle. Nous sommes en mesure de convertir des concepts et des prototypes innovants en produits commercialisés avec des normes de qualité et d'ingénierie rigoureuses, les mettant entre les mains de notre clientèle mondiale et exigeante.

La création de produits est un état d'esprit et chaque membre de l'équipe est habilité à prendre des décisions en sachant que l'échec fait partie du processus d'apprentissage et de croissance. En tant que fonction intégrée dans l'organisation de conception et de développement, nous sommes des résolveurs de problèmes aux prises avec des détails; guidant et exécutant le développement technique de vêtements dans des délais serrés et la plus haute qualité possible de produit, tant sur l'étagère que dans l'utilisation.

jobs.description:
In short
 Support the development of the fastest-growing global sports brand in scaling our retail footprint to new heights. Are you a strategic thinker with the operational rigor to turn a high-level vision into reality? Do you thrive at the intersection of retail operations, cross-functional alignment, and commercial execution?

We are looking for a highly driven Program Manager - Global Distributor-led Store Business to shape how our brand comes to life across our global partner networks. In this role, you will serve as the bridge between global strategy and local market execution, ensuring our distributor-led stores deliver a premium, consistent, and commercially successful customer experience.

Your mission
 - Drive the global Distributor-led (DMS) store strategy based on the Global Retail strategy forward, acting as the central engine from high-level strategic planning to physical, in-store execution
- Partner closely with Global and Regional Retail teams to design and implement scalable operating frameworks that align distributor market operations with our core brand principles.
- Seamlessly create and adapt DTC Retail playbooks for distributor-led stores. You will drive cross-market alignment, fostering a culture of shared learnings and best practices across global partners.
- Standardize global KPIs and reporting. You will consolidate market insights and distributor performance trends into actionable data for global stakeholders, driving informed decision-making on local, regional and global level.
- Take proactive ownership of global retail standards, helping regional teams identify and quickly resolve in-store execution and operational gaps in alignment with cross-functional partners.

Your story
 - You bring 6+ years of professional experience in retail operations, distributor-led (DMS) retail, franchise management, or partner-led business models within a global consumer brand.
- You are highly skilled in project management with a proven track record of designing scalable retail playbooks, operational frameworks, and standardized SOPs that external partners can seamlessly adopt.
- You possess exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills. You can easily collaborate with, influence, and build trust among cross-functional teams, regional leads, and external distributors to drive compliance without relying on formal authority
- You combine a highly structured, analytical mindset with a hands-on approach. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity and are just as passionate about resolving in-store execution gaps as you are about designing long-term market expansion strategies.
- Your home base will be Zurich. You are fully proficient in English, both written and spoken, with the ability to build strong relationships across diverse cultures.

Meet the team
 Our Retail team is at the forefront of bringing our brand to life in the physical world. We are a fast-paced, highly collaborative group of creators, strategists, and operators dedicated to delivering premium consumer experiences. As we rapidly scale our global footprint, the Distributor-led (DMS) team plays a critical role in unlocking new markets and ensuring our brand standards are uncompromising, no matter where in the world our consumers find us. We believe in high autonomy, relentless innovation, and succeeding together.

What we offer
 On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

jobs.title: Principal Engineer - Operations Technology
jobs.description:
In short
 With On’s growth, our Finance and Operations Technology teams are growing, and we’re looking for a Principal Engineer to help scale On’s operations and finance platforms.

In this role, you’ll be based in our London office, directly reporting to the Senior Director of Engineering of Operations and Finance Technology, working closely with our operations and finance engineering teams, the product management team and key stakeholders based in Zurich, Berlin and London.

All with the end goal to re-engineer and scale our core Finance and Operations technology platforms, encompassing critical areas such as supply chain, logistics, enterprise resource planning (ERP), and financial systems. All while using the latest technology.

Your entrepreneurial and result-driven mindset, combined with strong hands-on technical oversight and execution skills, will make you a key member of the core team on which On’s future is built.

Your mission
 - Lead by example and with inclusion: Drive collaborative projects by seeking diverse viewpoints, emphasising shared knowledge, and making balanced decisions that benefit both Technology at On and the broader company. When required, always be eager to jump hands-on to move On forward and be comfortable with creating things from scratch to lead the team on the right path forward.
- Strategically align with business goals: Proactively identify and address critical business areas within Finance and Operations, balancing technical solutions with company objectives for optimal results. Craft strategies that not only respond to immediate operational needs but also anticipate future shifts, bridging the gap between visionary concepts and actionable strategies.
- Elevate Technology through Vision: Communicate a compelling vision for the future of technology within Finance and Operations at On, engaging team members and broader business stakeholders. Your passion and dedication to the vision should inspire and galvanise others to action.
- Drive Continuous Improvement: Foster a culture where the technical bar is consistently raised. Champion direct feedback and insights as tools to achieve this continuous evolution.
- Decisive Leadership: Be at the forefront of high-level decisions that resonate across the organisation. Your choices should always align with, and amplify, On's overarching strategy.
- Uphold Security and Compliance: Maintain and enhance On's security standards, ensuring processes minimise risks and stay compliant, particularly across critical Finance and Operations systems.

Your story
 - You hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
- With over 10 years under your belt, you've mastered the art of building and optimising high-performance and availability tech systems.
- You bring proven experience as a Principal Engineer, including building and scaling high-traffic services from the ground up by driving significant technical initiatives, and demonstrating strong business acumen.
- You possess strong problem-solving skills to tackle complex technical and product challenges, are a genuine team player, and communicate exceptionally well in English.
- You are confident working with a modern tech stack, including proficiency in more than one Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) language or TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, GCP, and Kafka Stream.
- You have experience taking part in strategies to attract and retain top-tier engineering talent and are committed to continuously raising the bar within the team through effective mentorship and professional development.
- Experience working with external partners and technology vendors is a plus.

Attributes of a successful candidate:

- Pragmatic Problem Solver: You excel at tackling complex challenges with practical, efficient solutions, always prioritising simplicity and avoiding unnecessary system complexity.
- Collaborative Influencer: A true leader rather than a manager, you're adept at guiding team decisions and fostering consensus through professional and constructive influence.
- Committed to Growth and Feedback: You're comfortable providing candid feedback to both peers and leadership, and equally eager to integrate feedback from others to continuously elevate your own expertise.

Meet the team
 You will be part of a cross-functional team consisting of engineers, product managers and functional consultants that implement features from design to deployment, being responsible and in charge of the full process and delivery. We encourage you to find new and innovative ways to solve issues through diversity of thought while at the same time enjoying working within a passionate team drawn from the global community. We live agile values, not just talk about it.

What we offer
 On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

jobs.title: Principal Engineer (AI & Cloud Infrastructure)
jobs.description:
In short
 In Technology at On, everything we build fuels our mission to ignite the human spirit through movement. We craft technology that improves with every interaction, enhancing the experience for everyone who moves. Delivering Wow through our platforms, apps, and services is a core value.

Your focus will not be on individual use cases or one-off prototypes. Instead, your focus will be AI Platform Engineering: building the paved roads, shared services, and core capabilities that make every AI initiative at On faster to build, cheaper to run, safer to operate, and easier to scale. You will turn scattered experimentation into durable, production-grade capability. You will be a hands-on Principal Engineer who can move from architecture to implementation, from proof of concept to production platform, and from a single workload to a multi-tenant capability serving the entire organisation.

You will work closely with our AI strategy, data science, machine learning, applied AI, and infrastructure leaders, ensuring that On's AI foundations are technically excellent, deeply integrated with our data and systems landscape, and built to serve athletes and customers for years to come.

What Success Looks Like:
You will be successful in this role if you turn On's AI ambition into durable engineering capability. You will build a platform that teams across On trust and choose to build on. AI initiatives that once took months of bespoke infrastructure work will ship in days on paved roads. Cost, quality, security, and governance will be managed by design rather than by exception. And as the AI landscape evolves, On's foundations will evolve with it: stable where it matters, adaptable where it counts. You will be the engineering backbone that turns AI possibility into production reality.

Your mission
 Platform & Infrastructure Delivery

Build On's Core AI Platform
- Design and deliver the shared services at the heart of On's AI capability: model gateway and orchestration layers, inference serving, retrieval infrastructure, vector and feature stores, evaluation pipelines, and the developer tooling that ties them together.

Provide Paved Roads for AI Development
- Create golden paths, SDKs, templates, and reference architectures that allow product and applied AI teams to ship AI features quickly without reinventing infrastructure, security, or governance for each initiative.

Engineer for Production, Not Just Demos
- Ensure that AI workloads at On meet the standards expected of any critical system: reliability, observability, latency, cost efficiency, failover, and graceful degradation. Take capabilities from promising prototype to hardened production service.

Own Model Lifecycle Infrastructure
- Build and operate the machinery for the full model lifecycle: versioning, deployment, A/B rollout, monitoring, drift detection, evaluation, and retirement, across both third-party foundation models and internally developed models.

Optimise Cost, Performance, and Scale
- Establish the practices and tooling to manage inference cost, token consumption, caching, routing between models, and capacity planning, so that On's AI usage scales sustainably with the business.

Engineering & Technical Leadership

Act as a Hands-on Principal Engineer
- Lead by example through deep technical contribution. Be comfortable writing production code, designing distributed systems, reviewing critical architecture, and unblocking teams on the hardest infrastructure problems.

Set the Technical Direction for AI Infrastructure
- Define the architecture, standards, and long-term technical roadmap for On's AI platform. Make deliberate build-vs-buy decisions across the rapidly evolving AI tooling landscape, and keep the platform coherent as it grows.

Integrate AI Into On's Systems Landscape
- Connect the AI platform deeply with On's data platform, identity and access management, event streams, and application ecosystem, so intelligent capabilities can draw on trusted data and act safely within existing systems.

Set a High Technical Bar
- Ensure platform components are designed with sound engineering judgement. Balance velocity with quality, simplicity, security, maintainability, and long-term scalability, and raise the bar for AI engineering practice across the organisation.

Navigate Ambiguity With Pragmatism
- Work in a space where the ecosystem changes monthly. Use technical judgement, benchmarking, and first-principles thinking to make durable architectural decisions in a fast-moving landscape.

Enablement, Governance & Adoption

Enable Applied AI Teams
- Partner closely with applied AI, product, and functional teams as your customers. Understand their needs, remove friction, and shape the platform roadmap around what accelerates them most.

Build Governance Into the Platform
- Embed security, privacy, data protection, access control, auditability, and responsible AI guardrails directly into platform primitives, so doing the right thing is the default, not an afterthought.

Establish Evaluation & Quality Infrastructure
- Provide the shared evaluation frameworks, benchmarks, regression suites, and observability that let teams measure model and agent quality objectively, and give leadership confidence in what is deployed.

Partner With the AI Circle and AI Kitchen
- Contribute actively to On's AI operating rhythm, including the AI Kitchen and AI Circle. Represent the platform perspective in prioritisation discussions and help turn strategic ambition into robust, scalable execution.

Influence Without Authority
- Operate as a senior individual contributor who earns trust through expertise, clarity, delivery, and collaboration. Guide teams through professional influence rather than formal management authority.

Innovation & Continuous Improvement

Scout Emerging AI Infrastructure
- Continuously evaluate new serving frameworks, orchestration tools, model providers, agent runtimes, and infrastructure patterns, assessing where they can strengthen On's platform.

Evolve the Platform From First Principles
- Avoid accumulating tooling for its own sake. Continuously simplify, consolidate, and redesign the platform as the ecosystem matures, retiring what no longer earns its place.

Industrialise What Works
- Identify when a capability proven by applied teams should be absorbed into the platform as a shared service, and lead that transition from bespoke solution to reusable foundation.

Promote Responsible AI Use
- Ensure platform capabilities are developed and operated with appropriate consideration for security, privacy, data protection, governance, cost, and brand trust.

Mentor and Inspire
- Support engineers across On in building strong AI infrastructure skills. Share practical knowledge on distributed systems, MLOps, and LLMOps, and help others develop the judgement to build AI systems well.

Your story
 Technical Background
- You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

Principal-Level Engineering Experience
- You have 10+ years of experience designing and building high-quality, large-scale software systems, with a proven track record as a senior or principal-level engineer operating across complex organisations.

AI/ML Infrastructure Practitioner
- You have hands-on experience building the infrastructure behind AI systems: model serving and inference optimisation, retrieval and vector infrastructure, orchestration and agent runtimes, evaluation pipelines, MLOps/LLMOps tooling, and the integration of foundation model APIs into production systems.

Distributed Systems Engineer
- You are deeply comfortable with cloud-native architecture, Kubernetes and containerised workloads, event-driven systems, API design, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, and the operational disciplines: observability, SLOs, incident response, that keep critical platforms healthy.

Platform Builder
- You have built platforms or internal developer tooling that other engineering teams depend on. You think in terms of paved roads, self-service, multi-tenancy, and developer experience, and you measure your success by the teams you accelerate.

Systems Thinker
- You understand how data, platforms, workflows, and business processes connect. You can design shared capabilities that create leverage across an entire ecosystem rather than solving one problem at a time.

Pragmatic Problem Solver
- You are excited by complexity, but you do not add unnecessary complexity yourself. You favour simple, elegant, high-leverage architectures that can be understood, adopted, and evolved.

Technology Translator
- You can speak equally well with engineers, executives, product managers, and business stakeholders. You make infrastructure trade-offs, costs, and risks understandable, relevant, and actionable.

Impact-Oriented Mindset
- You care deeply about outcomes. You are not satisfied with elegant infrastructure that nobody uses. You want to see the platform measurably accelerate how On builds, ships, and operates AI.

Exceptional Communicator
- Fluent in English, you can articulate complex technical ideas clearly and persuasively, whether in an architecture review, executive conversation, design document, or cross-functional workshop.

Meet the team
 Joining the Tech Leadership team at On, you will help accelerate our journey towards becoming an AI-native organisation. In this role, you will design, build, and operate the foundational AI platform that powers intelligent capabilities across On, providing the shared infrastructure, tooling, and services that allow teams throughout the company to build with AI safely, reliably, and at scale.

What we offer
 On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

You will be a hands-on Principal Engineer who can move from architecture to implementation, from proof of concept to production platform, and from a single workload to a multi-tenant capability serving the entire organisation.

You will work closely with our AI strategy, data science, machine learning, applied AI, and infrastructure leaders, ensuring that On's AI foundations are technically excellent, deeply integrated with our data and systems landscape, and built to serve athletes and customers for years to come.

You will be successful in this role if you turn On's AI ambition into durable engineering capability. You will build a platform that teams across On trust and choose to build on. AI initiatives that once took months of bespoke infrastructure work will ship in days on paved roads. Cost, quality, security, and governance will be managed by design rather than by exception. And as the AI landscape evolves, On's foundations will evolve with it: stable where it matters, adaptable where it counts. You will be the engineering backbone that turns AI possibility into production reality.

Build On's Core AI Platform

Engineer for Production, Not Just Demos

Own Model Lifecycle Infrastructure

Optimise Cost, Performance, and Scale

jobs.title: Lead - Tooling Engineer
jobs.description:
In short

As Footwear Tooling Engineer you will create groundbreaking concepts and products for high-performance athletes while advancing On’s sustainability goals. Working in a collaborative environment, you’ll shape the future direction of our pinnacle performance product and technologies through Innovation and Design.

You will act as the owner of the bottom unit development for our pinnacle performance product and technologies. You will work in close collaboration with designers and developers here at On Labs in Zurich and our Tooling team in Vietnam to create the highest quality products. From concept creation through prototyping, you will guide the team on bottom unit materials, geometries, and construction from a critical manufacturing, biomechanical performance, and durability viewpoint. You will also be a key player in identifying and creating process improvements for all bottom unit development across the company.

Your mission

- Lead the bottom unit development for On’s performance products

- Provide solutions to design and construction constraints by using your demonstrated knowledge of materials, mold construction and manufacturing

- Evaluate and improve product designs for manufacturability and durability by reviewing 2D/3D CADs, prototypes, and feedback from the testing teams

- Ensure alignment with product specifications and manufacturing capabilities

- Use your understanding of plastics injection molding to advise cost, design, and molding capabilities of injected components in the bottom unit

- Collaborate with our Asian counterparts and support mold shop teams on tooling revisions and manufacturing concerns

- Assist the development, product management, and design teams with any tooling related questions or issues

- Evaluate current workflows and create process improvements to maximize efficiencies and advance testing

Your story

- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Design, or a related field

- Minimum of 5 years experience within a footwear engineering role working closely with development and production, ideally in a footwear tooling development

- Technical knowledge of various materials, mold construction, and manufacturing processes relevant to footwear; In-depth knowledge of plastics injection molding principles, including advising on cost, design, and molding capabilities of injected components

- Experience working with 2D and 3D CADs (Rhino a bonus); proficiency in reviewing and evaluating 2D/3D CADs for manufacturability, durability, and alignment with product specifications

- Experience in 3D modelling and rapid prototyping tools

- Demonstrated experience in project management, costing, and the ability to provide solutions within complex constraints

- Experience working with biomechanical performance principles as they relate to footwear bottom unit design

- Experience working cross-functionally across designers, developers, product management, and testing teams

- Experience collaborating with international manufacturing partners on tooling revisions and manufacturing concerns

- Strong communication skills to provide clear guidance and technical support to various stakeholders.

- Excellent time management skills and ability to work with multiple deadlines

- Available to travel to Asia at least 2 times a year

The team

Our mission is to define and create the future of sportswear bringing to life groundbreaking innovations. Acting at the forefront of material science, sport science and engineering we develop products that push the boundaries of performance and sustainability, blending in unique aesthetic appeal that embodies On’s design DNA.

descriptionByLocale.it:
In breve

Come Footwear Tooling Engineer creerete concetti e prodotti innovativi per atleti ad alte prestazioni mentre avanzano gli obiettivi di sostenibilità On.s. Lavorando in un ambiente collaborativo, si.ll plasma la direzione futura del nostro prodotto e delle tecnologie per prestazioni pinnacle attraverso Innovazione e Design.

Lavorerai in stretta collaborazione con designer e sviluppatori di On Labs a Zurigo e con il nostro team Tooling in Vietnam per creare prodotti di altissima qualità. Dalla creazione di concept fino alla prototipazione, guiderai il team su materiali di base, geometrie e costruzioni da un punto di vista critico della produzione, delle prestazioni biomeccaniche e della durata.

Sarete anche un giocatore chiave nell'identificazione e nella creazione di miglioramenti di processo per tutto lo sviluppo delle unità di fondo in tutta l'azienda.

La tua missione

- Guidare lo sviluppo dell'unità inferiore per i prodotti di performance On.s

- Fornire soluzioni per la progettazione e vincoli costruttivi utilizzando la vostra conoscenza dimostrata dei materiali, costruzione di stampi e produzione

- Evaluare e migliorare i progetti di prodotto per la capacità di resistenza e la durata, recensendo CAD 2D/3D, prototipi e feedback dai team di test

- Garantire l'allineamento con le specifiche del prodotto e le capacità di produzione

- Utilizzare la comprensione dello stampaggio ad iniezione in plastica per consigliare costi, progettazione e capacità di stampaggio dei componenti iniettati nell'unità inferiore

- Il 'Canada' con i nostri omologhi asiatici e supporta i team dei negozi di stampi sulle revisioni degli utensili e sulle preoccupazioni di fabbricazione

- Assistere lo sviluppo, la gestione dei prodotti e la progettazione team con qualsiasi domanda o problemi relativi strumento

- Evaluare i flussi di lavoro correnti e creare miglioramenti di processo per massimizzare l'efficienza e il test di avanzamento

La tua storia

- Laurea in Ingegneria Meccanica, Disegno Industriale o in un campo correlato

- Minimo 5 anni di esperienza in un ruolo di ingegneria calzaturiera lavorando a stretto contatto con lo sviluppo e la produzione, idealmente in uno sviluppo di attrezzi calzaturieri

- Conoscenza tecnica dei vari materiali, costruzione di stampi e processi di produzione relativi alle calzature; Conoscenza approfondita dei principi di stampaggio ad iniezione delle materie plastiche, compresa la consulenza sui costi, la progettazione e le capacità di stampaggio dei componenti iniettati

- Esperienza lavorando con CAD 2D e 3D (un bonus di Rhino); competenza nella revisione e valutazione dei CAD 2D/3D per la capacità di sfruttare, mantenere e allineare le specifiche del prodotto

- Esperienza in strumenti di modellazione 3D e prototipazione rapida

- Esperienza dimostrativa nella gestione dei progetti, costi e capacità di fornire soluzioni entro vincoli complessi

- Esperienza lavorando con i principi di performance biomeccanica in quanto si riferiscono alla progettazione di fondo calzatura

- Esperienza lavorando in modo cross-funzionale tra progettisti, sviluppatori, gestione dei prodotti e team di test

- Esperienza di collaborazione con partner industriali internazionali sulle revisioni degli utensili e sulle problematiche di fabbricazione

- Forte capacità comunicative per fornire orientamenti e supporto tecnico chiari ai vari soggetti interessati.

- Ottima capacità di gestione del tempo e capacità di lavorare con scadenze multiple

- Disponibile per viaggiare in Asia almeno 2 volte all'anno

La squadra

La nostra missione è definire e creare il futuro dello sportswear portando alla luce innovazioni innovative. Aggendo all'avanguardia nella scienza dei materiali, nello sport e nell'ingegneria sviluppiamo prodotti che spingono i confini delle prestazioni e della sostenibilità, mescolandosi in un unico appeal estetico che incarna il DNA di progettazione On.s.

Kurz gefasst

Als Footwear Tooling Engineer erstellen Sie bahnbrechende Konzepte und Produkte für Hochleistungssportler und fördern dabei On,s Nachhaltigkeitsziele. In einem kollaborativen Umfeld gestalten Sie die Zukunftsrichtung unseres Spitzenleistungsprodukts und unserer Technologien durch Innovation und Design.

Sie werden als Eigentümer der Entwicklung der unteren Einheit für unsere Spitzenleistung Produkt und Technologien. Sie werden in enger Zusammenarbeit mit Designern und Entwicklern hier bei On Labs in Zürich und unserem Tooling-Team in Vietnam, um die höchste Qualität Produkte zu schaffen. Von der Konzepterstellung bis zum Prototyping, Sie werden das Team auf unteren Einheiten Materialien, geiseln, und Konstruktion aus einer kritischen Herstellung, biomechanische Leistung und Haltbarkeitssicht führen.

Sie werden auch ein wichtiger Akteur bei der Identifizierung und Erstellung von Prozessverbesserungen für alle unteren Einheiten Entwicklung im Unternehmen.

Ihre Mission

- Führen Sie die untere Einheit Entwicklung für On,s Performance-Produkte

- Bereitstellung von Lösungen für Design- und Konstruktionsbeschränkungen mit Ihren bewährten Kenntnissen in Materialien, Formenbau und Herstellung

- Bewertung und Verbesserung der Produktdesigns für Manufacturability und Haltbarkeit durch Überprüfung von 2D/3D CADs, Prototypen und Feedback der Testteams

- Gewährleistung der Abstimmung mit Produktspezifikationen und Fertigungskapazitäten

- Nutzen Sie Ihr Verständnis von Kunststoffspritzguss, um Kosten, Design und Formfähigkeiten von eingespritzten Komponenten im unteren Bereich zu beraten

- Zusammenarbeit mit unseren asiatischen Kollegen und Unterstützung von Werkzeugbauteams bei Werkzeugrevisionen und Fertigungsbedenken

- Unterstützung der Entwicklungs-, Produktmanagement- und Designteams bei Fragen oder Problemen rund um das Werkzeug

- Bewertung der aktuellen Workflows und Prozessverbesserungen zur Maximierung der Effizienz und Vorprüfung

Ihre Geschichte

- Bachelor in Maschinenbau, Industriedesign oder einem verwandten Bereich

- Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in einer schuhverarbeitenden Funktion, die eng mit Entwicklung und Produktion zusammenarbeitet, idealerweise in einer schuhverarbeitenden Entwicklung

- Technische Kenntnisse der verschiedenen Materialien, Formenbau und Herstellungsverfahren, die für Schuhe relevant sind; Tiefe Kenntnisse der Kunststoffspritzguss-Grundsätze, einschließlich Beratung über Kosten, Design und Formungsfähigkeiten von eingespritzten Komponenten

- Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit 2D und 3D CADs (Rhino a bonus); Kenntnisse in der Überprüfung und Bewertung von 2D/3D CADs für die Herstellungsfähigkeit, Haltbarkeit und Ausrichtung mit Produktspezifikationen

- Erfahrung in 3D-Modellierung und Rapid Prototyping-Tools

- Vorgestellte Erfahrung in Projektmanagement, Kostenrechnung und die Fähigkeit, Lösungen innerhalb komplexer Zwänge anzubieten

- Erfahrung mit biomechanischen Leistungsprinzipien, da sie sich auf die Fußunterteil-Design beziehen

- Erleben Sie funktionsübergreifend in Designern, Entwicklern, Produktmanagement und Testteams arbeiten

- Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Fertigungspartnern bei Werkzeugrevisionen und Fertigungsbelangen

- Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, um verschiedene Akteure klar zu beraten und technisch zu unterstützen.

- Ausgezeichnete Zeitmanagement-Fähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, mit mehreren Fristen zu arbeiten

- Verfügbar für Reisen nach Asien mindestens 2 mal im Jahr

Das Team

Unsere Mission ist es, die Zukunft der Sportbekleidung zu definieren und zu schaffen, die bahnbrechende Innovationen zum Leben erweckt. Mit der Arbeit an der Spitze der Materialwissenschaft, der Sportwissenschaft und der Technik entwickeln wir Produkte, die die Grenzen von Leistung und Nachhaltigkeit überschreiten und sich in einzigartiger ästhetischer Anziehungskraft vereinen, die On,s Design DNA verkörpert.

jobs.title: Lead - Spatial Designer, EMEA
jobs.description:
In Short:

At On, we’re redefining the boundaries of design and storytelling in sportswear. We are looking for a senior designer to lead on strategically planning and overseeing the delivery of immersive physical experiences in Europe, the Middle East and Africa (EMEA). These experiences will capture the essence of our brand - bringing our global campaigns to life in a wide range of retail environments across the region. Reporting to the Senior Creative Lead in our EMEA Creative Studio, you will help conceptualize, develop and deliver world-class spatial designs that express On’s identity through innovative use of form, material and narrative. Working with internal and external partners, you will translate On’s innovative spirit into memorable, locally relevant experiences for our fans across EMEA.

Your Mission:

• Adapt and localize global brand campaigns, tailoring their design and storytelling to create impactful, multi-door retail experiences across the region.

• Elevate the On retail environment by applying your expertise in 3D design, set design and scenography to translate concepts into locally relevant retail campaigns across all spatial touchpoints.

• Oversee the design of campaign activations for new store openings, pop-ups, and special events across our retail network.

• Drive the roadmap for the region, planning ahead and overseeing projects from strategic planning to creative execution.

• Work with external agencies, providing clear direction and managing feedback to ensure exceptional, scalable campaign executions.

• Collaborate with global and regional teams across Visual Experience, Retail, Marketing and Production to ensure a cohesive and impactful brand presence at every touchpoint.

• Champion creative problem-solving and challenge the status quo, using your design expertise to push boundaries and create dynamic, forward-thinking retail spaces.

Your Story:

• You’re likely to have 6+ years of experience in campaign or retail experience design for a premium, multi-door DTC brand.

• You have a portfolio that showcases your technical skills in 3D design, drawing and rendering - with a strong emphasis on retail environments and physical spaces, including windows, in-store spaces and pop-ups.

• Your expertise may span across 3D design, set design, spatial or scenographic design.

• You have experience with production drawings, material specification, and build processes.

• You’re an innovative and entrepreneurial thinker, consistently pushing creative boundaries and translating new ideas into tangible, executed designs that convey premium brand positioning.

• You’re an expert at managing multiple projects simultaneously, delivering high-quality work to tight deadlines without compromising on precision or excellence.

• You have a track record of successfully leading agencies or other partners to bring complex designs to life at scale through translating brand vision and design intent into actionable direction.

• You’re adept at navigating complex organizations, collaborating seamlessly across global and regional teams to achieve shared goals.

We’re more interested in the skills, mindset, and creative leadership you bring than in how many years you’ve spent in a specific role or industry. So if the above resonates with you, please feel empowered to apply.

Your Team:

This role can be based in either Zurich or London and you will sit at the intersection of several incredible teams packed with passionate people based primarily in those locations. The EMEA Brand Studio team tells compelling stories and brings experiences to life, all in pursuit of our mission to ignite the power of human spirit through movement. This work requires collaboration across the business. It is hybrid and flexible, 2-3 days per week in the office and some travel between Zurich, London, Paris, Berlin, Milan and other cities in the EMEA region. On is a Swiss company with a stunning local hub in Zurich and rapidly growing teams in London, Berlin and beyond.

What We Offer:

A fair and balanced internal recruiting process with an opportunity to learn about other teams, roles and challenges.

On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Designazione delle merci

In breve:

At On, stiamo ridefinendo i confini del design e della storytelling nello sportswear. Stiamo cercando un senior designer che conduca alla pianificazione strategica e alla supervisione della consegna di esperienze fisiche di tipo 126ve in Europa, Medio Oriente e Africa (EMEA). Queste esperienze cattureranno l'essenza del nostro marchio - portando le nostre campagne globali alla vita in un'ampia gamma di ambienti retail in tutta la regione.

Reporting to the Senior Creative Lead nel nostro EMEA Creative Studio, aiuterai a concettualizzare, sviluppare e fornire design spaziali di livello mondiale che esprimono l'identità On.s attraverso l'uso innovativo di forma, materiale e narrativa. Lavorando con partner interni ed esterni, tradurrai lo spirito innovativo On.s in esperienze memorabili e localmente rilevanti per i nostri fan in tutta l'EMEA.

La tua missione

- Adattare e localizzare campagne di brand globali, personalizzare il loro design e storyteling diding per creare esperienze retail multi-door impattanti in tutta la regione. - Aumentare l'ambiente On retail applicando la tua esperienza in 3D design, scenografia e design per tradurre i concetti in campagne retail locali rilevanti in tutti i touchpoint spaziali. - Sovravedere la progettazione di attivazioni di campagna per nuove aperture di negozi, pop-up, ed eventi speciali attraverso la nostra rete retail. - Guidare la roadmap per la regione, pianificare e supervisionare i progetti dalla pianificazione strategica all'esecuzione creativa.

- Collabora con agenzie esterne, fornendo una chiara direzione e gestione dei feedback per garantire esecuzioni di campagne eccezionali e scalabili. - Collabora con team globali e regionali attraverso Visual Experience, Retail, Marketing e Produzione per garantire una presenza coesa e impattante del marchio in ogni touchpoint. - Champion creation problem-solving e sfidare lo status quo, utilizzando la tua esperienza di design per spingere i confini e creare spazi retail dinamici e lungimiranti.

La tua storia

- È probabile che tu abbia 6+ anni di esperienza nella progettazione di campagne o di esperienze al dettaglio per un marchio DTC premium multi-porta. - Hai un portafoglio che mostra le tue competenze tecniche in progettazione 3D, disegno e rendering - con una forte enfasi sugli ambienti al dettaglio e spazi fisici, tra cui finestre, spazi in negozio e pop-up. - La tua esperienza può spaziare su progettazione 3D, scenografia, progettazione spaziale o scenografica. - Hai esperienza con disegni di produzione, specifiche dei materiali e processi di costruzione.

- Sei un pensatore innovativo e imprenditoriale, spingendo costantemente i confini creativi e traducendo nuove idee in progetti tangibili e eseguiti che trasmettono posizionamento di marchio premium. - Sei un esperto nella gestione di più progetti contemporaneamente, offrendo un lavoro di alta qualità a scadenze strette senza compromettere la precisione o l'eccellenza. - Hai un track record di agenzie leader di successo o altri partner per portare progetti complessi a vita in scala attraverso la traduzione di visione del marchio e design intenta in direzione attuabile.

- Sei abile a navigare in organizzazioni complesse, collaborando senza soluzione di continuità tra team globali e regionali per raggiungere obiettivi condivisi.

La tua squadra

Questo ruolo può essere basato a Zurigo o Londra e vi siederà all'incrocio di diversi team incredibili, ricchi di persone appassionate, che si trovano principalmente in quelle sedi. Il team EMEA Brand Studio racconta storie avvincenti e dà vita a esperienze, tutti in cerca della nostra missione di accendere il potere dello spirito umano attraverso il movimento. Questo lavoro richiede collaborazione in tutta l'attività. È ibrido e flessibile, 2-3 giorni a settimana in ufficio e alcuni viaggi tra Zurigo, Londra, Parigi, Berlino, Milano e altre città della regione EMEA.

È una società svizzera con un centro locale mozzafiato a Zurigo e team in rapida crescita a Londra, Berlino e oltre.

Cosa offriamo

- Un processo di reclutamento interno equo ed equilibrato con l'opportunità di conoscere altri team, ruoli e sfide. - On è un luogo che è centrata sulla crescita e il progresso. Offriamo un ambiente progettato per dare alle persone gli strumenti per sviluppare olisticamente. per rimanere attive, per imparare, esplorare e innovare. - Il nostro approccio distintivo combina un'atmosfera di supporto, orientata al team, con l'accesso alla cura personale di sé per il benessere fisico e mentale, così ogni persona è guidata da uno scopo. - On è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità.

Ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente di lavoro equo e inclusivo, dove tutte le decisioni relative al reclutamento, al progresso e al mantenimento sono esenti da discriminazioni.
