descriptionByLocale.de:
Warenbezeichnung

Kurz gesagt:

Bei On definieren wir die Grenzen von Design und Storytelling in der Sportbekleidung. Wir suchen einen Senior Designer, der die strategische Planung und Überwachung der Bereitstellung von dauerhaften physischen Erfahrungen in Europa, dem Nahen Osten und Afrika (EMEA) übernimmt. Diese Erfahrungen werden das Wesen unserer Marke erfassen - unsere globalen Kampagnen in einer Vielzahl von Einzelhandelsumgebungen in der Region zum Leben erwecken.

Sie werden in unserem EMEA Creative Studio an den Senior Creative Lead berichten und helfen, weltklasse Raumentwürfe zu konzipieren, zu entwickeln und zu liefern, die On,s Identität durch innovative Nutzung von Form, Material und Erzählung zum Ausdruck bringen. In Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Partnern übersetzen Sie On,s Innovationsgeist in unvergessliche, lokal relevante Erfahrungen für unsere Fans in ganz EMEA.

Ihre Mission

- Anpassung und Lokalisierung globaler Markenkampagnen, Anpassung ihres Designs und Storytellings an die Schaffung von wirkungsreichen, multi-door-Handelserlebnissen in der Region. - Elevate the On Retail-Umgebung durch Anwendung Ihrer Expertise in 3D-Design, Set Design und Szenografie, um Konzepte in lokal relevante Retail-Kampagnen über alle räumlichen Touchpoints hinweg zu übersetzen. - Überwachen Sie die Gestaltung von Kampagnenaktivierungen für neue Store-Openings, Pop-ups und Sonderveranstaltungen in unserem Retail-Netzwerk. - Fahren Sie die Roadmap für die Region, planen Sie voraus und überwachen Sie Projekte von der strategischen Planung bis zur kreativen Umsetzung.

- Arbeiten Sie mit externen Agenturen zusammen, indem Sie klare Richtungs- und Feedback-Referenzen bereitstellen, um außergewöhnliche, skalierbare Kampagnenausführungen zu gewährleisten. - Arbeiten Sie mit globalen und regionalen Teams in den Bereichen Visual Experience, Retail, Marketing und Produktion zusammen, um eine kohärente und wirkungsvolle Markenpräsenz an jedem Berührungspunkt zu gewährleisten. - Championieren Sie kreative Problemlösungen und fordern Sie den Status Quo heraus, indem Sie Ihre Designkompetenz nutzen, um Grenzen zu überschreiten und dynamische, zukunftsweisende Einzelhandelsflächen zu schaffen.

Ihre Geschichte

- Sie haben wahrscheinlich mehr als 6 Jahre Erfahrung in der Kampagnen- oder Einzelhandelserfahrungsgestaltung für eine Premium-DTC-Marke mit mehreren Türen. - Sie haben ein Portfolio, das Ihre technischen Fähigkeiten in 3D-Design, Zeichnung und Rendering zeigt - mit einem starken Schwerpunkt auf Einzelhandelsumgebungen und physischen Räumen, einschließlich Fenstern, Ladenräumen und Pop-ups. - Ihre Expertise kann sich über 3D-Design, Set-Design, räumliche oder szenografische Design. - Sie haben Erfahrung mit Produktionszeichnungen, Materialspezifikation und Bauprozesse.

- Sie sind ein innovativer und unternehmerischer Denker, der kreative Grenzen konsequent sprengt und neue Ideen in greifbare, ausgeführte Designs übersetzt, die Premium-Markenpositionierung vermitteln. - Sie sind ein Experte bei der Verwaltung mehrerer Projekte gleichzeitig, liefert hochwertige Arbeit zu engen Fristen, ohne Kompromisse bei Präzision oder Exzellenz. - Sie haben eine Erfolgsbilanz von erfolgreichen führenden Agenturen oder anderen Partnern, um komplexe Designs auf dem Niveau zu bringen, indem Sie Markenvision und Design-Intent in eine handlungsfähige Richtung übersetzen.

- Sie sind sehr geschickt darin, komplexe Organisationen zu navigieren, und arbeiten nahtlos in globalen und regionalen Teams zusammen, um gemeinsame Ziele zu erreichen.

Ihr Team

Diese Rolle kann in Zürich oder London angesiedelt sein und Sie sitzen an der Kreuzung mehrerer unglaublicher Teams mit leidenschaftlichen Menschen, die vor allem an diesen Standorten angesiedelt sind. Das EMEA Brand Studio Team erzählt überzeugende Geschichten und bringt Erfahrungen zum Leben, die alle in der Verfolgung unserer Mission, die Kraft des menschlichen Geistes durch Bewegung zu entfachen, zum Leben erweckt werden. Diese Arbeit erfordert eine Zusammenarbeit im gesamten Unternehmen. Es ist hybrid und flexibel, 2-3 Tage pro Woche im Büro und einige Reisen zwischen Zürich, London, Paris, Berlin, Mailand und anderen Städten in der EMEA-Region.

On ist ein Schweizer Unternehmen mit einem atemberaubenden lokalen Hub in Zürich und schnell wachsenden Teams in London, Berlin und darüber hinaus.

Was wir anbieten

- Ein fairer und ausgewogener interner Recruiting-Prozess mit der Möglichkeit, über andere Teams, Rollen und Herausforderungen zu lernen. - On ist ein Ort, der sich um Wachstum und Fortschritt dreht. Wir bieten ein Umfeld, das den Menschen die Werkzeuge gibt, sich ganzheitlich zu entwickeln – aktiv zu bleiben, zu lernen, zu erforschen und zu innovativ zu sein. - Unser unverwechselbarer Ansatz kombiniert eine unterstützende, teamorientierte Atmosphäre mit Zugang zur persönlichen Selbstversorgung für körperliches und geistiges Wohlbefinden, so dass jeder Mensch durch den Zweck geführt wird. - On ist ein Arbeitgeber der Chancengleichheit.

Wir verpflichten uns, ein faires und integratives Arbeitsumfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Entscheidungen im Zusammenhang mit der Einstellung, dem Fortschritt und der Beibehaltung frei von Diskriminierung sind.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Désignation des marchandises

En bref :

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un designer senior qui sera chargé de planifier et de superviser stratégiquement la livraison d'expériences physiques immersive en Europe, au Moyen-Orient et en Afrique (EMEA). Ces expériences vont capter l'essence de notre marque - mettant en scène nos campagnes mondiales dans un large éventail d'environnements de vente au détail dans toute la région.

En vous adressant au Senior Creative Lead de notre studio créatif EMEA, vous aiderez à conceptualiser, développer et livrer des designs spatiaux de classe mondiale qui expriment l'identité par l'utilisation novatrice de la forme, du matériel et du narratif. En travaillant avec des partenaires internes et externes, vous traduirez l'esprit innovant en expériences mémorables et pertinentes localement pour nos fans dans l'ensemble de l'EMEA.

Votre mission

- Adapter et localiser les campagnes de marque mondiales, adapter leur conception et leur narration pour créer des expériences de vente au détail multiportes et impactées dans toute la région. - Élever l'environnement de vente au détail en appliquant votre expertise en conception 3D, conception de set et scénographie pour traduire des concepts en campagnes de vente au détail locales dans tous les points de contact spatiaux. - Superviser la conception des activations de campagne pour les nouvelles ouvertures de magasins, pop-ups et événements spéciaux sur notre réseau de vente au détail.

- Collaborer avec des équipes mondiales et régionales dans le cadre de l'expérience visuelle, du commerce de détail, du marketing et de la production afin d'assurer une présence de marque cohérente et pertinente à chaque point de contact. - Champion créatif résolution de problèmes et défier le statu quo, en utilisant votre expertise de conception pour repousser les frontières et créer des espaces de vente dynamiques et prospectifs.

Votre histoire

- Vous avez probablement 6 ans d'expérience dans la conception d'expérience de campagne ou de vente au détail pour une marque DTC multiportes premium. - Vous avez un portefeuille qui met en valeur vos compétences techniques en conception, dessin et rendu 3D - avec un accent particulier sur les environnements de vente au détail et les espaces physiques, y compris les fenêtres, les espaces en magasin et les pop-ups. - Votre expertise peut couvrir la conception 3D, la conception de décors, la conception spatiale ou scénographique. - Vous avez de l'expérience avec les dessins de production, la spécification des matériaux et les processus de construction.

- Vous êtes un penseur innovant et entrepreneurial, repoussant constamment les frontières créatives et traduisant de nouvelles idées en des designs tangibles et exécutés qui transmettent un positionnement de marque premium. - Vous êtes un expert dans la gestion simultanée de plusieurs projets, fournissant un travail de haute qualité à des délais serrés sans compromettre la précision ou l'excellence. - Vous avez une expérience de la réussite des agences leaders ou d'autres partenaires pour mettre en œuvre des designs complexes à l'échelle en traduisant la vision de marque et l'intention de conception en direction actionnable.

- Vous êtes adepte de la navigation des organisations complexes, collaborant de façon transparente entre les équipes mondiales et régionales pour atteindre des objectifs communs.

Votre équipe

Ce rôle peut être basé à Zurich ou à Londres et vous vous retrouverez à l'intersection de plusieurs équipes incroyables, remplies de passionnés, principalement dans ces lieux. L'équipe de Brand Studio d'EMEA raconte des histoires fascinantes et met en valeur nos expériences, tout en poursuivant notre mission de mettre en valeur la puissance de l'esprit humain par le mouvement. Ce travail exige une collaboration dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise.

On est une entreprise suisse avec un superbe hub local à Zurich et des équipes en croissance rapide à Londres, Berlin et au-delà.

Ce que nous offrons

- Un processus de recrutement interne équitable et équilibré qui permet de découvrir d'autres équipes, rôles et défis. - Nous offrons un environnement qui permet de développer les outils de manière holistique – rester actif, apprendre, explorer et innover. - Notre approche distinctive combine une atmosphère de soutien et de travail en équipe, avec l'accès à des soins personnels pour le bien-être physique et mental, de sorte que chaque personne est dirigée par un but. - Nous sommes un employeur à égalité de chances.

Nous sommes déterminés à créer un milieu de travail équitable et inclusif, où toutes les décisions liées au recrutement, à l'avancement et au maintien en poste sont exemptes de discrimination.

jobs.title: Lead - Robotics and PLC Engineer
jobs.description:
In short
 Take the leap and redefine the future of sports goods production with us. Lead groundbreaking projects to develop and scale cutting-edge processes and products. Invent, optimize, automate and develop machines, to shape the future of manufacturing. Beside concept development and prototyping of new manufacturing technologies on a lab scale, you will lead the technology engineering, development scale up towards commercial production.

As a robotics and PLC engineer you will work closely on the development of new footwear manufacturing machines. You realize early concepts and help to develop them to production by programming and deploying new procedures and routines. You act as a link between computational design and machine engineering. You introduce new robot routines, program PLC's but also help troubleshoot and identify improvements to be applied.

Your mission
 - Robot Programming & Integration: Act as the subject matter expert for industrial manipulators. You will introduce new routines, update controllers, and integrate new hardware into the manufacturing ecosystem.
- PLC Innovation: Beyond standard logic, you will leverage CODESYS and various communication protocols. You’ll find creative ways to bridge PLC systems with high-level languages like Python to unlock new capabilities.
- Digital Twin Facilitation: Serve as the critical link between software engineering and physical hardware. You will manage digital twin environments and ensure precise calibration across systems.
- Kinematic Simulation: Conduct reachability studies on parametrized models to guide hardware design and ensure mechanical optimization before a single part is built.
- Knowledge Leadership: Act as a technical mentor and consultant for designers and operators, ensuring the team has the support needed to navigate complex automated systems.

Your story
 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, or a related technical field.
- 6+ years of professional experience in industrial automation or a related innovation-focused environment.
- Proven expertise in programming and deploying industrial robots.
- Demonstrated success in implementing robust, scalable workflows for novel or first-of-their-kind applications.
- Strong understanding of how quality standards and precision engineering impact the final product.
- Ability to thrive in innovation-driven environments with demanding timelines and high-quality standards.
- Strong communication skills with the ability to bridge software development and mechanical engineering teams.
- Availability to travel up to 20% of the time.
- Proven track record of creating reliable, scalable operating procedures for pioneering applications.
- Experience with ABB Robotics is highly valued.
- Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

Meet the team
 As a member of the Innovation Technology team, you will join a multidisciplinary collective of experts redefining the future of sports goods manufacturing. We bridge the gap between digital theory and physical reality by building bespoke machinery, processing novel materials, and leveraging advanced modeling and simulation. Our mission is to unlock the potential of next-generation manufacturing, developing the custom software and engineering workflows needed to scale high-performance products

What we offer
 On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

jobs.title: Lead - Reverse Logistics
jobs.description:
In short
 The Lead Global Reverse Logistics role, within the Global Distribution & Logistics team, is strategically responsible for the vision, optimization, and standardization of the return process flow across all channels: Direct-to-Consumer (DTC), Retail, and Business-to-Business (B2B). This critical role involves overseeing the entire global return lifecycle from customers back to the fulfillment network while independently driving key strategic streams of the circular Cyclon initiative. You will architect global standards and SOPs, leading the integration of On’s 3PL-managed fulfillment network with return centers and dedicated Cyclon 2.0 partners. This position reports to the Head of Warehouse Operations on the Global Supply Chain team and focuses on developing team capabilities to manage highly complex, cross-regional projects with diverse stakeholders.

Your mission
 - Strategic Global Flow Design & Optimization: Own the design, overarching strategy, and continuous enhancement of global reverse logistics operational flows. Synthesize regional insights and market trends to drive macro-level systemic improvements.
- Process Standardization & Innovation: Formulate and mandate global operational standards to ensure highly efficient and consistent return processes across all global 3PL partners, positioning reverse logistics as a competitive advantage.
- Global Implementation Leadership: Architect, prioritize, and drive the execution of comprehensive implementation roadmaps. Oversee the creation of global Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), ensuring effective change management and multi-regional alignment.
- Strategic Stakeholder Management & Influence: Lead communication and partnership frameworks with high-level internal and external global stakeholders. Define complex project scopes, negotiate requirements, and align diverse steering committees on key strategic solutions.
- End-to-End Program Management: Direct and execute high-scale, cross-functional implementations and circular economy initiatives. Establish rigorous tracking metrics and detailed program roadmaps to report long-term strategic results to executive leadership.

Your story
 - Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Logistics, Supply Chain & Operations Management, or a related field (Master's degree preferred).
- Minimum of 8–10+ years of progressive, hands-on experience in implementing, scaling, and leading global operational supply chain processes, with a deeply established expertise in reverse logistics, circularity, and post-consumer product lifecycles.
- Proven leadership track record in operational process design, steering multi-million dollar initiatives, and successfully driving alignment across highly diverse global stakeholder groups.
- Extensive experience in strategic 3PL management, including global vendor selection, complex commercial onboarding, contractual governance, and long-term performance optimization.
- Exceptional communication, negotiation, and advisory skills, with a demonstrated ability to build deep cross-functional relationships, manage high ambiguity, and guide cross-regional teams.
- Advanced proficiency with Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) and Warehouse Management Systems (WMS), with specific experience in Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365) preferred.
- Proficient English language skills. Other languages are a plus.

Meet the team
 Our Global Distribution & Logistics team is the backbone of On's Supply Chain on a clear mission to build the most advanced fulfillment network in the industry. We are a data-driven, action-oriented group that thrives on collaboration and challenges the status quo. We work across continents and functions, partnering with the best 3PLs in the world to deliver excellence and build a resilient, innovative, and world-class supply chain.

What we offer
 On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

jobs.description:
Lead Project Manager - Brand & Product Assets
 Global Marketing Program Management Team

Location: Zurich, Berlin, London (preferred)

In Short
 Born in the Swiss Alps with the goal of revolutionizing the sportswear industry, On has become the world’s fastest-growing premium sportswear brand.
We’re on a mission to ignite the human spirit through movement, staying true to our deep roots in performance running while growing our relevance with those who move in other ways.
To support this ambition, we are looking for a strong project manager with agency experience to drive our Product & Digital Copy projects.
This role will report to the Head of Marketing Program Management – Brand & Product Assets.

The role oversees and coordinates copy development across a wide range of consumer and commercial touchpoints, including CRM emails, product description pages (PDPs), B2B sell-in tools for partners, and retail marketing assets such as footwear wall copy. It also includes product and style naming, development of new terminology (evergreen), and copy for hangtags, packaging, and brand guidelines across all verticals and Special Projects.

This role ensures copy is strategically aligned, delivered on time, and consistently expresses the brand voice across all channels and markets.

If you have experience managing copy processes, understand what makes a strong creative brief, and have a genuine passion for language, this could be the right opportunity to make your mark.

We particularly welcome candidates with diverse life and professional experiences, perspectives, and working styles.

Your Mission

• Own and drive end-to-end project management for all product and digital copy projects, ensuring briefs are complete and aligned through proactive cross-functional validation, copy outputs accurately reflect the brief, and both master English copy and translations are delivered on time.

• Collaborate with the Creative Ops team to allocate copywriters and proactively manage their workload by tracking timelines and prioritization.

• Support the Head of Marketing Program Management – Brand & Product Assets to define and continuously improve processes and ways of working.

• Foster strong alignment across the wider Marketing Program Management team to ensure consistency across all consumer touchpoints.

• Monitor efficiency and key performance metrics, leveraging data-driven insights to continuously optimize and refine approaches for maximum impact.

• Proactively identify and address potential challenges or roadblocks, demonstrating agility and resourcefulness in developing solutions that maintain momentum and deliver strong outcomes.

Your Story

• A minimum of 5-7 years of experience in Project Management within a creative advertising agency is required for this role.

• You have the tenacity to solve hard problems, exceptional initiative, attention to detail and follow-through skills – all with sight of the bigger picture.

• Proven track record in successfully coordinating multiple projects simultaneously from start to finish.

• Strong understanding of product and digital copy processes across CRM emails, product description pages (PDPs), B2B sell-in tools for partners, and retail marketing assets, as well as product and style naming, the development of evergreen terminology, and copy for hangtags, packaging, and brand guidelines across all verticals and special projects.

• Excellent problem-solving, project management, and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders at all levels.

• Ability to meet tight timelines, prioritize tasks, and find solutions without compromising quality or positivity.

• Exceptional initiative, attention to detail, and follow-through skills while keeping sight of the bigger picture.

• Excellent presentation skills

• Fluent in English

• Familiarity with AI-generated copy is a plus.

• Proficiency in Asana, Jira, Figma and Google Workspace is a plus

About the Team

The mission of the Marketing Program Management team is to ensure marketing projects are delivered on time and on budget (where required), enabling seamless execution across cross-functional teams.
We operate in a culture of accountability, resourcefulness, and collaboration, fostering an environment where innovation and growth can thrive.
With a strong commitment to excellence, we continuously elevate On’s product and digital copy, pushing creative and executional boundaries season after season.

What we offer

On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

jobs.title: Lead - Platform Security Engineer
jobs.description:
In short
 At On, our technology moves as fast as our runners: always evolving, always pushing boundaries. We're building a world-class platform to ignite the human spirit through movement, and our Information Security team is the trusted guardian of that mission.
Join a collaborative team of curious minds who believe security should not stop at recommendations. We are moving security closer to engineering — into the code, pipelines, platforms, cloud environments, and identity systems where risks are created and remediated.
We are looking for a Platform Security Engineer who wants to work side-by-side with Engineering, Platform & Ops, and Cloud Security Architecture teams. This is a deeply hands-on role for someone who can open pull requests, build guardrails, remediate vulnerabilities, reduce attack surface, and help make secure engineering the default way of working at On.
This role is for someone who sees security not as a gate, but as a force multiplier for engineering excellence.

Your mission
 As a Lead Platform Security Engineer, your mission is to turn security requirements into implemented controls. You will work directly with Engineering, Platform & Ops, and Cloud Security Architecture teams to embed security into how platforms and products are designed, built, deployed, and operated.
You will move beyond advisory security by contributing directly to platform repositories, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, identity controls, and security automation. Your success will be measured by risk reduction: merged fixes, fewer repeat findings, stronger guardrails, and a more resilient engineering ecosystem.

- Work side-by-side with Engineering, Platform & Ops, and Cloud Security Architecture teams to translate security requirements, threat models, and vulnerability findings into practical engineering outcomes.
- Contribute hands-on to platform, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, and security-control repositories through pull requests, configuration changes, automation, and policy-as-code.
- Build and improve scalable security guardrails across the software delivery lifecycle, including secrets scanning, dependency scanning, infrastructure-as-code checks, secure build controls, and AI development workflows.
- Partner with engineering teams to remediate vulnerabilities, reduce attack surface, and prevent recurring findings through direct fixes, paired engineering work, or automated controls.
- Strengthen identity and access security for both human and non-human identities, including service accounts, CI runners, automation workflows, coding agents, MCP servers, and bots.
- Support secure-by-design reviews and threat modeling for cloud, platform, identity, CI/CD, and AI-enabled development, ensuring risks are addressed before implementation starts.
- Participate in operational ownership for security-relevant infrastructure and controls you materially contribute to, including root-cause analysis and incident remediation where needed.

Your story
 You are a hands-on lead security engineer who enjoys working close to engineering teams, platforms, code, and infrastructure. You are not satisfied with writing recommendations and waiting for someone else to implement them. You like to build, fix, automate, and improve the system at the source.

You combine strong security judgment with practical engineering skills and know how to make security controls work in real-world development environments.

- You bring 10+ years of experience in security engineering, platform security, cloud security, DevSecOps, application security, or infrastructure security.
- You have hands-on experience contributing to engineering workflows using Git, pull requests, code reviews, CI/CD pipelines, automation, or infrastructure-as-code.
- You are comfortable working with cloud environments, ideally including Google Cloud Platform, and understand cloud IAM, network exposure, platform security, and secure configuration patterns.
- You have practical experience with vulnerability remediation and know how to move from finding to fix, including validating closure and preventing recurrence.
- You understand CI/CD security and have experience with controls such as secrets scanning, dependency scanning, SAST, infrastructure-as-code scanning, policy-as-code, or secure build pipelines.
- You are familiar with identity and access security concepts, including least privilege, privileged access, service accounts, non-human identities, temporary access, and credential rotation.
- You are able to translate threat models, risk scenarios, and architecture requirements into concrete technical controls that engineers can implement and operate.
- You are curious about emerging AI security risks and motivated to secure modern development workflows involving AI-generated code, coding agents, MCP servers, and automation.
- You are a natural collaborator who can build trust with Engineering, Platform & Ops, Cloud Security Architecture, Cyber Defence, and GRC teams.
- You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, focusing on practical risk reduction rather than theoretical security perfection.
- You have a pragmatic mindset and know how to balance speed, security, engineering quality, and business impact.

Meet the team
 As a leading running brand, On’s technology division operates in a dynamic, fast-paced environment and plays a critical role in driving our business success. You will play an active role in accelerating the maturity of our security posture; this is a critical hire for a new Security Engineering function.
Your mission is to protect the company’s infrastructure and applications by being a pragmatic, trusted, and a collaborative partner to Engineering.

What we offer
 On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

jobs.title: Lead - Last Mile Excellence
jobs.description:
In short
 The Lead - Last Mile Excellence role will report to the Head of Outbound Transportation & Last Mile Delivery on the Last Mile Excellence team supporting our omnichannel last mile operations. You will drive complex, end-to-end projects to ensure On customers receive the best possible delivery and returns experience across ecommerce, retail, and wholesale. As an agile thinker in a brand-new team, you will be responsible for landing some of our largest initiatives, directly improving customer experience in a fast-growing retail environment.

Your mission
 - Lead the global rollout and strategic scaling of our multi-carrier strategy across all regions. Currently, On single source carriers in the majority of our global regions and our team is responsible for evolving our last mile into a multi-carrier model.
- Develop the methodology for us to measure and improve our expected delivery date performance, working collaboratively across Tech, Operations, Regional Supply Chain and our carrier partners to drive this number as high as possible.
- Help develop, align, and optimize foundational ways of working across our ecommerce, retail, and wholesale channels.
- Make critical operational and project decisions autonomously while effectively gathering input from cross-functional stakeholders.
- Balance innovation with efficiency, continuously seeking new ideas or technologies to improve processes without reinventing the wheel.

Your story
 - 7+ years of hands-on experience navigating complex supply chain environments, with a deep operational understanding of retail, delivery carriers, or 3PL networks.
- Proven experience managing carrier relations or delivery solutions, matching the expertise of a carrier manager or delivery solutions manager.
- An agile thinker who is highly comfortable navigating changing priorities and ambiguity in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
- A proactive problem-solver with a track record of working autonomously to address complex, multi-layered logistical challenges.
- Excellent communication skills, with a natural ability to build a diverse internal network and collaborate closely with functional peers.
- Proficient English language skills. Other languages are a plus.
- A results-oriented individual with a deep curiosity, open to learning, and determined to make a direct impact on the customer journey.
- Experience managing a carrier or retailer delivery P&L and operating a Carrier Management System is advantageous.

Meet the team
 Welcome to the brand-new Last Mile Excellence team! We exist to ensure On customers receive the best possible delivery and returns experience across our three core channels: ecommerce, retail, and wholesale. We sit under the larger Global Logistics and Distribution team, whose mission it is to introduce global standards and practices and roll them out to our colleagues in Regional Supply Chain. We are a fast-growing, agile group dedicated to making a direct, tangible impact on the post-purchase journey. If you love solving complex supply chain problems, navigating changing priorities, and collaborating with a diverse network to improve global ways of working, you will fit right in.

What we offer
 On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

jobs.title: Lead - Inbound Transportation Operations
jobs.description:
In short
 We are seeking a highly experienced and proactive Inbound Transport Operations Lead for our Zurich-based Global Inbound Transportation Team. Reporting directly to the Head of Inbound Transportation Operations, you will drive the execution of strategic transport initiatives and enhance delivery performance by ensuring our products flow from our suppliers to our warehouses for your assigned markets efficiently and on time. Your will play a pivotal role in managing and evolving our transport operations to boost performance, foster proactive shipment oversight, and streamline our transportation network.

Your mission
 - Drive key strategic initiatives for Transport Operations, including supporting the establishment of transport flows to new warehouses, onboarding of Logistics Service Providers, and scaling of Direct Ship operations.
- Lead and optimize inbound delivery performance for a specific market, ensuring timely and cost-effective product flows from factories to warehouses across diverse modes of shipment (air, sea, road), and guaranteeing rigorous adherence to SLAs and lead-time benchmarks.
- Establish strong partnerships with LSPs, Regional Operations, Customs and Supply Planning mitigating supply chain disruptions proactively, driving continuous improvement and enforcing accountability across all stakeholders
- Co-lead monthly and quarterly business reviews with LSPs and market-level reviews to evaluate KPIs, drive continuous improvement, and hold all stakeholders accountable.
- Lead initiatives to standardize, align, and re-assess global transport operations requirements across providers and destinations.
- Foster best practice sharing, driving standardization and harmonization where beneficial while maintaining agility for local market needs.

Your story
 - A degree in business, economics, logistics, planning, supply chain, information systems, or operations; MBA a is a plus.
- +7 years of work experience in global transport operations ideally in an apparel/fashion global supply chain management or freight forwarding/carrier industry. Additional supply chain experience in other areas such as, procurement, sourcing, supply planning, and warehousing is an asset.
- Extensive knowledge and operational experience across all modes of transport, including airfreight, seafreight, truck, and courier services.
- Strong analytical, structured and data driven mindset.
- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, both oral and written, to interact effectively with different teams and stakeholders
- Proficiency in English. Other languages are a plus.
- Ability to work and deliver in changing environments, under very limited guidance while adhering to specified deadlines.

Meet the team
 The Inbound Transportation Team works closely to strive for excellence in everything we do, to ensure that products from our suppliers to the warehouses globally are delivered in a timely and optimal manner. We are data-driven but are also action-oriented and are able to multi-task. We establish and follow processes, but are also continuously challenging the status quo and industry standards.

What we offer
 On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

jobs.description:
Generative Intelligence and Search Ecosystem Analyst

In Short

The way the world discovers information is undergoing a fundamental shift. Consumers are moving away from traditional search engines toward a fragmented ecosystem of AI assistants, agentic models, and decentralized social channels. At On, we address this transformation through our "Search Everywhere" initiative.

As the Lead - Generative Intelligence and Search Ecosystem Analyst , you will be the primary intelligence architect of On’s visibility in this fragmented "Search Everywhere" reality, moving beyond the legacy metrics of keyword rankings and organic traffic to a more holistic understanding of brand authority, entity recall, and AI-driven recommendations. You will lead the insights generation and data-driven recommendations to help ensure On remains the "cited answer" in a world dominated by AI-driven recommendations, generative engines, and decentralized social ecosystems. You will tackle complex, ambiguous challenges by treating Large Language Models (LLMs) as the new search index, ensuring our technical innovations (from CloudTec™ to LightSpray™), product attributes and brand stories are accurately represented and recommended to consumers globally.

Your Mission

• Strategic Vision for Discovery: Own the long-term roadmap for On’s visibility across the "Search Everywhere" landscape, moving the organization from tracking rankings to mastering "entity authority" and AI recall.

• Ecosystem Intelligence: Lead the analysis of the non-linear customer journey, using advanced clickstream and behavioral data to identify exactly where and how consumers are shifting their trust from traditional search engines to generative AI and social platforms.

• Technical Authority on Retrieval: Serve as the internal expert on Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). You will define the technical standards for how our product data should be structured to be "machine-readable" and "summarization-ready," minimizing AI hallucinations about our technology.

• Global Market Orchestration: Navigate the nuances of international search ecosystems (including Google, Baidu, Naver, and Yandex), ensuring On’s technological narrative is consistent and authoritative across different linguistic and algorithmic environments.

• Cross-Functional Influence: Partner with Paid and Organic Search, Content, Marketing, and Product teams to optimize budget allocation and content pipelines, acting as a trusted thought partner to bridge the gap between technical data engineering and brand storytelling.

• Operational Excellence: Partner with Data and Tech teams to guide the construction of scalable ETL pipelines for log file analysis, monitoring AI bot behavior (like GPTBot) at the server level to ensure high-value content is indexed and retrieved efficiently.

Your Story

• Proven Domain Expert: You have extensive experience (8+ years) in technical SEO and search analytics. You don’t just use tools; you have a track record of solving complex visibility problems and understand the underlying mechanics of how information is vectorized, retrieved, and presented.

• Future-proof mindset: You haven’t just watched the search landscape change; you have looked into how to adapt your toolkit. You have a working knowledge of emerging evaluation frameworks (such as NDCG or RAGAS) and are familiar with the specialized toolkits used to audit LLM responses and brand clarity. You stay ahead of the curve in emerging trends, such as visual search (Google Lens), agentic e-commerce, and the nuances of zero-party data.

• Technical Fluency: You are proficient in Python and SQL. You are comfortable working with large-scale datasets, server logs, and building the logic for automated intelligence dashboards.

• Collaborative Influencer: You are a strong communicator who can translate complex linguistic analytics into actionable business terms for senior stakeholders across regions and functions.

Meet the Team

You will join the Digital Customer Analytics team, a high performing team dedicated to the end-to-end customer journey, from optimizing performance marketing and site experimentation to analyzing purchasing behavior and long-term loyalty. We transform complex digital signals into actionable insights that fuel growth, retention, and a seamless shopping experience.

What We Offer

On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Generative Intelligence e Ricerca Ecosystem Analyst

In breve

Il modo in cui il mondo scopre le informazioni sta subendo un cambiamento fondamentale. I consumatori si stanno allontanando dai motori di ricerca tradizionali verso un ecosistema frammentato di assistenti dell'AI, modelli agentici e canali sociali decentrati. A On, affrontiamo questa trasformazione attraverso la nostra iniziativa "Search Everywhere".

Come Lead - Generative Intelligence and Search Ecosystem Analyst , sarete l'architetto di intelligenza primaria della visibilità di On in questa frenetica realtà "Search Everywhere", che va oltre le metriche legacy delle classifiche di parole chiave e del traffico organico ad una comprensione più olistica dell'autorità di marca, del richiamo dell'entità e delle raccomandazioni AI-driven. Condurrai le raccomandazioni di generazione e data-driven intuizioni per garantire Su rimane la "riposta citata" in un mondo dominato da raccomandazioni, motori generativi, e ecosistemi sociali decentralizzati. Potrai affrontare sfide complesse e ambigue trattando Large Language Models (LLMs) come il nuovo indice di ricerca, garantendo le nostre innovazioni tecniche (da CloudTecTM a LightSprayTM), gli attributi dei prodotti e le storie di marca sono rappresentati con precisione e consigliati ai consumatori a livello globale.

La tua missione

• Visione strategica per la scoperta: Possedere la roadmap a lungo termine per la visibilità di On attraverso il paesaggio "Search Everywhere", spostando l'organizzazione dal tracciamento delle classifiche alla padronanza di "autorità di unità" e richiamando AI.

• Ecosystem Intelligence: guidare l'analisi del percorso non lineare del cliente, utilizzando dati a flusso di clic avanzato e comportamentali per identificare esattamente dove e come i consumatori stanno spostando la loro fiducia dai motori di ricerca tradizionali alle piattaforme AI generative e sociali.

• Autorità Tecnica di Retrieval: Servire come esperto interno di Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). Definirai gli standard tecnici per il modo in cui i nostri dati di prodotto dovrebbero essere strutturati per essere "leggibili da macchine" e "preparabili da sumarizzazione", riducendo al minimo le allucinazioni AI sulla nostra tecnologia.

• Global Market Orchestration: Navigare le sfumature degli ecosistemi di ricerca internazionali (tra cui Google, Baidu, Naver e Yandex), assicurando che la narrazione tecnologica di On sia coerente e autorevole in diversi ambienti linguistici e algoritmici.

• Cross-Functional Influence: Partner con i team Paid e Organic Search, Content, Marketing e Product per ottimizzare l'allocazione di budget e le pipeline di contenuti, agendo come partner di fiducia per colmare il divario tra ingegneria dei dati tecnici e storytelling del marchio.

• Eccellenza Operativa: Partner con i team Data e Tech per guidare la costruzione di tubazioni ETL scalabili per l'analisi dei file di registro, il monitoraggio del comportamento AI bot (come GPTBot) a livello del server per garantire che i contenuti ad alto valore siano indicizzati e recuperati in modo efficiente.

La tua storia

• Proven Domain Expert: Hai una vasta esperienza (8+ anni) in SEO tecnico e analisi di ricerca. Non si utilizzano solo strumenti; si dispone di un track record di risolvere problemi di visibilità complessi e capire la meccanica sottostante di come le informazioni sono vettoriate, recuperate e presentate.

• Mindset anti-futuro: Non hai appena guardato il cambiamento del paesaggio di ricerca; hai guardato in come adattare il tuo toolkit. Hai una conoscenza di lavoro dei framework di valutazione emergenti (come NDCG o RAGAS) e hai familiarità con i toolkit specializzati utilizzati per controllare le risposte LLM e la chiarezza del marchio. Si rimane davanti alla curva delle tendenze emergenti, come la ricerca visiva (Google Lens), agentic e-commerce, e le sfumature di dati zero-partiti.

• Fluenza Tecnica: Sei esperto in Python e SQL. Sei comodo a lavorare con set di dati su larga scala, registri server e la costruzione della logica per cruscotti di intelligenza automatizzati.

• Influencer collaborativo: Lei è un comunicatore forte che può tradurre analisi linguistiche complesse in termini di business attuabili per gli stakeholder senior in regioni e funzioni.

Incontra il team

Ti unirai al team di Digital Customer Analytics, un team altamente performante dedicato al customer journey end-to-end, dall'ottimizzazione del marketing delle prestazioni e della sperimentazione del sito per analizzare il comportamento di acquisto e la lealtà a lungo termine. Trasformiamo segnali digitali complessi in intuizioni attuabili che alimentano la crescita, la ritenzione e un'esperienza di shopping senza soluzione di continuità.

Cosa offriamo

Su è un luogo che si concentra intorno alla crescita e al progresso. Offriamo un ambiente progettato per dare alle persone gli strumenti per sviluppare olistico – per rimanere attivi, per imparare, esplorare e innovare. Il nostro approccio distintivo combina un'atmosfera solida e orientata al team, con l'accesso all'autocura personale sia per il benessere fisico che mentale, quindi ogni persona è guidata dallo scopo.

Su è una parità di opportunità datori di lavoro. Ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente di lavoro equo e inclusivo, dove tutte le decisioni relative al reclutamento, all'avanzamento e alla conservazione sono libere di discriminazione.

Bei On gehen wir diese Transformation durch unsere Initiative „Search Everywhere an.

Als Lead - Generative Intelligence und Search Ecosystem Analyst sind Sie der primäre Intelligenzarchitekt der Sichtbarkeit von On in dieser fragmentierten "Search Everywhere" -Realität, die über die Legacy-Metriken von Keyword-Rankings und organischem Traffic hinausgeht, um ein ganzheitlicheres Verständnis von Markenautorität, Entitätsrückruf und KI-gesteuerten Empfehlungen zu erlangen. Sie werden die Insights-Generierung und datengesteuerte Empfehlungen leiten, um sicherzustellen, dass On die "zitierte Antwort" in einer Welt bleibt, die von KI-gesteuerten Empfehlungen, generativen Motoren und dezentralen sozialen Ökosystemen dominiert wird. Sie werden komplexe, mehrdeutige Herausforderungen angehen, indem Sie Large Language Models (LLMs) als neuen Suchindex behandeln und sicherstellen, dass unsere technischen Innovationen (von CloudTecTM bis LightSprayTM), Produktattribute und Markengeschichten genau dargestellt und den Verbrauchern weltweit empfohlen werden.

Deine Mission

• Strategische Vision für Entdeckung: Besitzen Sie die langfristige Roadmap für die Sichtbarkeit von On in der "Search Everywhere" -Landschaft, die das Unternehmen von der Nachverfolgung von Rankings zur Beherrschung von "Entity Authority" und KI-Rückruf bewegt.

• Ökosystemintelligenz: Führen Sie die Analyse der nichtlinearen Customer Journey mithilfe von erweiterten Clickstream- und Verhaltensdaten, um genau zu ermitteln, wo und wie Verbraucher ihr Vertrauen von traditionellen Suchmaschinen auf generative KI und soziale Plattformen verlagern.

• Technical Authority on Retrieval: Diene als interner Experte für Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). Sie definieren die technischen Standards, wie unsere Produktdaten so strukturiert sein sollten, dass sie "maschinenlesbar" und "zusammenfassend" sind, wodurch KI-Halluzinationen über unsere Technologie minimiert werden.

• Cross-Functional Influence: Partnerschaft mit bezahlten und organischen Such-, Content-, Marketing- und Produktteams zur Optimierung der Budgetzuweisung und der Content-Pipelines und als vertrauenswürdiger Denkpartner, um die Lücke zwischen technischem Data Engineering und Brand Storytelling zu schließen.

Analyste de l'intelligence et de la recherche génétiques

En bref

La façon dont le monde découvre l'information subit un changement fondamental. Les consommateurs s'éloignent des moteurs de recherche traditionnels vers un écosystème fragmenté d'assistants de l'IA, de modèles d'agents et de canaux sociaux décentralisés. Chez On, nous abordons cette transformation grâce à notre initiative « Rechercher partout ».

En tant que responsable - Analyste de l'intelligence et de l'écosystème de recherche , vous serez le principal architecte de l'intelligence de la visibilité d'Ons dans cette réalité fragmentée "Rechercher partout", allant au-delà des métriques héritées des classements par mots clés et du trafic organique à une compréhension plus globale de l'autorité de marque, du rappel d'entités et des recommandations axées sur l'IA. Vous dirigerez la production d'information et les recommandations axées sur les données pour vous assurer qu'On reste la « réponse sollicitée » dans un monde dominé par les recommandations axées sur l'IA, les moteurs générateurs et les écosystèmes sociaux décentralisés. Vous vous attaquerez à des défis complexes et ambigus en traitant les modèles de grande langue (LLM) comme le nouvel index de recherche, en vous assurant que nos innovations techniques (de CloudTecTM à LightSprayTM), les attributs de produit et les histoires de marque sont bien représentés et recommandés aux consommateurs du monde entier.

Votre mission

• Vision stratégique pour la découverte : Posséder la feuille de route à long terme pour la visibilité d'Ons à travers le paysage « Rechercher partout », faisant passer l'organisation des classements de suivi à la maîtrise de « l'autorité de l'entité » et du rappel d'IA.

• Ecosystem Intelligence: Diriger l'analyse du parcours client non linéaire, en utilisant des données avancées sur le flux de clic et le comportement pour identifier exactement où et comment les consommateurs changent leur confiance des moteurs de recherche traditionnels à l'IA générative et plates-formes sociales.

• Autorité technique chargée de la récupération : Servir d'expert interne sur la production de récupération-augmentée (RAG). Vous définirez les normes techniques pour la façon dont nos données de produit devraient être structurées pour être « lisibles par machine » et « prêtes à la synthèse », minimisant les hallucinations d'IA au sujet de notre technologie.

• L'orchestration du marché mondial : Naviguez les nuances des écosystèmes de recherche internationaux (y compris Google, Baidu, Naver et Yandex), en veillant à ce que la narration technologique d'On.

• Influence interfonctionnelle : Partenaire avec des équipes de recherche, de contenu, de marketing et de produits payés et biologiques pour optimiser l'allocation budgétaire et les pipelines de contenu, agissant en tant que partenaire de confiance pour combler l'écart entre l'ingénierie des données techniques et la narration de la marque.

• Excellence opérationnelle: Partenaire avec les équipes Data et Tech pour guider la construction de pipelines ETL évolutives pour l'analyse des fichiers log, la surveillance du comportement des robots AI (comme GPTBot) au niveau du serveur pour s'assurer que le contenu de haute valeur est indexé et récupéré efficacement.

Votre histoire

• Expert de domaine éprouvé: Vous avez une vaste expérience (8+ ans) en référencement technique et analyse de recherche. Vous n'utilisez pas simplement des outils; vous avez une expérience de résolution de problèmes complexes de visibilité et de comprendre la mécanique sous-jacente de la façon dont l'information est vectorielle, récupérée et présentée.

• L'état d'esprit à l'épreuve de l'avenir: Vous n'avez pas observé le changement de paysage de recherche; vous avez examiné comment adapter votre boîte à outils. Vous avez une connaissance pratique des nouveaux cadres d'évaluation (tels que NDCG ou RAGAS) et vous connaissez bien les trousses d'outils spécialisées utilisées pour vérifier les réponses et la clarté de la marque. • Fluence technique : Vous êtes compétent en Python et SQL. Vous êtes à l'aise de travailler avec des ensembles de données à grande échelle, des journaux de serveurs et de construire la logique des tableaux de bord automatisés de l'intelligence.

• Influenceur collaboratif : Vous êtes un communicateur fort qui peut traduire l'analyse linguistique complexe en termes opérationnels réalisables pour les principaux intervenants de toutes les régions et fonctions.

Vous rejoindrez l'équipe Digital Customer Analytics, une équipe hautement performante dédiée au parcours client de bout en bout, de l'optimisation du marketing de performance et de l'expérimentation de site à l'analyse du comportement d'achat et de la fidélité à long terme. Nous transformons des signaux numériques complexes en aperçus concrets qui alimentent la croissance, la rétention et une expérience d'achat transparente.

jobs.title: Lead - Footwear Material Designer
jobs.description:
In short
 At On, our Material Design team is central to defining the intersection of performance, aesthetics, and sustainability. We are looking for a Lead - Material Designer to join us here at On. In this role you will be responsible for setting the material design vision, driving innovation, and ensuring excellence across product categories.

Materials are a key expression of our brand—shaping how products perform, feel, and connect emotionally with consumers. As a Lead Material Designer, you combine deep technical expertise with a strong creative point of view to guide the development of material strategies and narratives at a global level.
You lead and inspire teams, influence product direction, and translate cultural, technological, and sustainability insights into forward-thinking material solutions that define On’s future.

Your mission
 - Material Strategy Leadership – Define and drive the long-term material design vision across categories, aligning with brand, product strategy, and business goals
- Seasonal Direction Setting – Own and lead seasonal material briefs, ensuring clarity, innovation, and alignment with commercial, sustainability, and margin targets
- Creative Direction & Storytelling – Establish strong, differentiated material narratives that elevate product storytelling and reinforce brand identity
- Material Innovation – Lead the exploration and integration of new materials, technologies, and finishes, pushing boundaries in performance and sustainability
- Material Development Oversight – Guide and challenge the development of engineered materials and constructions, ensuring design intent is realized at the highest level
- Materialways & Feasibility Leadership – Ensure material proposals are both visionary and executable, grounded in manufacturing expertise and scalability
- Material Systems & Efficiency – Oversee material mapping and library strategy to drive consistency, efficiency, and scalability across product lines
- Cross-Functional Leadership – Act as a key partner and decision-maker across Footwear Design, Color, Development, and Product Strategy teams
- Color & Material Integration – Lead the integration of color and material strategies from concept through execution
- Stakeholder Influence – Present and communicate material strategies and concepts at a senior level, driving alignment and key decisions
- Team Leadership & Mentorship – Lead, mentor, and develop Material Designers, fostering growth, creativity, and high performance within the team
- Culture & Innovation Driver – Champion a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement within the team and across functions
- Trend & Insight Leadership – Translate macro trends, cultural movements, and advancements in materials into actionable design direction
- External Awareness – Maintain strong awareness of industry developments, suppliers, and emerging technologies to keep On at the forefront
- Inspiration Direction – Oversee and elevate the team’s approach to inspiration, ensuring a forward-looking and relevant creative pipeline

Your story
 - Bachelor’s degree in Textile Design, Product Design, or a related field
- 8–10+ years of experience in footwear or performance product design, with deep expertise in Material Design
- Proven track record of leading material direction and delivering innovative, commercially successful products
- Strong expertise in material construction, manufacturing processes, and performance requirements
- Demonstrated ability to lead teams and influence cross-functional stakeholders at multiple levels
- Strategic mindset with the ability to connect creative vision to business impact
- Advanced proficiency in design tools (Adobe Creative Suite, PLM); 3D capabilities are a strong plus
- Deep commitment to sustainability, with experience driving responsible material strategies at scale
- Strong understanding of competitive landscape, consumer insights, and market dynamics
- Excellent communication, storytelling, and presentation skills
- Fluent in English (written and spoken); additional languages are a plus

Meet the team
 Our Color and Materials Team is a key driver of On’s global product expression and innovation. As a Lead, you play a critical role in shaping not only the output of the team but also its direction, culture, and impact.
We bring together diverse expertise across color, materials, and design to create meaningful, high-performance product experiences. Through a highly collaborative and forward-thinking approach, we push boundaries, challenge conventions, and define the future of our brand.

What we offer
 On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

jobs.title: Lead - Footwear Dynamic Testing - Innovation
jobs.description:
In Short:

Product Testing is the voice of the athlete and the consumer at On. We’re responsible for ensuring every On product meets the highest quality standards and delivers a premium, high-performance experience by combining scientific rigor with real-world insight.

As Lead in Footwear Testing, you will own the end-to-end validation of cutting-edge concepts from our Innovation pipelines. You will lead high-visibility brand bets, mentor junior team members, and establish the strategic framework and scalable testing structures that blend objective performance insights with consumer psychology—up until the concepts are ready to be handed over to inline development.

Your Mission:

• Lead highly visible testing projects and major brand bets within the Innovation space. You will navigate complex stakeholder landscapes and drive cross-functional alignment for key early-stage initiatives that impact the broader company direction.

• Own the end-to-end testing process for complex concepts. Design, build, and establish efficient testing processes, timelines, and strategic pipelines, defining validation milestones to ensure a seamless, data-rich handover to the inline testing specialists.

• Integrate consumer insights and psychological principles to optimize how we interact with our tester pool. Design subjective assessment methods that accurately capture the consumer mindset, perception, and emotional response to early-stage products.

• Process large volumes of complex data utilizing advanced processing tools, translating testing results into dynamic visualizations and clear reports that enable confident decision-making for project stakeholders.

• Conduct performance analyses independently or in close collaboration with Sports Science to find correlations between our testing data and their objective insights, ensuring foundational excellence in fit, comfort, durability, and performance.

• Handle the technical nuances and complex testing requirements of novel manufacturing methods and advanced prototyping, applying deep industry experience to solve unique validation challenges before inline integration.

• Deliver benchmarking and competitor insights on early-stage concepts to identify opportunities for innovation and product differentiation.

• Drive team goals and process improvements. Act as a role model and mentor to junior testing specialists, contributing to the continuous evolution of testing methodologies within the fast-paced innovation space.

Your Story:

• 7+ years of experience in footwear testing, product creation, sports science, or development, with a strong focus on footwear innovation and early-stage validation.

• A background or strong foundational knowledge in psychology, human factors, or consumer science, enabling you to extract nuanced, subjective feedback from testers.

• Solid capability in handling and visualizing large datasets using advanced data analysis tools to efficiently clean, process, and present complex testing results.

• Excellent communication skills, capable of driving alignment across cross-functional teams and confidently presenting strategic data on major brand bets to partners across the organization.

• A strong track record of setting up structured methodologies from the ground up, clearly defining project scopes, and a passion for mentoring junior talent.

• Detail-oriented, creative, and solutions-focused, with a proactive mindset and a strong passion for performance footwear.

• Comfortable working with flexibility and adapting to shifting priorities in a highly innovative environment.

• Open to occasional global travel to connect, facilitate, and test directly with our target consumers in key markets.

• Fluent in English (written and spoken).

Your Team:

We’re a team responsible for making sure that the products for On represent the highest quality & performance standards. We have a lot of responsibility to meet the needs and demands of our customers. So we analyse, test and validate our products in the most comprehensive manner. Only products that pass our rigorous tests ever go to market.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

• Drive team goals and process improvements. Act as a role model and mentor to junior testing specialists, contributing to the continuous evolution of testing methodologies within the fast-paced innovation space.

• Comfortable working with flexibility and adapting to shifting priorities in a highly innovative environment.

• Open to occasional global travel to connect, facilitate, and test directly with our target consumers in key markets.

We’re a team responsible for making sure that the products for On represent the highest quality & performance standards. We have a lot of responsibility to meet the needs and demands of our customers. So we analyse, test and validate our products in the most comprehensive manner. Only products that pass our rigorous tests ever go to market.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

jobs.description:
In Short…

As the Lead Developer for PAD (Lifestyle) + Young Movers (Kids), you will be responsible for inline Lifestyle products in our fastest-growing, largest product vertical, alongside specialized development engineered specifically for the young movers in our community.

Honing craft takes time. It requires patience, resilience, and a dedication to the complex integration of footwear construction and systems. In this role, you are an individual contributor operating at the intersection of high-performance design for all-day wear and disciplined Swiss Engineering.

Your Mission…

• Commit to the Craft: You will lead the technical development for new silhouettes across both Adult and Kids categories, ensuring that every product meets strict engineering standards for performance, aesthetic, and fit.

• Master Complex Integration: You will serve as the primary technical partner to Design, converting creative dreams into commercial reality without compromising on function.

• Bridge the Generations: You will translate adult performance concepts into kid-specific footwear, understanding the unique biomechanical and durability needs of younger, developing feet.

Your Day-to-Day…

• Execute the Technical Lifecycle: Manage the end-to-end development process from initial 2D/3D design concepts through tech-packing, prototyping, and final production-ready samples.

• Drive Material & Tooling Innovation: Partner with material sourcing and tooling teams to test, validate, and implement new compounds, textiles, and manufacturing methods.

• Lead Fit & Wear Testing: Oversee rigorous fit and wear testing protocols for both adults and kids, analyzing feedback to iterate and optimize comfort, support, and durability.

• Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Act as the central technical hub between Design, Product Management, Sourcing, and Tier 1 factory partners to ensure timelines and margin targets are met.

• Optimize for Scale: Ensure blueprints and construction methods are optimized for mass production while maintaining the pristine aesthetic integrity of the brand.

Your Story…

• The Technical Authority: You bring 7+ years of footwear development experience , with a proven track record of launching highly complex, performance-driven lifestyle or athletic products. Experience in kids' footwear development is a massive plus.

• Resilient Individual Contributor: You have the patience and persistence to navigate the long development road. You take full accountability for the technical lifecycle and thrive when managing independent projects.

• A Problem Solver by Nature: Ingenuity is at your core. You think differently, challenge the status quo, and find elegance in solving the most difficult construction puzzles while maintaining superior performance.

• Global Collaborator: You have extensive experience working directly with overseas commercialization centers and factories, understanding how to communicate technical nuances across cultures.

Your Keys to Success…

• Thrive in Ambiguity: You don't wait for a perfect roadmap. In a fast-scaling environment, parameters change quickly; you view shifting priorities as an opportunity to innovate rather than a roadblock.

• Biased for Action (With Guardrails): You possess a strong sense of urgency. You know when to move fast and trust your gut, and when to pause to ensure Swiss-engineered quality isn't compromised.

• The "No Job Too Small" Mindset: Despite your seniority as a Lead, you are a hands-on builder. You are just as excited to brainstorm high-level platform concepts with Design as you are to roll up your sleeves and fix a tech-pack error.

• Comfortable with Constructive Friction: Innovation doesn’t happen in a vacuum. You welcome diverse perspectives, lean into healthy debate with Design and Product management, and use pushback to sharpen the final product.

• Continuous Learner: The footwear landscape—especially in sustainable materials and circularity—is evolving daily. You are naturally curious, constantly scouting new methods, and eager to apply fresh learnings to the PAD and Kids lines.

descriptionByLocale.it:
In breve...

Come Lead Sviluppatore per PAD (Lifestyle) + Young Movers (Kids), sarai responsabile per i prodotti Lifestyle in linea nella nostra più rapida crescita, più grande prodotto verticale, insieme allo sviluppo specializzato progettato specificamente per i giovani traslochi nella nostra comunità.

L'astronave richiede tempo. Richiede pazienza, resilienza e dedizione alla complessa integrazione della costruzione e dei sistemi di calzature. In questo ruolo, Lei è un contributore individuale che opera all'incrocio di design ad alte prestazioni per l'usura di tutti i giorni e l'ingegneria svizzera disciplinata.

La tua missione...

• Impegnati all'artigianato: guiderai lo sviluppo tecnico di nuove silhouette sia per le categorie Adulti che per bambini, garantendo che ogni prodotto soddisfi rigidi standard di ingegneria per prestazioni, estetica e vestibilità.

• Integrazione Master Complex: Servirai come principale partner tecnico di Design, convertendo i sogni creativi in realtà commerciale senza compromettere la funzione.

• Bridge the Generations: Tradurrete concetti di prestazioni per adulti in calzature specifiche per bambini, comprendendo le esigenze biomeccaniche e di durata uniche dei piedi più giovani e in via di sviluppo.

Il tuo giorno per giorno...

• Esegui il ciclo di vita tecnico: Gestisci il processo di sviluppo end-to-end dai concetti iniziali di progettazione 2D/3D attraverso i campioni tech-packing, prototipazione e produzione-ready finale.

• Drive Material & Tooling Innovation: Partner con team di sourcing e tooling per testare, convalidare e implementare nuovi composti, tessuti e metodi di produzione.

• Lead Fit & Wear Testing: supervisiona i protocolli di prova di vestibilità e usura rigorosi per adulti e bambini, analizzando il feedback per iterare e ottimizzare il comfort, il supporto e la durata.

• Collaborare in modo trasversale: agire come hub tecnico centrale tra Design, Product Management, Sourcing e Tier 1 partner di fabbrica per garantire tempi e obiettivi di margine.

• Ottimizzazione per Scale: Assicurare le stampe e i metodi di costruzione sono ottimizzati per la produzione di massa mantenendo l'incontaminato integrità estetica del marchio.

La tua storia...

• L'Autorità Tecnica: Porti 7+ anni di esperienza di sviluppo calzaturiero, con una comprovata traccia di lancio di stili di vita altamente complessi, orientati alle prestazioni o prodotti atletici. L'esperienza nello sviluppo delle calzature per bambini è un vantaggio enorme.

• Contributor individuale resiliente: hai la pazienza e la persistenza di navigare lungo la strada di sviluppo. Prendere piena responsabilità per il ciclo di vita tecnico e prosperare quando si gestisce progetti indipendenti.

• Un Problem Solver della Natura: L'ingegno è al vostro centro. Pensi in modo diverso, sfida lo status quo, e trovare l'eleganza nel risolvere i puzzle di costruzione più difficili, mantenendo prestazioni superiori.

• Global Collaboratore: Hai una vasta esperienza di lavoro direttamente con centri di commercializzazione all'estero e fabbriche, comprendendo come comunicare sfumature tecniche in tutte le culture.

Le tue chiavi di successo...

• Thrive in Ambiguity: Non aspettate una roadmap perfetta. In un ambiente in rapida crescita, i parametri cambiano rapidamente; si osservano le priorità di spostamento come un'opportunità per innovare piuttosto che un blocco stradale.

• Biased for Action (Con Guardrails): Hai un forte senso di urgenza. Sai quando muoversi velocemente e fidarti del tuo istinto, e quando fermarti per garantire che la qualità ingegnerizzata svizzera non sia compromessa.

• The "No Job Too Small" Mindset: Nonostante la tua anzianità come Piombo, sei un costruttore di mani. Sei altrettanto entusiasta di brainstorming concetti di piattaforma di alto livello con Design come si sta per roll up le maniche e risolvere un errore tech-pack.

• Confortevole con la frizione costruttiva: l’innovazione non avviene in un vuoto. Si accolgono diverse prospettive, si appoggiano al dibattito sano con Design e Product Management, e utilizzare pushback per affinare il prodotto finale.

• Continuous Learner: Il paesaggio calzaturiero, soprattutto in materiali e circolarità sostenibili, si sta evolvendo ogni giorno. Siete naturalmente curiosi, costantemente esplorando nuovi metodi, e desiderosi di applicare nuove apprensioni alle linee PAD e Kids.
