jobs.title: Lead - Apparel Testing
jobs.description:
In short

Product Testing is the voice of the athlete and the consumer at On. We ensure every product delivers a premium, high-performance experience by combining scientific rigor with real-world insight.

As Apparel and Accessories Testing Lead, you will be responsible for validating products from development through to market, focusing on specialized, high performance sport categories. You’ll work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and act as a key partner across Design, Development, Materials, and Strategy to ensure excellence in the wearing experience including comfort, durability, and performance.

Your mission

Command the Validation Strategy: Define and execute rigorous testing strategies across durability, comfort, and performance, taking charge of specialized testing programs. You will identify testing requirements based on product briefs and target consumers, confidently owning the end-to-end testing process.

Uncover the Truth in Data: Lead qualitative and quantitative apparel and accessories testing, perception studies, and real-world validation to ensure our products reflect authentic athlete and consumer needs. Integrate consumer insights, scientific expertise, and performance analysis into standardized, evidence-based product evaluations.

Drive Confident Decisions: Translate complex testing results into powerful insights that enable confident decision-making and elevate product excellence across the organization. You will analyze performance and durability data, including behavior and attitudinal insights, developing clear reports for project stakeholders.

Influence Product Creation: Conduct hands-on performance testing, directly presenting key findings and improvement recommendations to critical stakeholders. Deliver benchmarking and competitor insights to spot opportunities for true innovation and product differentiation in the global sports arena.

Build the Testing Ecosystem: Establish highly efficient testing processes, timelines, and feedback loops aligned seamlessly with Product Creation calendars. You will actively build and maintain a dynamic tester network of agile, high-performance athletes that supports both everyday testing needs and urgent project timelines. Set up high-energy testing events and initiatives to drive deep engagement within the testing community.

Elevate Operations: Work seamlessly with testing systems and databases to ensure accurate, high-quality data and optimized reporting flows. As a leader, you will contribute significantly to team goals, process improvements, and the continuous evolution of our testing methodologies.

Your story

• A strategic thinker and natural leader with a proven track record of managing complex projects or product validation cycles from concept to market.

• You possess a deep understanding of specialized, high-performance sports apparel and accessories, and know how to balance scientific testing rigor with real-world, human-centric feedback.

• You are an exceptional communicator who can translate dense data and testing metrics into clear, actionable recommendations to cross-functional teams

• You are highly organized and capable of building out robust tester networks, establishing efficient processes, and managing global testing logistics.

• You have 7+ years of experience in a field focused on the human experience with a product or service. We are excited to hear from candidates from diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to:

• Apparel Product Testing or Development

• User Experience Research (UXR)

• Biomechanics or Kinesiology

• Materials Science or Textile Engineering

• Ergonomics or Human Factors

• Sports Marketing or Athlete Management

• High-Performance Coaching

• You are willing to travel globally and have the flexibility to work outside of typical hours to align with athlete schedules and events.

• A clear communicator in English, both verbal and written.

Your Team

You'll be a leader in a global team fueled by a culture of relentless discovery. We test and validate our product promises, transforming athlete feedback and scientific data into market-leading performance. While our creation partners work to make products great, our mission is to prove they're great. Based in Zurich, our team of Footwear, Apparel & Accessories, and Lab experts is the ultimate destination for individuals dedicated to enhancing the consumer experience.

descriptionByLocale.it:
In breve

Test di prodotto è la voce dell'atleta e il consumatore a On. Ci assicuriamo che ogni prodotto offre un'esperienza di alta qualità, combinando rigor scientifico con la visione del mondo reale.

Come il Lead di Testing di Rarel e il Lead di Accessori, sarete responsabili della convalida dei prodotti dallo sviluppo al mercato, concentrandosi su categorie sportive specializzate e ad alte prestazioni. Lavorerete in un ambiente collaborativo e veloce e agirete come partner chiave in tutto il Design, Sviluppo, Materiali e Strategia per garantire l'eccellenza nell'esperienza di indossare tra cui comfort, durata e prestazioni.

La tua missione

Comando della strategia di convalida: Definire ed eseguire strategie di test rigorose attraverso la durata, il comfort e le prestazioni, prendendosi cura di programmi di test specializzati. Identificherete i requisiti di test basati su slip di prodotto e consumatori target, con fiducia possedere il processo di test end-to-end.

Scopri la Verità nei Dati: Lead qualitativo e quantitativo abbigliamento e accessori testing, studi di percezione, e convalida reale mondo per garantire i nostri prodotti riflettono autentiche esigenze di atleta e consumatori. Integrate intuizioni dei consumatori, competenze scientifiche, e analisi delle prestazioni in valutazioni standard, basate su prove prodotto.

Decisioni di chi ha la competenza: Tradurre risultati di test complessi in potenti intuizioni che consentono di prendere decisioni sicure e l'eccellenza di prodotti di 124 in tutta l'organizzazione. Analizzare le prestazioni e i dati di durata, tra cui behavior e intuizioni attitudinali, sviluppando report chiari per gli stakeholder del progetto.

Influenza Creazione di prodotti: Condurre test pratici delle prestazioni, presentando direttamente i risultati chiave e le raccomandazioni di miglioramento ai soggetti critici. Offrire benchmarking e informazioni sui concorrenti per individuare opportunità di vera innovazione e differenziazione dei prodotti nell'arena sportiva globale.

Costruisci l'Ecosistema di Testing: Stabilisci processi di test altamente efficienti, linee temporali e cicli di feedback allineati senza problemi con i calendari di creazione del prodotto. Costruirai e manterai attivamente una rete di tester dinamici di atleti agili, ad alte prestazioni che supportano sia le esigenze di test quotidiani che le scadenze urgenti dei progetti.

Operazioni di Elevate: Lavorate senza problemi con sistemi di testing e database per garantire dati accurati e di alta qualità e flussi di reporting ottimizzati. Come leader, contribuirete in modo significativo agli obiettivi del team, ai miglioramenti dei processi e alla continua evoluzione delle nostre metodologie di testing.

La tua storia

• Un pensatore strategico e leader naturale con un comprovata esperienza nella gestione di progetti complessi o cicli di validazione dei prodotti dal concetto al mercato.

• Si dispone di una profonda comprensione di abbigliamento sportivo specializzato e ad alte prestazioni e di accessori, e sapere bilanciare i test scientifici rigor con reale mondo, umano-centric feedback.

• Siete un comunicatore eccezionale che può tradurre dati densi e metriche di test in chiare e attuabili raccomandazioni per team cross-funzionali

• Siete altamente organizzati e in grado di costruire reti di tester robuste, stabilire processi efficienti e gestire la logistica di test globale.

• Hai 7+ anni di esperienza in un campo focalizzato sull'esperienza umana con un prodotto o un servizio. Siamo entusiasti di sentire da candidati provenienti da diversi background, tra cui, ma non limitato a:

•Product Testing o sviluppo di prodotti di base

• Ricerca sull'esperienza utente (UXR)

• Biomeccanica o Kinesiologia

• Scienza dei materiali o Ingegneria tessile

• Ergonomia o Fattori Umani

• Marketing sportivo o gestione di Athlete

• Coaching ad alte prestazioni

• Siete disposti a viaggiare a livello globale e avere la flessibilità di lavorare al di fuori delle ore tipiche per allinearsi con gli orari di atleta ed eventi.

• Un comunicatore chiaro in inglese, sia verbale che scritto.

La tua squadra

Sarai leader in un team globale alimentato da una cultura di scoperta inesorabile. Testiamo e convalidamo le promesse dei nostri prodotti, trasformando il feedback atletico e i dati scientifici in performance leader sul mercato. Mentre i nostri partner creativi lavorano per rendere grandi i prodotti, la nostra missione è dimostrare che sono grandi. Con sede a Zurigo, il nostro team di Footwear, Ravel &achres, e gli esperti di Lab è la destinazione finale per gli individui dedicati a migliorare l'esperienza dei consumatori.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Kurz gefasst

Produktprüfungen sind die Stimme des Sportlers und des Verbrauchers bei On. Wir sorgen dafür, dass jedes Produkt durch die Kombination von wissenschaftlicher Strenge mit realer Einsicht ein Premium- und Leistungserlebnis bietet.

Als Apparel und Zubehör Testing Lead sind Sie für die Validierung von Produkten von der Entwicklung bis zum Markt verantwortlich, wobei Sie sich auf spezialisierte Hochleistungssportkategorien konzentrieren. Sie arbeiten in einem schnelllebigen, kollaborativen Umfeld und agieren als wichtiger Partner in den Bereichen Design, Entwicklung, Materialien und Strategie, um herausragende Leistungen im Tragekomfort, einschließlich Haltbarkeit und Leistung zu gewährleisten.

Ihre Mission

Befehl der Validierungsstrategie: Definieren und führen Sie strenge Teststrategien über Haltbarkeit, Komfort und Leistung aus, wobei Sie spezielle Testprogramme übernehmen. Sie identifizieren Testanforderungen basierend auf Produktslips und Zielkunden, die selbstbewusst den End-to-End-Testprozess besitzen.

Entdecken Sie die Wahrheit in Daten: Führen Sie qualitative und quantitative Bekleidung und Zubehör Tests, Wahrnehmungsstudien und Real-Welt-Validierung, um sicherzustellen, dass unsere Produkte authentische Sportler und Verbraucher Bedürfnisse. Integrieren Verbraucher Einblicke, wissenschaftliche Expertise und Leistungsanalyse in standardisierte, evidenzbasierte Produktbewertungen.

Führen Sie vertrauensvolle Entscheidungen: Übersetzen Sie komplexe Testergebnisse in leistungsstarke Erkenntnisse, die eine vertrauensvolle Entscheidungsfindung ermöglichen und die Produktexzellenz in der gesamten Organisation erhöhen. Sie analysieren Leistungs- und Haltbarkeitsdaten, einschließlich Verhalten und attitudinale Erkenntnisse, und erstellen klare Berichte für Projektakteure.

Einfluss Produkterstellung: Führen Sie praktische Leistungstests durch, die wichtige Erkenntnisse und Verbesserungsempfehlungen direkt an kritische Stakeholder weitergeben. Ermöglichen Sie Benchmarking und Wettbewerbseinblicke, um Chancen für echte Innovation und Produktdifferenzierung in der globalen Sportarena zu erkennen.

Build the Testing Ecosystem: Etablieren Sie hocheffiziente Testprozesse, Zeitlinien und Feedback-Schleifen, die nahtlos mit den Produkterstellungskalendern abgestimmt sind. Sie bauen und pflegen aktiv ein dynamisches Tester-Netzwerk von agilen, leistungsstarken Athleten, die sowohl den täglichen Testbedarf als auch die dringenden Projekt-Zeitlinien unterstützen.

Elevate Operations: Arbeiten Sie nahtlos mit Testsystemen und Datenbanken, um genaue, qualitativ hochwertige Daten und optimierte Reporting-Flows zu gewährleisten. Als Marktführer tragen Sie maßgeblich zu Teamzielen, Prozessverbesserungen und der kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung unserer Testmethoden bei.

Ihre Geschichte

• Ein strategischer Denker und natürlicher Marktführer mit einer bewährten Erfolgsbilanz bei der Verwaltung komplexer Projekte oder Produktvalidierungszyklen von Konzept zu Markt.

• Sie verfügen über ein tiefes Verständnis von spezialisierten, leistungsstarken Sportbekleidung und Zubehör und wissen, wie man wissenschaftliche Teststarre mit realen, menschenzentrierten Feedbacks ausgleicht.

• Sie sind ein außergewöhnlicher Kommunikator, der dichte Daten übersetzen und Metriken in klare, umsetzbare Empfehlungen an funktionsübergreifende Teams testen kann.

• Sie sind hoch organisiert und in der Lage, robuste Testernetzwerke aufzubauen, effiziente Prozesse zu etablieren und die globale Testlogistik zu verwalten.

• Sie haben 7+ Jahre Erfahrung in einem Bereich, der sich auf die menschliche Erfahrung mit einem Produkt oder einer Dienstleistung konzentriert. Wir freuen uns, von Kandidaten aus verschiedenen Hintergründen zu hören, einschließlich, aber nicht beschränkt auf:

• Produktprüfung oder Entwicklung von Bekleidung

• User Experience Research (UXR)

• Biomechanik oder Kinesiologie

• Materialwissenschaft oder Textiltechnik

• Ergonomie oder menschliche Faktoren

• Sportmarketing oder Athletenmanagement

• Leistungsorientiertes Coaching

• Sie sind bereit, global zu reisen und haben die Flexibilität, außerhalb der typischen Stunden zu arbeiten, um sich an die Zeiten und Ereignisse der Athleten anzupassen.

• Ein klarer Kommunikator in englischer Sprache, sowohl mündlich als auch schriftlich.

Ihr Team

Sie werden ein führendes Team sein, das von einer Kultur der unerbittlichen Entdeckung angetrieben wird. Wir testen und validieren unsere Produktversprechen, indem wir Athletenfeedback und wissenschaftliche Daten in marktführende Leistung verwandeln. Während unsere Kreationspartner daran arbeiten, Produkte großartig zu machen, ist unsere Mission es, zu beweisen, dass sie großartig sind. Unser Team aus Schuh-, Bekleidungs- und Zubehörartikeln und Lab-Experten mit Sitz in Zürich ist das ultimative Ziel für Einzelpersonen, die sich der Verbesserung der Verbrauchererfahrung widmen.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Bref

Les tests de produit sont la voix de l'athlète et du consommateur chez On. Nous nous assurons que chaque produit offre une expérience premium et haute performance en combinant la rigueur scientifique avec la vision du monde réel.

En tant que chef de test Apparel et Accessoires, vous serez responsable de la validation des produits du développement au marché, en mettant l'accent sur les catégories de sport spécialisées et de haute performance. Vous travaillerez dans un environnement collaboratif et rapide et agirez comme partenaire clé dans la conception, le développement, les matériaux et la stratégie pour assurer l'excellence dans l'expérience de port, y compris le confort, la durabilité et la performance.

Votre mission

Commandez la stratégie de validation : Définissez et exécutez des stratégies de test rigoureuses pour la durabilité, le confort et la performance, en prenant en charge des programmes de test spécialisés. Vous identifierez les exigences de test en fonction des dossiers de produit et des consommateurs cibles, en possédant avec confiance le processus de test de bout en bout.

Découvrez la vérité dans les données : Tests qualitatifs et quantitatifs de vêtements et accessoires, études de perception et validation du monde réel pour s'assurer que nos produits reflètent les besoins authentiques des athlètes et des consommateurs.

Conduire les décisions de confiance : Transférer les résultats de tests complexes en des idées puissantes qui permettent de prendre des décisions confiantes et d'élever l'excellence des produits dans l'ensemble de l'organisation.

Influence Création de produits : Effectuez des essais pratiques de performance, en présentant directement les principales constatations et les recommandations d'amélioration aux intervenants critiques.

Construisez l'écosystème de test : établissez des processus de test, des délais et des boucles de rétroaction très efficaces et alignés de façon transparente sur les calendriers de création de produits. Vous créerez et maintenirez activement un réseau dynamique d'athlètes de haute performance et d'athlètes de valence qui répondent aux besoins quotidiens des tests et aux délais urgents des projets.

Des opérations élevées : Travaillez de façon transparente avec les systèmes et bases de données de test pour assurer des données précises et de haute qualité et des flux de rapports optimisés. En tant que leader, vous contribuerez de façon significative aux objectifs de l'équipe, aux améliorations de processus et à l'évolution continue de nos méthodes de test.

Votre histoire

• Un penseur stratégique et un leader naturel ayant fait ses preuves dans la gestion de projets complexes ou de cycles de validation de produits d'un concept à l'autre.

• Vous avez une compréhension approfondie des vêtements et accessoires sportifs spécialisés et de haute performance, et savez équilibrer la rigueur scientifique des tests avec la rétroaction humaine réelle.

• Vous êtes un interlocuteur exceptionnel qui peut traduire des données denses et des mesures de test en recommandations claires et réalisables aux équipes interfonctionnelles

• Vous êtes hautement organisé et capable de construire des réseaux robustes de investigation, d'établir des processus efficaces et de gérer la logistique de test globale.

• Vous avez 7 ans et plus d'expérience dans un domaine axé sur l'expérience humaine avec un produit ou un service. Nous sommes impatients d'entendre des candidats de divers horizons, y compris, mais non exclusivement:

• Essai ou développement de produits Apparel

• Recherche sur l'expérience utilisateur (UXR)

• Biomécanique ou Kinésiologie

• Science des matériaux ou génie textile

• Ergonomie ou facteurs humains

• Marketing sportif ou gestion des athlètes

• Coaching haute performance

• Vous êtes prêt à voyager dans le monde entier et avez la flexibilité de travailler en dehors des heures normales pour vous aligner sur les horaires et les événements des athlètes.

• Un communicateur clair en anglais, à la fois verbal et écrit.

Votre équipe

Nous testons et valideons nos promesses de produits, transformant les retours d'expérience et les données scientifiques des athlètes en performances de pointe sur le marché. Nos partenaires de création travaillent pour faire de grands produits, mais notre mission est de prouver qu'ils sont excellents. Basés à Zurich, notre équipe de Chaussures, Apparel & Accessoires et Lab experts est la destination ultime pour les personnes dédiées à améliorer l'expérience du consommateur.

jobs.title: Lead - Accessories Developer (Technical) Bags
jobs.description:
In short
 The Lead Accessories Developer - (Technical) Bags will report to the Lead - Accessories Development on the Accessories team supporting the Global Product function. You will be the technical engine behind the bags technical range. Your mission is to translate complex designs into market ready products through expert product development, precise sizing architecture, and superior technical construction.

Your mission
 - Deliver exceptional product quality by merging innovative manufacturing techniques with early-stage material explorations to develop novel construction methods.
- Partner closely with the Materials team to leverage their early-stage material explorations. Select and apply fabrics, trims, and components based on hard performance data and functional requirements rather than aesthetic appeal alone.
- Move beyond standard 2D/3D documentation by physically validating concepts through hands-on prototyping. Build and manipulate physical samples to prove the feasibility and functional logic of new construction methods before engaging external suppliers.
- Ensure all early-stage concepts function harmoniously with the human body in motion. Validate fit, sizing, and ergonomics through a biomechanical lens to optimize performance and comfort.
- Conduct rigorous testing and risk analysis on new constructions to identify and correct potential failure points before projects transition to the main development cycle.
- The "Golden Standard": Create, refine, and enforce a flawless standard for detailed Technical Packages (Tech Packs) and Bill of Materials (BOMs) within the PLM system.
- Critical Path Ownership: Manage the overarching product development calendar, tracking milestones closely to ensure the timely delivery of seasonal ranges.
- Build and leverage strategic relationships with both domestic and overseas suppliers. Negotiate product costs and implement strict quality assurance practices to optimize margins without compromising the product's integrity.
- Work dynamically with manufacturing partners to streamline and improve sample turnaround times, resolving production bottlenecks proactively.
- Act as a technical mentor to junior development staff, fostering an environment of continuous learning, technical excellence, and curiosity.
- Guide cross-functional teams (Design, Product Management, and Sourcing) to align on product execution and establish strategic external partnerships that introduce new, industry-first market differentiators.

Your story
 - Deep Specialization: You bring 10+ years of experience dedicated exclusively to the development of accessories focused on technical bags.
- Performance Expertise: You have a proven track record in sports and high-end performance gear, understanding the rigors of athletic use.
- Technical Bags and Packs Background: Extensive experience in performance and technical bags and packs is highly desirable.
- Multi-Product Mastery: You are an expert in developing varied silhouettes.
- Analytical Design: Proficient in translating 2D design concepts into 3D performance realities using advanced PLM systems and Adobe Illustrator.
- Global Sourcing: Experience collaborating with world-class manufacturers to push the boundaries of performance textile innovation.
- Meticulous attention to detail regarding measurements, tolerances, and material specifications.
- A constant drive to explore new yarn technologies and construction methods to solve problems.
- A proactive approach to troubleshooting fit and construction issues during the development phase.

Meet the team
 You will join a dynamic, cross-functional team dedicated to redefining accessories. We are a group of specialists who value technical rigor, aesthetic elevation, and challenge the Status Quo mindset. Our team operates at the intersection of high-end fashion and elite sport, moving fast to turn innovative ideas into premium products.

What we offer
 On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

jobs.description:
In short
 Whether you’re looking to jump start your career or gain first hands-on experience in a new field, an internship at On offers you a unique growth experience, the chance to make an impact from day 1 and contribute to On’s growth journey. We are looking for fresh ideas, curious minds and passionate individuals ready to make a difference. Our internships generally last 6 months and you will be fully embedded in a team.
- Start date: September 1st
- Duration: 6 months
- Prerequisite: Interest in area relevant to the internship, passion for On, right to work in EU / Switzerland
- Note: This is a paid internship
- If you don't meet the criteria above, unfortunately, we cannot move forward with your application. Please be truthful in your answers, the recruiter reviewing your application will appreciate your honesty.

Curious about life as an intern at On? We recommend watching the recording of our previous livestream (https://agora-cf-cloud-recordings.s3.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com/livestreams/5OdzwcwgV3l6rGfcJCZ5/2e6c0b4e51486dd2cf595f9bde0b257c_5OdzwcwgV3l6rGfcJCZ5_0.mp4) to hear former interns share their internship experience, get an insider’s look at different departments and pick up some tips and tricks from our recruiters to help you ace the application process!

Your mission
 - Proactively monitor integration performance, conduct regular audits, and implement necessary corrections to ensure high data accuracy and system reliability.
- Support the implementation of integration solutions by aligning technical requirements, data formats, and business rules across internal systems and external partners.
- Partner with internal and external teams on meticulous testing and validation to ensure seamless, high-quality data flow for new initiatives and rollouts.
- Explore Agentic AI: Use the latest AI toolsets as an aid to write high-quality code and learn to deploy intelligent agents, leveraging the latest Google LLM models to build autonomous agents, remove manual tasks and improve operational efficiency.

Your story
 - Creator Mindset: You are a passionate technologist who loves to create solutions that help people. You're focused on developing and deploying systems that use AI to solve real human and business problems.
- Agentic Curiosity: You are curious about the potential of AI agents. Whether you have already experimented with LLMs or are just starting to explore, you are eager to learn how to apply these tools to solve complex challenges in real-world distributed systems.
- Growth Mindset: You happily step out of your comfort zone to tackle unfamiliar tasks, viewing both successes and failures as vital learning opportunities.

 - Proactively monitor integration performance, conduct regular audits, and implement necessary corrections to ensure high data accuracy and system reliability.
- Support the implementation of integration solutions by aligning technical requirements, data formats, and business rules across internal systems and external partners.

- Explore Agentic AI: Use the latest AI toolsets as an aid to write high-quality code and learn to deploy intelligent agents, leveraging the latest Google LLM models to build autonomous agents, remove manual tasks and improve operational efficiency.

Your story
 - Creator Mindset: You are a passionate technologist who loves to create solutions that help people. You're focused on developing and deploying systems that use AI to solve real human and business problems.

jobs.title: HR Specialist, South Europe (Italian OR French speaker)

titleByLocale.it: Risorse Umane Specialista, South Europe (Italian OR French speaker)
titleByLocale.en: HR Specialist, South Europe (Italian OR French speaker)
titleByLocale.de: Personalwesen Spezialist, South Europe (Italian OR French speaker)
titleByLocale.fr: Ressources Humaines Spécialiste, South Europe (Italian OR French speaker)

jobs.description:
In short:

Our HR team is heavily expanding to support On’s explosive growth, and we are looking for an enthusiastic person to join us as Senior HR Specialist in the HR Operations Team. This role is for someone who has experience in HR Operations, ideally in a fast-paced, scale-up and retail environment. The role is ideal for someone who enjoys new challenges, appreciates a streamlined and supportive process, and has a passion for HR compliance. While France & Italy will be your main focus, you will also support other EMEA entities.

Mission:

• You act as the country-specific HR-support for France, Italy, Spain and Portugal

• Local labor law and labor relations expertise, providing guidance to local managers, Business Partners and HR teams (in partnership with Legal where required).

• You facilitate HR trainings on updated country legislation to our stakeholders

• You are responsible for the exit process and administration in each country

• You support locally in the roll out of new benefits, and contribute to regular benefits reviews in collaboration with Total Rewards team

• In collaboration with the payroll specialist you own leave management and administration for your countries in scope

• You support our HRBPs in investigations

• You advise and guide the business, as well as employees on HR compliance topics (policies, benefits, employment set-ups, and leave management incl. parental leave)

• You support local audits, health & safety activities and, mandatory reportings

• You are responsible for assessing proposals from business or stakeholders and raise concerns proactively where needed, while providing solutions based on local regulations and independent risk assessment

• You introduce new initiatives to ensure HR compliance in your respective countries in accordance with NCA

• You support new market and new entity launch as well as support new store openings and acquisitions, to support On's continued growth

• You support the ER team as a point of contact for the trade unions and works council

• You deliver and improve HR operations processes in the region, aligned to global processes in collaboration with Payroll and other HR Functions.

• You drive and own execution of regional HR operations projects, and take part in global HR projects when required

Your story:

• 5-8 years HR Operations/HR Specialist experience (scale up or multinational preferred)

• Fluency in English , and proficiency in Italian OR French . Any other local language is a plus

• Hands-on HRIS experience (Workday) and used to working in excel and google sheets

• Proficient knowledge of local labour law, social security and tax compliance, in minimum one local market (experience from several markets is a plus)

• Great stakeholder management, attention to detail, used to handling confidential data, and a premium service mindset

• You don’t shy away from challenges, the unknown and demonstrate resiliency at all times

• Thrive in a fast-paced environment and enjoy thinking outside the box, always looking for ways to improve

• Experience in project management, labor relations and retail operations are seen as a plus

Your team: Being part of the HR team at On means doing things differently, we don’t do things just because they are what “HR does”. We build, grow, enable and empower the team to drive the future of On. The HR Operations team strives to create and deliver a seamless and positive employee experience at all times. Because this is what matters to us. Because we are On.

descriptionByLocale.it:
In breve:

Il nostro team HR è fortemente in espansione per sostenere la crescita esplosiva di On, e stiamo cercando una persona entusiasta di unirsi a noi come Senior HR Specialist nel Team Operazioni HR. Questo ruolo è per qualcuno che ha esperienza nelle operazioni HR, idealmente in un ambiente veloce, scale-up e retail. Il ruolo è ideale per chi ama nuove sfide, apprezza un processo snellato e di supporto, e ha una passione per la conformità alle risorse umane. Mentre la Francia e l'Italia saranno il vostro obiettivo principale, supporterete anche altre entità EMEA.

Missione:

• Agisci come supporto HR specifico per il paese per Francia, Italia, Spagna e Portogallo

• Competenze di diritto del lavoro locale e relazioni di lavoro, fornendo indicazioni ai manager locali, ai partner commerciali e alle squadre HR (in collaborazione con Legale dove richiesto).

• Agevolare le formazioni HR sulla legislazione di un paese aggiornato ai nostri stakeholder

• Sei responsabile del processo di uscita e dell'amministrazione in ogni paese

• Supporti localmente nel roll out di nuovi benefici e contribuisci a regolari recensioni dei benefici in collaborazione con il team Total Rewards

• In collaborazione con lo specialista del libro paga che possiedi la gestione del congedo e l'amministrazione per i vostri paesi nel campo di applicazione

• Sostieni le nostre risorse umane nelle indagini

• Si consiglia e guida il business, così come i dipendenti su temi di conformità HR (politiche, benefici, sistemi di occupazione, e lasciare la gestione incl congedo parentale)

• Supporti audit locali, attività di salute e sicurezza e, segnalazioni obbligatorie

• L'utente è responsabile della valutazione delle proposte da parte di aziende o stakeholder e dell'aumento delle preoccupazioni in modo proattivo, se necessario, fornendo soluzioni basate sulle normative locali e sulla valutazione del rischio indipendente

• Introduce nuove iniziative per garantire la conformità delle risorse umane nei rispettivi paesi in conformità con NCA

• Supporti il nuovo mercato e il nuovo lancio di entitÃ e supporta nuove aperture e acquisizioni del negozio, per sostenere la crescita continua di On

• Sostieni il team ER come punto di contatto per i sindacati e il consiglio di lavoro

• Fornisci e migliora i processi operativi HR nella regione, allineati ai processi globali in collaborazione con Payroll e altre funzioni HR.

• Si guida e la propria esecuzione di progetti regionali di operazioni HR, e prendere parte a progetti HR globali quando necessario

La tua storia:

• 5-8 anni HR Operations/HR Esperienza specialistica (preferito su scala o multinazionale)

• Fluenza in inglese e competenza in italiano o francese. Qualsiasi altra lingua locale è un plus

• Hands-on HRIS esperienza (Giornata di lavoro) e utilizzato per lavorare in fogli excel e google

• Conoscenza competente del diritto del lavoro locale, della sicurezza sociale e della conformità fiscale, in un mercato locale minimo (l'esperienza da diversi mercati è un plus)

• Grande gestione delle parti interessate, attenzione ai dettagli, utilizzato per la gestione dei dati confidenziali e una mentalità di servizio premium

• Non timido lontano dalle sfide, l'ignoto e dimostrare resilienza in ogni momento

• Thrive in un ambiente veloce e godere di pensare al di fuori della scatola, sempre alla ricerca di modi per migliorare

• L'esperienza nella gestione del progetto, i rapporti di lavoro e le operazioni di vendita al dettaglio sono visti come un plus

Il vostro team: Essere parte del team HR di On significa fare le cose in modo diverso, non facciamo le cose solo perché sono ciò che “HR fa”. Costruiamo, cresciamo, consentiamo e potenziamo il team per guidare il futuro di On. Il team HR Operations si sforza di creare e fornire un'esperienza dipendente senza soluzione di continuità e positiva in ogni momento. Perché questo è ciò che conta per noi. Perche' siamo su.
descriptionByLocale.en:
In short:

Our HR team is heavily expanding to support On’s explosive growth, and we are looking for an enthusiastic person to join us as Senior HR Specialist in the HR Operations Team. This role is for someone who has experience in HR Operations, ideally in a fast-paced, scale-up and retail environment. The role is ideal for someone who enjoys new challenges, appreciates a streamlined and supportive process, and has a passion for HR compliance. While France & Italy will be your main focus, you will also support other EMEA entities.

Mission:

• You act as the country-specific HR-support for France, Italy, Spain and Portugal

• Local labor law and labor relations expertise, providing guidance to local managers, Business Partners and HR teams (in partnership with Legal where required).

• You facilitate HR trainings on updated country legislation to our stakeholders

• You are responsible for the exit process and administration in each country

• You support locally in the roll out of new benefits, and contribute to regular benefits reviews in collaboration with Total Rewards team

• In collaboration with the payroll specialist you own leave management and administration for your countries in scope

• You support our HRBPs in investigations

• You advise and guide the business, as well as employees on HR compliance topics (policies, benefits, employment set-ups, and leave management incl. parental leave)

• You support local audits, health & safety activities and, mandatory reportings

• You are responsible for assessing proposals from business or stakeholders and raise concerns proactively where needed, while providing solutions based on local regulations and independent risk assessment

• You introduce new initiatives to ensure HR compliance in your respective countries in accordance with NCA

• You support new market and new entity launch as well as support new store openings and acquisitions, to support On's continued growth

• You support the ER team as a point of contact for the trade unions and works council

• You deliver and improve HR operations processes in the region, aligned to global processes in collaboration with Payroll and other HR Functions.

• You drive and own execution of regional HR operations projects, and take part in global HR projects when required

Your story:

• 5-8 years HR Operations/HR Specialist experience (scale up or multinational preferred)

• Fluency in English , and proficiency in Italian OR French . Any other local language is a plus

• Hands-on HRIS experience (Workday) and used to working in excel and google sheets

• Proficient knowledge of local labour law, social security and tax compliance, in minimum one local market (experience from several markets is a plus)

• Great stakeholder management, attention to detail, used to handling confidential data, and a premium service mindset

• You don’t shy away from challenges, the unknown and demonstrate resiliency at all times

• Thrive in a fast-paced environment and enjoy thinking outside the box, always looking for ways to improve

• Experience in project management, labor relations and retail operations are seen as a plus

Your team: Being part of the HR team at On means doing things differently, we don’t do things just because they are what “HR does”. We build, grow, enable and empower the team to drive the future of On. The HR Operations team strives to create and deliver a seamless and positive employee experience at all times. Because this is what matters to us. Because we are On.

• Connaissance approfondie du droit local du travail, de la sécurité sociale et de la conformité fiscale, sur au moins un marché local (l'expérience de plusieurs marchés est un plus)

• Vous ne vous éloignez pas des défis, de l'inconnu et de la résilience en tout temps

• L'expérience dans la gestion de projet, les relations de travail et les opérations de détail sont considérées comme un plus

Votre équipe: Faire partie de l'équipe RH à On signifie faire les choses différemment, nous ne faisons pas les choses juste parce qu'ils sont ce que le RH fait. Nous construisons, développons, permettons et autonomisons l'équipe pour conduire l'avenir d'On. L'équipe des opérations des RH s'efforce de créer et de fournir une expérience d'employé transparente et positive en tout temps. Parce que c'est ce qui compte pour nous. Parce que nous sommes en marche.

jobs.title: Head of Strategy & Operations, Footwear Product Creation

titleByLocale.it: Responsabile Strategia e Operazioni, Creazione Prodotti Calzature
titleByLocale.en: Head of Strategy & Operations, Footwear Product Creation
titleByLocale.fr: Responsable Stratégie et Opérations, Création de Produits Chaussures

jobs.description:
In short

As the Head of Strategy & Operations, you are the architect of Footwear Creation's operating model. You will translate On's 2030 Long Range Plan into executable transformation- driving the strategic initiatives, processes, and systems that enable our team to deliver breakthrough footwear with Swiss-engineered precision. Sitting at the intersection of Development, Engineering, Materials, and Sustainability, you will influence leaders across functions, build organizational excitement for new ways of working, and make decisive calls on initiative prioritization and execution. Your mission: own the LRP initiative portfolio, orchestrate the leadership operating rhythm, and deliver measurable transformation that elevates how we create.

Your mission

Strategic Leadership & Vision (LRP to Action)

• Architect the Roadmap: Translate On’s 2030 LRP and annual goals into a multi-year strategic roadmap for Footwear Product Creation

• Strategic Prioritization: Act as the Creation gatekeeper for the footwear portfolio, ensuring technical breakthroughs are sequenced and resourced for maximum commercial impact.

Portfolio Strategy & Operating Rhythm

• Own seasonal range portfolio planning: capacity modeling, resource allocation, project prioritization

• Design and manage the Footwear Creation operating rhythm: weekly leadership standups, monthly business reviews, quarterly strategic planning

• Facilitate high-stakes leadership discussions; Own the agendas, pre-reads, drive decisions and follow-through for all leadership forums

• Serve as the primary coordination point between Creation and cross-functional partners (Innovation, Sourcing, Brand, Supply Chain)

• Build portfolio dashboards that give leadership real-time visibility into capacity, progress, risks, and trade-offs.

Process Excellence & Transformation

• Lead strategic initiatives to improve creation velocity: stage-gate optimization, systems integration, capacity planning frameworks

• Identify and eliminate process inefficiencies; challenge any workflow that doesn't add value

• Drive adoption of new ways of working through clear metrics, change management, and feedback loops

• Build a high-accountability, fast-decision culture within the Creation leadership team.

Change Management & Adoption Excellence

• Drive adoption of new initiatives through comprehensive change management: communication strategies, training programs, adoption metrics, feedback mechanisms

• Build organizational excitement and understanding of the strategic rationale behind transformational changes

• Navigate politics and complexity to drive decisions and unblock progress

• Hold partners accountable to commitments- even when they don't report to you

• Monitor leading indicators of adoption; implement course corrections when resistance or confusion emerges

• Foster a culture of accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement within Footwear Creation.

Your Story

• Experience: 10+ years of leadership in Product Strategy, Program Management, or Footwear Creation, with a proven track record of translating corporate strategy into actionable cross-functional initiatives

• Operational Rigor: Exceptional executive facilitation skills; you are comfortable holding senior stakeholders accountable and running high-stakes leadership rhythms

• Influence without authority: You've led initiatives where success required getting leaders who don't report to you to change how they work. You have low self orientation

• Footwear Acumen: Deep understanding of the end-to-end product creation lifecycle- from innovation and engineering to global manufacturing

• Data-Driven Mindset: Exceptional analytical and visualization skills; you can turn complex project data into clear insights for executive decision-making

• Transformation Leader: Experience leading organizational change, including "Future State" org design and the implementation of new operating models

• Communication: A natural storyteller, capable of inspiring large teams on stage and navigating complex cross-functional partnerships

• Passion: An undeniable drive for sports, footwear technology, and Swiss-engineered innovation.

Why This Matters

On is scaling fast. Footwear Creation needs to evolve- not just work harder, but work smarter. We need new systems, new processes, new ways of collaborating. We need someone who can drive that transformation across a complex, cross-functional organization.

You won't build the products. But you'll build the operating model, the systems, and the culture that enable products and brand initiatives to be adopted and built with excellence, at speed, at scale.

If you're the kind of transformation leader who thrives on complexity, who knows how to influence without authority, who can make tough calls and drive change that sticks- this is your role.

Meet The Team

Our mission is to define and create the future of sportswear bringing to life groundbreaking innovations. Acting at the forefront of material science, sport science and engineering we develop products that push the boundaries of performance and sustainability, blending in unique aesthetic appeal that embodies On’s design DNA.

What we offer

On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

descriptionByLocale.it:
In breve

Come responsabile strategico e operativo, sei l'architetto del modello operativo di Footwear Creation. Tradurrai il Piano Long Range 2030 di On in una trasformazione eseguibile, guidando le iniziative strategiche, i processi e i sistemi che permettono al nostro team di fornire calzature rivoluzionarie con precisione svizzera. Seduto all'incrocio tra sviluppo, ingegneria, materiali e sostenibilità, influenzerai i leader attraverso le funzioni, costruirai emozioni organizzative per nuovi modi di lavorare e richiamerai in modo decisivo sulla priorità e sull'esecuzione dell'iniziativa.

La tua missione: possedere il portafoglio di iniziative LRP, orchestrare il ritmo operativo della leadership e fornire una trasformazione misurabile che il '42 è come creiamo.

La tua missione

Leadership strategica e visione (LRP to Action) - Architect the Roadmap: Translate On.s 2030 LRP e gli obiettivi annuali in una roadmap strategica pluriennale per la creazione di prodotti calzaturieri - Priorità strategica: Act as the Creation gatekeeper for the calzaturiera portfolio, assicurando che le scoperte tecniche siano sequenziate e risorse per il massimo impatto commerciale.

Strategia di portafoglio e ritmo operativo - Pianificazione del portafoglio stagionale propria: modellazione della capacità, allocazione delle risorse, priorità del progetto - Progettazione e gestione del ritmo operativo della creazione di calzature: standup settimanali di leadership, revisioni aziendali mensili, pianificazione strategica trimestrale - Facilita discussioni di leadership ad alte prese di posizione; Possiedete i programmi, pre-letture, decisioni di guida e follow-through per tutti i forum di leadership - Serve come punto di coordinamento primario tra creazione e partner cross-funzionali (innovazione, Sourcing, Brand, Supply Chain) - Costruite dashboard di portafoglio che danno

la visibilità in tempo reale della leadership in capacità, progresso, rischi e compromessi.

Processo di eccellenza e trasformazione - Leader iniziative strategiche per migliorare la velocità di creazione: ottimizzazione del cancello di fase, integrazione dei sistemi, pianificazione delle capacità framework - Identificare ed eliminare le inefficienze di processo; sfidare qualsiasi flusso di lavoro che non aggiunge valore - Guidare l'adozione di nuovi modi di lavorare attraverso metriche chiare, gestione dei cambiamenti e loop di feedback - Costruire una cultura ad alta responsabilità, rapida decisione all'interno del team di direzione della creazione.

Gestione dei cambiamenti & Adotion Excellence - Guidare l'adozione di nuove iniziative attraverso una gestione completa dei cambiamenti: strategie di comunicazione, programmi di formazione, metriche di adozione, meccanismi di feedback - Costruire l'eccitazione organizzativa e la comprensione della logica strategica dietro i cambiamenti di trasformazione - Navigare la politica e la complessità per guidare le decisioni e sbloccare i progressi - Tenere i partner responsabili degli impegni - anche quando non si riferiscono a voi - Monitorare indicatori principali di adozione; implementare correzioni dei corsi quando emerge resistenza o confusione - Promuovere una cultura di

responsabilità, trasparenza e miglioramento continuo all'interno della creazione di calzature.

La tua storia

- Esperienza: 10+ anni di leadership nella Strategia del Prodotto, Gestione del Programma, o Creazione di Calzature, con un comprovata esperienza di tradurre strategia aziendale in iniziative interfunzionali attuabili - Rigor operativo: Eccezionale capacità di agevolazione esecutiva; sei a tuo agio a tenere responsabili gli stakeholder senior e a gestire ritmi di leadership ad alto livello - Influenza senza autorità: Hai guidato iniziative dove il successo richiedeva di ottenere leader che non ti riferiscono di cambiare il loro funzionamento.

Hai un basso orientamento - Footwear Acumen: una profonda comprensione del ciclo di vita della creazione di prodotti end-to-end- dall'innovazione e l'ingegneria alla produzione globale - Data-Driven Mindset: eccezionali capacità analitiche e di visualizzazione; puoi trasformare i dati di progetto complessi in chiare intuizioni per il processo decisionale esecutivo - Transformation Leader: esperienza di cambiamento organizzativo leader, tra cui il design org "Future State" e l'implementazione di nuovi modelli operativi - Comunicazione: Un narratore naturale, capace di ispirare grandi team sul palco e navigare in complesse cross-funzionali

partnership - Passione: un innegabile impulso per lo sport, la tecnologia calzaturiera e l'innovazione svizzera.

Perché questo importa

La creazione di calzature deve evolversi, non solo lavorare più duramente, ma lavorare più intelligente. Abbiamo bisogno di nuovi sistemi, nuovi processi, nuovi modi di collaborare. Abbiamo bisogno di qualcuno che possa guidare questa trasformazione attraverso un'organizzazione complessa e cross-funzionale.

Non costruirai i prodotti, ma costruirai il modello operativo, i sistemi e la cultura che permettono di adottare e costruire prodotti e iniziative di marca con eccellenza, a velocità, su scala.

Se sei il tipo di leader della trasformazione che prospera sulla complessità, che sa influenzare senza autorità, che può fare chiamate difficili e guidare il cambiamento che si attacca- questo è il tuo ruolo.

Incontra la squadra

La nostra missione è definire e creare il futuro dello sportswear portando alla luce innovazioni innovative. Aggendo all'avanguardia nella scienza dei materiali, nello sport e nell'ingegneria sviluppiamo prodotti che spingono i confini delle prestazioni e della sostenibilità, mescolandosi in un unico appeal estetico che incarna il DNA di progettazione On.s.

Cosa offriamo

Il nostro approccio distintivo combina un'atmosfera di supporto e orientata al team, con l'accesso alla cura personale di sé per il benessere sia fisico che mentale, così ogni persona è guidata da uno scopo.

E' un datore di lavoro per pari opportunità. Ci impegniamo a creare un ambiente di lavoro equo e inclusivo, dove tutte le decisioni relative al reclutamento, al progresso e al mantenimento sono esenti da discriminazioni.

On is scaling fast. Footwear Creation needs to evolve- not just work harder, but work smarter. We need new systems, new processes, new ways of collaborating. We need someone who can drive that transformation across a complex, cross-functional organization.

You won't build the products. But you'll build the operating model, the systems, and the culture that enable products and brand initiatives to be adopted and built with excellence, at speed, at scale.

If you're the kind of transformation leader who thrives on complexity, who knows how to influence without authority, who can make tough calls and drive change that sticks- this is your role.

Meet The Team

Our mission is to define and create the future of sportswear bringing to life groundbreaking innovations. Acting at the forefront of material science, sport science and engineering we develop products that push the boundaries of performance and sustainability, blending in unique aesthetic appeal that embodies On’s design DNA.

What we offer

On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Kurz gefasst

Als Head of Strategy & Operations sind Sie der Architekt des Betriebsmodells von Footwear Creation. Sie übersetzen den Long Range Plan von On 2030 in ausführbare Transformationen – die strategischen Initiativen, Prozesse und Systeme, die es unserem Team ermöglichen, bahnbrechende Schuhe mit Schweizer Präzision zu liefern. An der Schnittstelle von Entwicklung, Engineering, Materialien und Nachhaltigkeit sitzend, werden Sie die Führungspersönlichkeiten über Funktionen hinweg beeinflussen, organisatorische Aufregung für neue Arbeitsweisen aufbauen und entscheidende Aufrufe zur Initiativprioritätierung und -ausführung setzen.

Ihre Mission: Besitzen Sie das LRP-Initiativenportfolio, orchestrieren Sie den Führungsrhythmus und liefern Sie messbare Transformationen, die unsere Kreationen erhöhen.

Ihre Mission

Strategic Leadership & Vision (LRP to Action) - Architect the Roadmap: Übersetzen auf,s 2030 LRP und jährliche Ziele in eine mehrjährige strategische Roadmap für die Erstellung von Schuhen Produkt - Strategische Priorisierung: Als Creation Gatekeeper für das Schuhportfolio, die technische Durchbrüche sind sequenziert und für maximale kommerzielle Wirkung Ressourcen.

Portfolio Strategie & operativer Rhythmus - Eigene saisonale Portfolioplanung: Kapazitätsmodellierung, Ressourcenallokation, Projektprioritätierung - Design und Management der Footwear Creation Betriebsrhythmus: wöchentliche Führungspositionen, monatliche Unternehmensberichte, vierteljährliche strategische Planung - Facilitate High-Stakes Führungsdiskussionen; Eigene Agendas, Pre-Reads, Antriebsentscheidungen und Follow-Through für alle Leadership-Foren - Dienen Sie als primärer Koordinationspunkt zwischen Creation und cross-funktionalen Partnern (Innovation, Sourcing, Brand, Supply Chain) - Erstellen Sie Portfolio-Dashboards, die geben

Führungsposition in Echtzeit in Bezug auf Kapazitäten, Fortschritte, Risiken und Kompromisse.

Process Excellence & Transformation - Führende strategische Initiativen zur Verbesserung der Erstellungsgeschwindigkeit: Stage-Gate-Optimierung, Systemintegration, Capacity Planning Frameworks - Identifizieren und beseitigen Prozessineffizienzen; jeden Workflow, der keinen Mehrwert bringt herausfordern - Antrieb der Annahme neuer Arbeitsweisen durch klare Metriken, Change Management und Feedback-Schleifen - Bauen Sie eine hoch rechenschaftsfähige, schnellentscheidungsfähige Kultur im Creation Leadership Team.

Change Management & Adoption Excellence - Antrieb der Annahme neuer Initiativen durch umfassende Change Management: Kommunikationsstrategien, Trainingsprogramme, Adoption Metriken, Feedback-Metriken - Aufbau von organisatorischen Aufregung und Verständnis der strategischen Begründung hinter Transformationsänderungen - Navigieren Sie Politik und Komplexität, um Entscheidungen zu treiben und den Fortschritt zu entsperren - Halten Sie Partner gegenüber Verpflichtungen rechenschaftspflichtig - auch wenn sie nicht an Sie berichten - Überwachen Sie führende Indikatoren der Adoption; implementieren Kurskorrekturen, wenn Widerstand oder Verwirrung entsteht - Förderung einer Kultur der

Rechenschaftspflicht, Transparenz und kontinuierliche Verbesserung innerhalb der Schuhkreation.

Ihre Geschichte

- Erfahrung: 10 Jahre mehr Führung in Produktstrategie, Programmmanagement oder Footwear Creation, mit einer bewährten Erfolgsbilanz bei der Umsetzung von Unternehmensstrategie in handlungsfähige funktionsübergreifende Initiativen - Operational Rigor: Außergewöhnliche Fähigkeiten zur Verbesserung der Führungskräfte; Sie sind komfortabel, Senior Stakeholder verantwortlich zu halten und hohe Takes Führungsrhythmen zu betreiben - Einfluss ohne Autorität: Sie haben Initiativen geführt, bei denen Erfolg erforderlich war, um Führungskräfte zu bekommen, die Ihnen nicht berichten, um ihre Arbeitsweise zu ändern.

Sie haben eine geringe Selbstorientierung - Schuhe Acumen: Tiefes Verständnis des End-to-End-Produktkreation-Lebenszyklus - von Innovation und Engineering bis hin zur globalen Fertigung - Data-Driven Mindset: Außergewöhnliche analytische und Visualisierungskompetenzen; Sie können komplexe Projektdaten zu klaren Erkenntnissen für die Entscheidungsfindung machen - Transformation Leader: Erleben Sie führende organisatorische Veränderungen, darunter "Future State"-Org-Design und die Umsetzung neuer Operationsmodelle - Kommunikation: Ein natürlicher Geschichtenerzähler, der große Teams auf der Bühne inspirieren und komplexe Cross-Funktionalitäten navigieren kann

Partnerschaften - Passion: Ein unbestreitbarer Antrieb für Sport, Schuhtechnik und schweizerische Innovationen.

Warum das so wichtig ist

Die Schuhkreation muss sich entwickeln, nicht nur härter arbeiten, sondern auch intelligenter arbeiten. Wir brauchen neue Systeme, neue Prozesse, neue Wege der Zusammenarbeit. Wir brauchen jemanden, der diese Transformation über eine komplexe, funktionsübergreifende Organisation hinweg vorantreiben kann.

Sie werden die Produkte nicht bauen, aber Sie werden das Betriebssystem, die Systeme und die Kultur, die Produkte und Markeninitiativen in die Hand nehmen und mit Exzellenz, in Geschwindigkeit und im Maßstab bauen zu können, bauen.

Wenn Sie die Art von Transformationsführer sind, der von Komplexität gedeiht, der weiß, wie man ohne Autorität beeinflusst, der harte Anrufe tätigen und Veränderungen antreiben kann, die Ihre Rolle spielen.

Das Team treffen

Unsere Mission ist es, die Zukunft der Sportbekleidung zu definieren und zu schaffen, die bahnbrechende Innovationen zum Leben erweckt. Mit der Arbeit an der Spitze der Materialwissenschaft, der Sportwissenschaft und der Technik entwickeln wir Produkte, die die Grenzen von Leistung und Nachhaltigkeit überschreiten und sich in einzigartiger ästhetischer Anziehungskraft vereinen, die On,s Design DNA verkörpert.

Was wir anbieten

Wir bieten ein Umfeld, das den Menschen die Werkzeuge bietet, sich ganzheitlich zu entwickeln – aktiv zu bleiben, zu lernen, zu erforschen und zu innovativ zu sein. Unser unverwechselbarer Ansatz verbindet eine unterstützende, teamorientierte Atmosphäre mit dem Zugang zur persönlichen Selbstversorgung für körperliches und geistiges Wohlbefinden, sodass jede Person nach dem Ziel geführt wird.

Wir verpflichten uns, ein faires und integratives Arbeitsumfeld zu schaffen, in dem alle Entscheidungen im Zusammenhang mit der Einstellung, dem Aufstieg und der Beibehaltung von Arbeitsplätzen frei von Diskriminierung sind.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Bref

En tant que responsable de la stratégie et des opérations, vous êtes l'architecte du modèle opérationnel de la création de chaussures. Vous allez traduire le plan à longue portée 2030 d'On en transformation exécutable - en conduisant les initiatives stratégiques, les processus et les systèmes qui permettent à notre équipe de livrer des chaussures révolutionnaires avec précision de conception suisse.

Votre mission : posséder le portefeuille d'initiatives du PRL, orchestrer le rythme opérationnel de leadership et fournir une transformation mesurable qui élève la façon dont nous créons.

Votre mission

Leadership stratégique et vision (RPL à l'action) - Architecte la feuille de route : Translate On, S 2030 PRP et objectifs annuels en une feuille de route stratégique pluriannuelle pour la création de produits de chaussures - Priorité stratégique : Agir comme gardien de la création pour le portefeuille de chaussures, en veillant à ce que les percées techniques soient séquencées et dotées de ressources pour un impact commercial maximal.

Stratégie et rythme de fonctionnement du portefeuille - Planification du portefeuille de l'aire de répartition saisonnière : modélisation des capacités, allocation des ressources, priorisation des projets - Conception et gestion du rythme de fonctionnement de la création de chaussures : bilans hebdomadaires de leadership, examens mensuels des affaires, planification stratégique trimestrielle - Faciliter les discussions de leadership à haut niveau; Posséder les agendas, les lectures préalables, les décisions et le suivi pour tous les forums de leadership - Servir de point de coordination principal entre la création et les partenaires interfonctionnels (Innovation, Sourcing, Marque, Chaîne d'approvisionnement) - Créer des tableaux de bord de portefeuille qui donnent

leadership visibilité en temps réel dans la capacité, les progrès, les risques et les compromis.

Excellence et transformation des processus - Diriger les initiatives stratégiques pour améliorer la vitesse de création : optimisation de la grille de production, intégration des systèmes, cadres de planification des capacités - Identifier et éliminer les inefficacités des processus; contester tout workflow qui n'ajoute pas de valeur - Encourager l'adoption de nouvelles façons de travailler grâce à des mesures claires, à la gestion du changement et à des boucles de rétroaction - Créer une culture de responsabilité élevée et de décision rapide au sein de l'équipe de direction de la Création.

Gestion du changement et excellence en matière d'adoption - Favoriser l'adoption de nouvelles initiatives par une gestion globale du changement : stratégies de communication, programmes de formation, mesures d'adoption, mécanismes de rétroaction - Accroître l'excitation organisationnelle et la compréhension de la raison d'être stratégique des changements transformationnels - Naviguer dans la politique et la complexité pour diriger les décisions et débloquer les progrès - Tenir les partenaires responsables des engagements - même s'ils ne vous rendent pas compte - Surveiller les indicateurs d'adoption de premier plan; mettre en oeuvre des corrections de cours lorsque la résistance ou la confusion se manifeste - Favoriser une culture de l'adoption

la responsabilité, la transparence et l'amélioration continue au sein de la création de chaussures.

Votre histoire

- Expérience : 10 ans et plus de leadership dans la stratégie de produits, la gestion de programmes ou la création de chaussures, avec une expérience éprouvée de la traduction de la stratégie ministérielle en initiatives interfonctionnelles réalisables - Rigeur opérationnelle : compétences exceptionnelles en matière de facilitation de la direction; vous êtes à l'aise de tenir les intervenants supérieurs responsables et de faire fonctionner des rythmes de leadership à haut rendement - Influence sans autorité : Vous avez dirigé des initiatives où le succès exige que les dirigeants qui ne vous rendent pas compte changent leur façon de travailler.

Vous avez une faible orientation - Chaussures Œcumé : Une compréhension approfondie du cycle de vie de la création de produits de bout en bout - de l'innovation et de l'ingénierie à la fabrication mondiale - Data-Driven Mindset : Des compétences exceptionnelles en analyse et visualisation ; vous pouvez transformer des données de projet complexes en idées claires pour la prise de décision exécutive - Transformation Leader : Expérience de changement organisationnel de premier plan, y compris la conception d'un org "Future State" et la mise en œuvre de nouveaux modèles d'exploitation - Communication : Un conteur naturel, capable d'inspirer de grandes équipes sur scène et de naviguer sur des fonctions transversales complexes

partenariat - Passion : un moteur indéniable pour le sport, la technologie de la chaussure et l'innovation suisse.

Pourquoi cela compte

La création de chaussures doit évoluer - non seulement travailler plus dur, mais travailler plus intelligemment. Nous avons besoin de nouveaux systèmes, de nouveaux processus, de nouvelles façons de collaborer. Nous avons besoin de quelqu'un qui peut conduire cette transformation à travers une organisation complexe et interfonctionnelle.

Vous ne construireez pas les produits. Mais vous créerez le modèle d'exploitation, les systèmes et la culture qui permettent d'adopter et de construire des produits et des initiatives de marque avec excellence, à la vitesse et à l'échelle.

Si vous êtes le genre de chef de la transformation qui prospère sur la complexité, qui sait influencer sans autorité, qui peut faire des appels difficiles et conduire le changement qui tient-ce est votre rôle.

Rencontrez l'équipe

Notre mission est de définir et de créer l'avenir du sportwear apportant des innovations révolutionnaires. Agissant à l'avant-garde des sciences matérielles, des sciences du sport et de l'ingénierie, nous développons des produits qui repoussent les limites de la performance et de la durabilité, se mêlant à un attrait esthétique unique qui incarne l'ADN de conception On,s.

Ce que nous offrons

Nous offrons un environnement conçu pour donner aux gens les outils de développement holistique – rester actifs, apprendre, explorer et innover. Notre approche distinctive combine une atmosphère solidaire et axée sur l'équipe, avec l'accès à des soins personnels pour le bien-être physique et mental, de sorte que chaque personne est dirigée par un but.

Nous sommes déterminés à créer un milieu de travail équitable et inclusif, où toutes les décisions liées au recrutement, à l'avancement et au maintien en poste sont exemptes de discrimination.

jobs.title: Head of Product Management Tennis
jobs.description:
In short
 We are looking for a visionary and hands-on leader to join us as Head of Product Management, a strategic leadership role with end-to-end accountability for shaping our footwear product line. This role will define the future of our presence in sport—specifically expanding our footprint in Tennis & Training—creating products that resonate with elite athletes and lifestyle consumers while elevating the brand's premium position.
You will own all parts of the product creation lifecycle, leveraging consumer and athlete insights, briefing, and concept creation to master product architecture, cultural storytelling, and commercial handoff.
More importantly, you will be a key leader within Footwear Product Creation. You will build and inspire a high-performing team while fostering strong cross-functional collaboration across apparel, accessories, and key business verticals. You will partner closely with innovation, engineering, and sourcing teams to bring best-in-class footwear to market, balancing craft with massive commercial scalability. This is an opportunity to shape & define what premium footwear means for On, drawing on elite industry playbooks to drive meaningful, multi-million dollar impact across athletes, consumers, and the business.

Your mission
 - Define and lead a clear, consumer-driven product vision and strategy for footwear, aligning cross-functional teams around a cohesive direction that delivers against both brand hype and billion-dollar business objectives.
- Build, develop, and inspire a high-performing product management team, setting an elite standard for excellence in strategic thinking, commercial execution, and collaboration across the entire product creation organization.
- Champion the voice of the athlete and consumer at the highest level, translating global insights into highly differentiated product concepts, tiering strategies (from limited energy to commercial scale), and narratives that elevate the brand in sport culture.
- Drive lockstep cross-functional alignment across design, development, merchandising, and commercial teams, ensuring seamless execution from initial brief to marketplace delivery with clarity, speed, and precision.
- Operate with an exceptional balance of creativity and business acumen, making strategic decisions that prioritize pipeline innovation, multi-tier scalability, and long-term franchise growth while navigating a fast-paced, evolving product landscape.

Your story
 - 15 years of proven experience leading and scaling high-performing product management teams, with a natural ability to set a clear vision and drive decisive action across complex, matrixed global organizations.
- A remarkable track record of transforming and scaling lifestyle footwear franchises into global revenue drivers
- Strong strategic mindset with a history of building long-range product plans that successfully map the size of the opportunity, target consumer profiles, price tiers (High/Mid/Low), and regional growth dimensions while aligning executive leadership.
- Deep understanding of the global footwear landscape, with a demonstrated ability to create, evolve, and sustain a product line that drives cultural energy and commands top-10 global best-selling status across diverse consumer segments.
- Exceptional ability to manage a dual-engine product portfolio, masterfully balancing limited-release collaborations to drive brand heat with high-volume general releases that convert demand into sustained, high-volume commercial growth.
- Confident, compelling, and intentional communicator, capable of influencing executive leadership, managing high-profile external stakeholders, and clearly articulating product storytelling from concept to the marketplace.
- A leadership style rooted in coaching and education—such as academic or mentorship experience in sports product creation—that fosters an inclusive, high-performance environment, empowers teams, and elevates the collective organizational output.

Meet the team
 This individual will be joining a highly dedicated team focused on the pursuit of the industry's most premium, dynamic, and industry-defining product line. The larger team brings expertise in design, development, testing, engineering, color and materials design as well as innovation. This individual will be tasked to bring out the absolute best of each functional group, leveraging an entrepreneurial mindset and structured sports-business expertise for the greater good of the product line.

What we offer
 On is a place that is centered around growth and progress. We offer an environment designed to give people the tools to develop holistically – to stay active, to learn, explore and innovate. Our distinctive approach combines a supportive, team-oriented atmosphere, with access to personal self-care for both physical and mental well-being, so each person is led by purpose.

On is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a work environment that is fair and inclusive, where all decisions related to recruitment, advancement, and retention are free of discrimination.

This is a critical leadership role where you will be responsible for translating creative concepts into highly functional, durable, and commercially viable (technical) performance and lifestyle accessories. You will lead a high-performing team, drive product innovation, and own the development process from initial prototyping to final production, ensuring the highest standards of quality, performance, and sustainability. This role will report into the Global Senior Director of Product Creation + Sourcing.

Your mission

Your mission is to execute the accessories development strategy and roadmap aligned with the overall brand, product, and financial goals. You will oversee development and successful commercialization from ideation to launch, including engineering, sampling, testing, milestone management, and final specifications. You will deliver against gross margin targets, manage department budgets while optimising costs. You will also provide collaborative leadership to align teams and foster an innovative work environment that encourages creativity, risk-taking and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

• Execute overall accessories development strategy and map out a roadmap which aligns with the overall brand, product, and financial goals

• Oversee all development and ensure commercialization of the product range from ideation to launch, including development engineering, sampling, testing, milestone management, and final product specifications

• Work as a partner to Design, Materials, Innovation, Product Management, and Sourcing teams to ensure successful delivery of seasonal products and execute strategic vision for the business

• Deliver against gross margin targets and manage department budgets while optimizing on costs

• Conduct comprehensive market research to identify emerging trends, competitive threats, and new market opportunities

• Support and partner with our Sourcing teams in Asia & Europe on building a robust global sourcing strategy that emphasises high-quality products, world-class partnerships, service, ethical sourcing and sustainability

• Implement supply chain initiatives, in partnership with our ESG team, that reduce environmental impact, such as using recycled and preferred materials, advanced water treatment and color dyeing technologies and optimising logistics with initiatives like localisation

• Stay at the forefront of emerging technologies and market trends to identify and oversee the development of innovative accessories that meet performance, durability, and sustainability requirements, which will instigate new ways of thinking about products

• Establish and enforce rigorous product testing and quality control protocols to ensure compliance with industry standards and brand requirements

• Spearhead and streamline product development and manufacturing processes to increase efficiency, reduce complexity and time to market

• Build and maintain strong relationships with key suppliers, engage with industry stakeholders, including athletes and sports professionals and work with the cross-functional stakeholders to gather customer feedback and incorporate it into future product designs.

Your story

• 15+ years of experience in accessories (hard and soft goods), including at least 7 years in a senior leadership role.

• Hold a deep understanding of sports accessory trends and competitor landscapes, with a proven ability to identify and capitalise on market opportunities, to drive growth and innovation within the accessories category

• Expert knowledge of technical textiles, manufacturing processes, and "design for manufacturing" principles, alongside proficiency in the latest creation software.

• A strong commitment to sustainability and a history of implementing sustainability initiatives in product development and sourcing

• Familiarity with the latest creation software and technologies relevant to accessory design, development and production.
